tip_text.text: Respawn Pads provide a forward operating base but at a high cost, place them well.

de.original: Respawn Pads provide a forward operating base but at a high cost, place them well.
de.translation: Respawnfelder ermöglichen dir ein schnelles Vorrücken, sind jedoch teuer. Platzier sie gut!

es.original: Respawn Pads provide a forward operating base but at a high cost, place them well.
es.translation: Los bloques de reaparición te permiten comenzar en una posición de avanzada pero cuestan bastante.

pt.original: Respawn Pads provide a forward operating base but at a high cost, place them well.
pt.translation: Pontos de Ressurgimento servem de base operacional de dianteira, mas com um custo alto. Posicione-os com sabedoria.

fr.original: Respawn Pads provide a forward operating base but at a high cost, place them well.
fr.translation: Les blocs de réapparition vous permettent d'installer des postes avancés, mais ils sont coûteux en ressources. Placez-les judicieusement.

ru.original: Respawn Pads provide a forward operating base but at a high cost, place them well.
ru.translation: Платформы возрождения хороши для создания передовой базы, но дорого стоят. Размещай их с умом.

tip_text.text: The Rocket Launcher alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> allows you to aim down the sights making your shots much more accurate.

de.original: The Rocket Launcher alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> allows you to aim down the sights making your shots much more accurate.
de.translation: Beim alternativen Angriff des Raketenwerfers (<BINDING_Cast2>) kannst du sein Fadenkreuz zum genaueren Zielen nutzen.

es.original: The Rocket Launcher alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> allows you to aim down the sights making your shots much more accurate.
es.translation: Usa el ataque secundario del lanzacohetes (<BINDING_CAST2>) para observar a través de la mira y tener más precisión.

pt.original: The Rocket Launcher alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> allows you to aim down the sights making your shots much more accurate.
pt.translation: O tiro secundário do Lança-foguetes (<BINDING_Cast2>) permite que você use uma mira, tornando seus disparos muito mais precisos.

fr.original: The Rocket Launcher alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> allows you to aim down the sights making your shots much more accurate.
fr.translation: L'action secondaire du lance-roquettes (<BINDING_Cast2>) vous permet de viser et de gagner en précision.

ru.original: The Rocket Launcher alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> allows you to aim down the sights making your shots much more accurate.
ru.translation: «Альтернативный огонь» ракетницы (<BINDING_Cast2>) дает возможность прицелиться и значительно повысить точность стрельбы.

tip_text.text: Defend your tunnels with traps and Radars because your enemies can use them too!

de.original: Defend your tunnels with traps and Radars because your enemies can use them too!
de.translation: Verteidige deine Tunnel mit Fallen und Radaren, denn auch deine Gegner können die Tunnel nutzen!

es.original: Defend your tunnels with traps and Radars because your enemies can use them too!
es.translation: Para evitar que los enemigos usen los túneles que tú cavaste, defiéndelos con trampas y radares.

pt.original: Defend your tunnels with traps and Radars because your enemies can use them too!
pt.translation: Defenda seus túneis com armadilhas e radares, já que seus inimigos podem utilizá-los também!

fr.original: Defend your tunnels with traps and Radars because your enemies can use them too!
fr.translation: Vos ennemis peuvent emprunter vos tunnels, alors défendez-les en plaçant des pièges et des radars !

ru.original: Defend your tunnels with traps and Radars because your enemies can use them too!
ru.translation: Защищай свои тоннели при помощи ловушек и радаров, потому что враги тоже могут воспользоваться ими.

tip_text.text: Sandbags take time to construct, but are one of the strongest building blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> and hold to place.

de.original: Sandbags take time to construct, but are one of the strongest building blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> and hold to place.
de.translation: Sandsäcke zu bauen, dauert etwas, aber sie sind unter den stärksten Baublöcken. Drück die <BINDING_CAST2> und halte sie zum Platzieren gedrückt.

es.original: Sandbags take time to construct, but are one of the strongest building blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> and hold to place.
es.translation: Los sacos de arena tardan bastante en construirse, pero son uno de los bloques más resistentes.

pt.original: Sandbags take time to construct, but are one of the strongest building blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> and hold to place.
pt.translation: Sacos de areia levam tempo para construir, mas são um dos blocos de construção mais fortes. Segure <BINDING_CAST2> para posicionar.

fr.original: Sandbags take time to construct, but are one of the strongest building blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> and hold to place.
fr.translation: Les blocs de sable prennent du temps à construire, mais ce sont les blocs les plus résistants du jeu. Maintenez l'action secondaire (<BINDING_CAST2>) enfoncée pour en construire un.

ru.original: Sandbags take time to construct, but are one of the strongest building blocks. <BINDING_CAST2> and hold to place.
ru.translation: На строительство мешков с песком уйдет время, но оно того стоит. Нажми и удерживай <BINDING_CAST2>.

tip_text.text: Sarge’s M60 OMG has a large clip. Mow your enemies down!

de.original: Sarge’s M60 OMG has a large clip. Mow your enemies down!
de.translation: Sarges M60 OMG hat ein sehr großes Magazin. Mach deine Gegner fertig!

es.original: Sarge’s M60 OMG has a large clip. Mow your enemies down!
es.translation: La ametralladora de Sarge tiene un cargador de gran capacidad, por lo que podrás disparar bastante antes de que se te acaben las municiones.

pt.original: Sarge’s M60 OMG has a large clip. Mow your enemies down!
pt.translation: A M60 OMG de Sarge possui um pente de balas grande. Encha seus inimigos de chumbo!

fr.original: Sarge’s M60 OMG has a large clip. Mow your enemies down!
fr.translation: Le chargeur de la mitrailleuse M60 de Sarge est bien garni. De quoi décimer vos ennemis !

ru.original: Sarge’s M60 OMG has a large clip. Mow your enemies down!
ru.translation: У пулемета M60, которым владеет Sarge, большая обойма. Он буквально выкашивает врагов!

tip_text.text: Sarge can throw a grenade with his Active Ability. Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> and toss them into a small enclosed area for the best results.

de.original: Sarge can throw a grenade with his Active Ability. Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> and toss them into a small enclosed area for the best results.
de.translation: Mit seiner aktiven Fähigkeit wirft Sarge Granaten. Drück <BINDING_USEABILITY> und wirf sie in enge Bereiche, um den meisten Schaden anzurichten.

es.original: Sarge can throw a grenade with his Active Ability. Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> and toss them into a small enclosed area for the best results.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_USEABILITY> para ejecutar la destreza activa «Granada» de Sarge. Arrójala en una zona cerrada para mejores resultados.

pt.original: Sarge can throw a grenade with his Active Ability. Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> and toss them into a small enclosed area for the best results.
pt.translation: Sarge pode lançar uma granada com sua habilidade ativa. Aperte a tecla <BINDING_USEABILITY> e jogue-as numa área enclausurada para melhores resultados.

fr.original: Sarge can throw a grenade with his Active Ability. Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> and toss them into a small enclosed area for the best results.
fr.translation: Sarge peut lancer une grenade grâce à sa capacité active. Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_USEABILITY> et lancez-les dans une zone fermée pour des dégâts accrus.

ru.original: Sarge can throw a grenade with his Active Ability. Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> and toss them into a small enclosed area for the best results.
ru.translation: Активная способность Sarge позволяет ему бросить гранату. Гранаты особенно эффективны на небольших закрытых территориях. Нажми «<BINDING_USEABILITY>» для броска.

tip_text.text: Remember to use Sarge Stone's frag grenade Active Ability to finish off enemies taking cover.

ru.original: Remember to use Sarge Stone's frag grenade Active Ability to finish off enemies taking cover.
ru.translation: Используй осколочные гранаты Sarge Stone (активная способность), чтобы прикончить врагов, засевших в укрытии.

es.original: Remember to use Sarge Stone's frag grenade Active Ability to finish off enemies taking cover.
es.translation: Usa la destreza de granada de Sarge Stone para ultimar a los enemigos que estén atrincherados.

de.original: Remember to use Sarge Stone's frag grenade Active Ability to finish off enemies taking cover.
de.translation: Setze Sarge Stones Splittergranate ein, um in Deckung gegangenen Gegnern den Rest zu geben.

pt.original: Remember to use Sarge Stone's frag grenade Active Ability to finish off enemies taking cover.
pt.translation: Lembre-se de usar a habilidade ativa de granada de fragmentação de Sarge Stone para terminar de matar inimigos abrigados.

fr.original: Remember to use Sarge Stone's frag grenade Active Ability to finish off enemies taking cover.
fr.translation: N'oubliez pas d'utiliser la capacité active Grenade à fragmentation de Sarge Stone pour achever les ennemis à couvert.

tip_text.text: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

de.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
de.translation: Links unten im Spielfenster siehst du, wie viele Bausteine du hast. Grab für mehr Bausteine!

es.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

pt.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de Tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais Tijolos.

fr.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
fr.translation: Votre nombre total de briques est affiché en bas à gauche de l'écran. Creusez pour en récupérer davantage.

ru.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
ru.translation: Общее количество кирпичей указано в левом нижнем углу экрана. Копай, чтобы получить больше кирпичей.

tip_text.text: Hitting an opponent with a rocket and switching to the M60 OMG is the best way to maximize damage.

de.original: Hitting an opponent with a rocket and switching to the M60 OMG is the best way to maximize damage.
de.translation: Den meisten Schaden kannst du anrichten, indem du deinen Gegner mit einer Rakete triffst und dann zum M60 OMG wechselst.

es.original: Hitting an opponent with a rocket and switching to the M60 OMG is the best way to maximize damage.
es.translation: La manera más efectiva de causarle daño a los enemigos es atacarlos primero con el lanzacohetes y luego usar la ametralladora.

pt.original: Hitting an opponent with a rocket and switching to the M60 OMG is the best way to maximize damage.
pt.translation: Atingir um oponente com um foguete e depois trocar para a M60 OMG é a melhor forma de maximizar danos.

fr.original: Hitting an opponent with a rocket and switching to the M60 OMG is the best way to maximize damage.
fr.translation: Pour infliger un maximum de dégâts à votre cible, attaquez-la à coups de roquette, puis équipez votre mitrailleuse M60.

ru.original: Hitting an opponent with a rocket and switching to the M60 OMG is the best way to maximize damage.
ru.translation: Лучший способ нанести максимальный урон — поразить противника ракетой и переключиться на пулемет M60.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.

de.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_RECALL>, um in ungefähr 15 Sekunden wieder bei deiner Basis zu erscheinen. Sehr nützlich, wenn du in einer Zwickmühle steckst!

es.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
es.translation: Si oprimes <BINDING_RECALL> volverás al punto de partida de ese mapa luego de 15 segundos. Útil si te encuentras en una posición difícil.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
pt.translation: Pressione a tecla <BINDING_RECALL> no jogo para retornar à sua Base depois de cerca de 15 segundos. Útil se você estiver numa situação difícil.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_RECALL> en jeu pour retourner à votre base au bout de 15 secondes. Pratique si vous êtes en mauvaise posture.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
ru.translation: Нажми «<BINDING_RECALL>» в игре, чтобы вернуться на базу примерно через 15 секунд. Это удобно, когда оказываешься в сложной ситуации.

tip_text.text: Nigel’s Active Ability Spot Prey reveals an area - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to find sneaky enemies and their devices.

de.original: Nigel’s Active Ability Spot Prey reveals an area - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to find sneaky enemies and their devices.
de.translation: Nigels aktive Fähigkeit 'Zielerfassung' deckt Gebiete auf - drück <BINDING_USEABILITY>, um Gegner und deren Anlagen zu finden.

es.original: Nigel’s Active Ability Spot Prey reveals an area - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to find sneaky enemies and their devices.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_USEABILITY> para ejecutar la destreza activa de Nigel «Localizador de presas» y ver los rivales y dispositivos enemigos que estén en tu zona.

pt.original: Nigel’s Active Ability Spot Prey reveals an area - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to find sneaky enemies and their devices.
pt.translation: A habilidade ativa Localizador de Presas de Nigel revela uma área - aperte <BINDING_USEABILITY> para encontrar inimigos escondidos e seus dispositivos.

fr.original: Nigel’s Active Ability Spot Prey reveals an area - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to find sneaky enemies and their devices.
fr.translation: La capacité active de Nigel, Ciblage de proie, révèle les dispositifs placés et les héros se trouvant dans la zone. Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_USEABILITY> pour repérer les ennemis cachés et leurs dispositifs.

ru.original: Nigel’s Active Ability Spot Prey reveals an area - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to find sneaky enemies and their devices.
ru.translation: Активная способность Nigel «Зоркий глаз» показывает все вокруг. Нажми «<BINDING_USEABILITY>», чтобы увидеть прячущихся врагов и их устройства.

tip_text.text: Nigel’s Passive Ability Bounty grants him and his team Bricks with each kill.

de.original: Nigel’s Passive Ability Bounty grants him and his team Bricks with each kill.
de.translation: Nigels passive Fähigkeit 'Kopfgeld' bringt ihm und seinem Team mit jedem Kill Bausteine ein.

es.original: Nigel’s Passive Ability Bounty grants him and his team Bricks with each kill.
es.translation: La destreza pasiva de Nigel «Cazarrecompensas» le otorga cubos a él y a su equipo con cada nueva víctima que mata.

pt.original: Nigel’s Passive Ability Bounty grants him and his team Bricks with each kill.
pt.translation: A habilidade passiva Caçador de Recompensas de Nigel proporciona Tijolos para ele e sua equipe a cada abate.

fr.original: Nigel’s Passive Ability Bounty grants him and his team Bricks with each kill.
fr.translation: Pour chaque ennemi tué, la capacité passive de Nigel Abondance de butin lui permet ainsi qu'à ses coéquipiers de récupérer des briques.

ru.original: Nigel’s Passive Ability Bounty grants him and his team Bricks with each kill.
ru.translation: Пассивная способность «Нажива» дает Nigel и его команде кирпичи за каждое убийство.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.

de.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_HEROINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Helden anzusehen.

es.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_HEROINFO> para ver información detallada del personaje elegido.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_HEROINFO> no jogo para ver informações detalhadas sobre o herói selecionado.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_HEROINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le héros sélectionné.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_HEROINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном герое.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.

de.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_DEVICEINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Block anzusehen.

es.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> para ver información detallada del bloque elegido.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> no jogo para ver informações sobre o bloco selecionado.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le bloc sélectionné.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном блоке.

tip_text.text: Tiki Heads slow, dizzy and damage your enemies. Hide them away in walls.

de.original: Tiki Heads slow, dizzy and damage your enemies. Hide them away in walls.
de.translation: Tiki-Köpfe verlangsamen, benebeln und schaden deinen Gegnern. Versteck sie in Mauern!

es.original: Tiki Heads slow, dizzy and damage your enemies. Hide them away in walls.
es.translation: Las cabezas tiki ralentizan, marean y hieren a tus enemigos. Escóndelas en los huecos de los muros para que los rivales no las vean.

pt.original: Tiki Heads slow, dizzy and damage your enemies. Hide them away in walls.
pt.translation: Cabeças Tiki desaceleram, atordoam e causam danos em seus inimigos. Esconda-as em paredes.

fr.original: Tiki Heads slow, dizzy and damage your enemies. Hide them away in walls.
fr.translation: Les totems tiki ralentissent, étourdissent et infligent des dégâts à vos ennemis. Dissimulez-les dans les murs.

ru.original: Tiki Heads slow, dizzy and damage your enemies. Hide them away in walls.
ru.translation: Стреляющие головы замедляют врагов, вызывают у них головокружение и наносят им урон. Прячьте их в стенах.

tip_text.text: Much like the Spot Prey, the Tiki Head reveals anyone that has been hit for a couple of seconds.

de.original: Much like the Spot Prey, the Tiki Head reveals anyone that has been hit for a couple of seconds.
de.translation: Ähnlich wie die Zielerfassung zeigen die Tiki-Köpfe alle getroffenen Gegner für ein paar Sekunden an.

es.original: Much like the Spot Prey, the Tiki Head reveals anyone that has been hit for a couple of seconds.
es.translation: Al igual que «Localizador de presas», las cabezas tiki muestran durante un par de segundos quién fue atacado.

pt.original: Much like the Spot Prey, the Tiki Head reveals anyone that has been hit for a couple of seconds.
pt.translation: Assim como o Localizador de Presas, a Cabeça Tiki revela qualquer um que tenha sido atingido por alguns segundos.

fr.original: Much like the Spot Prey, the Tiki Head reveals anyone that has been hit for a couple of seconds.
fr.translation: Tout comme Ciblage de proie, les totems tiki rendent visible tout ennemi touché pendant quelques secondes.

ru.original: Much like the Spot Prey, the Tiki Head reveals anyone that has been hit for a couple of seconds.
ru.translation: Подобно «Зоркому глазу», стреляющая голова показывает того, кому был нанесен удар, в течение нескольких секунд.

tip_text.text: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

de.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
de.translation: Deine Waffe kannst du mit <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> wechseln.

es.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> para cambiar de arma.

pt.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
pt.translation: Troque de armas com <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

fr.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
fr.translation: Changez d'arme en appuyant sur la touche <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

ru.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
ru.translation: Менять оружие можно при помощи «<BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>».

tip_text.text: Build Speed Pads in tunnels to whoosh down them quickly.

de.original: Build Speed Pads in tunnels to whoosh down them quickly.
de.translation: Nutze Beschleunigungsblöcke in Tunneln, um schnell durch sie hindurchzurasen.

es.original: Build Speed Pads in tunnels to whoosh down them quickly.
es.translation: Coloca bloques aceleradores en los túneles para avanzar rápidamente.

pt.original: Build Speed Pads in tunnels to whoosh down them quickly.
pt.translation: Construa Placas Aceleradoras em túneis para passar rapidamente por eles.

fr.original: Build Speed Pads in tunnels to whoosh down them quickly.
fr.translation: Placez des accélérateurs dans les tunnels pour les traverser en un clin d'œil.

ru.original: Build Speed Pads in tunnels to whoosh down them quickly.
ru.translation: Используй ускорители в тоннелях, чтобы вихрем проноситься по ним.

tip_text.text: Nigel can take out enemy turrets safely from far away.

ru.original: Nigel can take out enemy turrets safely from far away.
ru.translation: Nigel может без легко издалека уничтожать вражеские турели.

es.original: Nigel can take out enemy turrets safely from far away.
es.translation: Nigel puede derribar torretas enemigas desde lejos de manera segura.

de.original: Nigel can take out enemy turrets safely from far away.
de.translation: Nigel kann gegnerische Gefechtstürme aus sicherer Entfernung ausschalten.

pt.original: Nigel can take out enemy turrets safely from far away.
pt.translation: Nigel pode destruir torres de tiro inimigas à distância com segurança.

fr.original: Nigel can take out enemy turrets safely from far away.
fr.translation: Nigel peut éliminer les tourelles ennemies en toute sécurité à distance.

tip_text.text: Zoom in with Nellie’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> to maximize its accuracy.

de.original: Zoom in with Nellie’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> to maximize its accuracy.
de.translation: Beim alternativen Angriff von Nellie (<BINDING_Cast2>) kannst du ihr Fadenkreuz zum genaueren Zielen nutzen.

es.original: Zoom in with Nellie’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> to maximize its accuracy.
es.translation: Usa el ataque secundario de la escopeta (<BINDING_CAST2>) para observar a través de la mira y tener más precisión.

pt.original: Zoom in with Nellie’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> to maximize its accuracy.
pt.translation: Aproxime seu alvo com o tiro secundário de Nellie (<BINDING_CAST2>) para maximizar sua precisão.

fr.original: Zoom in with Nellie’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> to maximize its accuracy.
fr.translation: L'action secondaire de Lucille vous permet de viser (<BINDING_CAST2>) pour gagner en précision.

ru.original: Zoom in with Nellie’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> to maximize its accuracy.
ru.translation: «Альтернативный огонь» винтовки (<BINDING_CAST2>) позволяет прицелиться и добиться максимальной точности.

tip_text.text: Headshots hurt! Aim for the head whenever possible with Nellie.

de.original: Headshots hurt! Aim for the head whenever possible with Nellie.
de.translation: Headshots tun weh! Ziel mit Nellie so oft wie möglich auf den Kopf.

es.original: Headshots hurt! Aim for the head whenever possible with Nellie.
es.translation: Siempre que sea posible, apunta a la cabeza al usar la escopeta.

pt.original: Headshots hurt! Aim for the head whenever possible with Nellie.
pt.translation: Tiros na cabeça são dolorosos! Mire na cabeça dos oponentes sempre que possível com Nellie.

fr.original: Headshots hurt! Aim for the head whenever possible with Nellie.
fr.translation: Un tir en pleine tête, ça fait mal ! Essayez de viser votre cible entre les deux yeux avec Lucille dès que possible.

ru.original: Headshots hurt! Aim for the head whenever possible with Nellie.
ru.translation: Выстрел в голову — это больно! Всегда старайся попасть из винтовки в голову.

tip_text.text: You can reload your clip before fully emptying it by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD>.

de.original: You can reload your clip before fully emptying it by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD>.
de.translation: Du kannst nachladen, bevor dein Magazin leer ist, indem du <BINDING_RELOAD> drückst!

es.original: You can reload your clip before fully emptying it by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD>.
es.translation: No hace falta esperar a quedarte sin municiones para volver a llenar el cargador. Oprime <BINDING_RELOAD> para recargarlo cuando quieras.

pt.original: You can reload your clip before fully emptying it by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD>.
pt.translation: Você pode recarregar o seu pente antes de esvaziá-lo completamente pressionando <BINDING_RELOAD>.

fr.original: You can reload your clip before fully emptying it by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD>.
fr.translation: Rechargez votre chargeur avant qu'il ne soit vide en appuyant sur la touche <BINDING_RELOAD> !

ru.original: You can reload your clip before fully emptying it by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD>.
ru.translation: Перезарядку можно выполнить еще до полного опустошения обоймы, нажав кнопку перезарядки «<BINDING_RELOAD>».

tip_text.text: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

de.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
de.translation: Links unten im Spielfenster siehst du, wie viele Bausteine du hast. Grab für mehr Bausteine!

es.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

pt.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de Tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais Tijolos.

fr.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
fr.translation: Votre nombre total de briques est affiché en bas à gauche de l'écran. Creusez pour en récupérer davantage.

ru.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
ru.translation: Общее количество кирпичей указано в левом нижнем углу экрана. Копай, чтобы получить больше кирпичей.

tip_text.text: You can manually reload Nigel’s weapons without emptying its clip with <BINDING_RELOAD>.

de.original: You can manually reload Nigel’s weapons without emptying its clip with <BINDING_RELOAD>.
de.translation: Du kannst manuell nachladen, bevor Nigels Magazin leer ist (<BINDING_RELOAD>).

es.original: You can manually reload Nigel’s weapons without emptying its clip with <BINDING_RELOAD>.
es.translation: No hace falta esperar a quedarte sin municiones para volver a llenar el cargador. Oprime <BINDING_RELOAD> para recargarlo cuando quieras.

pt.original: You can manually reload Nigel’s weapons without emptying its clip with <BINDING_RELOAD>.
pt.translation: Você pode recarregar as armas de Nigel manualmente sem esvaziar seu pente com a tecla <BINDING_RELOAD>.

fr.original: You can manually reload Nigel’s weapons without emptying its clip with <BINDING_RELOAD>.
fr.translation: Vous pouvez recharger manuellement les armes de Nigel sans vider leurs chargeurs (<BINDING_RELOAD>).

ru.original: You can manually reload Nigel’s weapons without emptying its clip with <BINDING_RELOAD>.
ru.translation: Оружие Nigel можно перезарядить вручную и не опустошая обойму (<BINDING_RELOAD>).

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.

de.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_RECALL>, um in ungefähr 15 Sekunden wieder bei deiner Basis zu erscheinen. Sehr nützlich, wenn du in einer Zwickmühle steckst!

es.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
es.translation: Si oprimes <BINDING_RECALL> volverás al punto de partida de ese mapa luego de 15 segundos. Útil si te encuentras en una posición difícil.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
pt.translation: Pressione a tecla <BINDING_RECALL> no jogo para retornar à sua Base depois de cerca de 15 segundos. Útil se você estiver numa situação difícil.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_RECALL> en jeu pour retourner à votre base au bout de 15 secondes. Pratique si vous êtes en mauvaise posture.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
ru.translation: Нажми «<BINDING_RECALL>» в игре, чтобы вернуться на базу примерно через 15 секунд. Это удобно, когда оказываешься в сложной ситуации.

tip_text.text: O.P. can climb up walls by sprinting at them! He can get to places that other heroes can’t.

de.original: O.P. can climb up walls by sprinting at them! He can get to places that other heroes can’t.
de.translation: O.P. kann Wände hochklettern, indem er auf sie zusprintet! Er kann Gebiete erreichen, zu denen andere Helden nicht gelangen.

es.original: O.P. can climb up walls by sprinting at them! He can get to places that other heroes can’t.
es.translation: Juan puede escalar muros y llegar a lugares a los que los demás personajes no pueden acceder. Simplemente oprime la tecla de correr.

pt.original: O.P. can climb up walls by sprinting at them! He can get to places that other heroes can’t.
pt.translation: O.P. pode escalar paredes arrancando em direção a elas! Ele consegue alcançar lugares que outros heróis não conseguem.

fr.original: O.P. can climb up walls by sprinting at them! He can get to places that other heroes can’t.
fr.translation: O.P. peut escalader les murs en courant dessus, et atteindre ainsi des endroits inaccessibles aux autres héros.

ru.original: O.P. can climb up walls by sprinting at them! He can get to places that other heroes can’t.
ru.translation: O.P. может карабкаться на стены, забегая на них. Так он попадает в места, недоступные другим героям.

tip_text.text: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

de.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
de.translation: Deine Waffe kannst du mit <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> wechseln.

es.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> para cambiar de arma.

pt.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
pt.translation: Troque de armas com <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

fr.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
fr.translation: Changez d'arme en appuyant sur la touche <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

ru.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
ru.translation: Менять оружие можно при помощи «<BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>».

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.

de.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_DEVICEINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Block anzusehen.

es.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> para ver información detallada del bloque elegido.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> no jogo para ver informações sobre o bloco selecionado.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le bloc sélectionné.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном блоке.

tip_text.text: Press  <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.

de.original: Press  <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_HEROINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Helden anzusehen.

es.original: Press  <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_HEROINFO> para ver información detallada del personaje elegido.

pt.original: Press  <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_HEROINFO> no jogo para ver informações detalhadas sobre o herói selecionado.

fr.original: Press  <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_HEROINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le héros sélectionné.

ru.original: Press  <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_HEROINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном герое.

tip_text.text: Fake Blocks take the form of the block they’re closest to. Create traps for enemies to fall through!

de.original: Fake Blocks take the form of the block they’re closest to. Create traps for enemies to fall through!
de.translation: Blockattrappen nehmen das Aussehen benachbarter Blöcke an. Bau mit ihnen Fallen, in die deine Gegner stürzen!

es.original: Fake Blocks take the form of the block they’re closest to. Create traps for enemies to fall through!
es.translation: Los bloques falsos imitan la apariencia de los bloques que los rodean. Úsalos para hacer caer a los rivales en tus trampas.

pt.original: Fake Blocks take the form of the block they’re closest to. Create traps for enemies to fall through!
pt.translation: Blocos Falsos assumem a forma do bloco do qual estão mais próximos. Crie armadilhas para seus oponentes!

fr.original: Fake Blocks take the form of the block they’re closest to. Create traps for enemies to fall through!
fr.translation: Les blocs factices prennent l'apparence des blocs à proximité. Utilisez-les pour tendre des pièges à vos ennemis.

ru.original: Fake Blocks take the form of the block they’re closest to. Create traps for enemies to fall through!
ru.translation: Ложные блоки принимают внешний вид ближайшего к ним блока. Используй их, чтобы создавать ловушки для врагов.

tip_text.text: With each hit on an enemy they take bleed damage from the Katana helping to turn the fight in your favour.

de.original: With each hit on an enemy they take bleed damage from the Katana helping to turn the fight in your favour.
de.translation: Jeder Treffer des Katanas bringt deine Gegner zum Bluten, wodurch du den Kampf zu deinen Gunsten wenden kannst.

es.original: With each hit on an enemy they take bleed damage from the Katana helping to turn the fight in your favour.
es.translation: Usa la katana para atacar a tus enemigos de cerca.

pt.original: With each hit on an enemy they take bleed damage from the Katana helping to turn the fight in your favour.
pt.translation: Cada golpe da Katana em seus inimigos causa danos de sangramento, ajudando a virar a batalha a seu favor.

fr.original: With each hit on an enemy they take bleed damage from the Katana helping to turn the fight in your favour.
fr.translation: Faites saigner vos adversaires en les attaquant avec votre katana pour faire tourner la bataille en votre faveur.

ru.original: With each hit on an enemy they take bleed damage from the Katana helping to turn the fight in your favour.
ru.translation: Каждый успешный удар катаны наносит врагу урон от кровотечения, приближая твою победу в бою.

tip_text.text: The Katana’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> throws a smoke bomb and teleports you instantly to it. Use it to cross arenas with ease.

de.original: The Katana’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> throws a smoke bomb and teleports you instantly to it. Use it to cross arenas with ease.
de.translation: Der alternative Angriff des Katanas (<BINDING_CAST2>) löst eine Rauchbombe aus und teleportiert dich zum Aufschlagsort. Nutze ihn, um Arenen schnell zu durchqueren.

es.original: The Katana’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> throws a smoke bomb and teleports you instantly to it. Use it to cross arenas with ease.
es.translation: El ataque secundario de la katana (<BINDING_CAST2>) lanza una bomba de humo y te teletransporta a esa ubicación. Úsalo para cruzar el mapa con facilidad.

pt.original: The Katana’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> throws a smoke bomb and teleports you instantly to it. Use it to cross arenas with ease.
pt.translation: O tiro secundário da Katana (<BINDING_CAST2>) arremessa uma bomba de fumaça e teleporta você instantaneamente para ela. Use-o para atravessar arenas facilmente.

fr.original: The Katana’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> throws a smoke bomb and teleports you instantly to it. Use it to cross arenas with ease.
fr.translation: L'action secondaire du katana (<BINDING_CAST2>) vous permet de lancer une bombe fumigène qui vous téléportera instantanément au point d'impact. Pratique pour traverser l'arène rapidement.

ru.original: The Katana’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2> throws a smoke bomb and teleports you instantly to it. Use it to cross arenas with ease.
ru.translation: «Альтернативный огонь» катаны (<BINDING_CAST2>) позволяет бросить дымовую шашку и телепортироваться к ней. Используй его, чтобы с легкостью перемещаться по карте.

tip_text.text: Any enemies near a smoke bomb are “dizzied” giving you a great chance to inflict damage on them.

de.original: Any enemies near a smoke bomb are “dizzied” giving you a great chance to inflict damage on them.
de.translation: Alle Gegner in der Nähe einer Rauchbombe werden benommen, wodurch du ihnen leicht Schaden zufügen kannst.

es.original: Any enemies near a smoke bomb are “dizzied” giving you a great chance to inflict damage on them.
es.translation: Los enemigos que se acerquen a las bombas de humo sufrirán mareos. Aprovecha esa oportunidad para atacarlos.

pt.original: Any enemies near a smoke bomb are “dizzied” giving you a great chance to inflict damage on them.
pt.translation: Inimigos que estiverem perto de uma bomba de fumaça ficam "atordoados", dando a você uma ótima chance de causar dano neles.

fr.original: Any enemies near a smoke bomb are “dizzied” giving you a great chance to inflict damage on them.
fr.translation: Les ennemis touchés par une bombe fumigène seront étourdis, ce qui vous donnera l'occasion de leur infliger des dégâts.

ru.original: Any enemies near a smoke bomb are “dizzied” giving you a great chance to inflict damage on them.
ru.translation: Все враги, находящиеся рядом с дымовой шашкой, испытывают головокружение, что дает тебе отличный шанс нанести им урон.

tip_text.text: The Katana is the perfect weapon for up-close combat.

de.original: The Katana is the perfect weapon for up-close combat.
de.translation: Das Katana ist die perfekte Waffe für den Nahkampf.

es.original: The Katana is the perfect weapon for up-close combat.
es.translation: La katana es el arma perfecta para el combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

pt.original: The Katana is the perfect weapon for up-close combat.
pt.translation: A Katana é a arma perfeita para combate corpo a corpo.

fr.original: The Katana is the perfect weapon for up-close combat.
fr.translation: Le katana est l'arme idéale pour les combats rapprochés.

ru.original: The Katana is the perfect weapon for up-close combat.
ru.translation: Катана — превосходное оружие для ближнего боя.

tip_text.text: Try strafing around your enemies while you attack them with O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi's Katana.

ru.original: Try strafing around your enemies while you attack them with O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi's Katana.
ru.translation: Когда O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi использует меч, попробуй сместиться влево или вправо.

es.original: Try strafing around your enemies while you attack them with O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi's Katana.
es.translation: Cuando ataques a tus enemigos con la katana de Juan, rodéalos sin dejar de moverte.

de.original: Try strafing around your enemies while you attack them with O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi's Katana.
de.translation: Bleib in Bewegung, während du deine Gegner mit O.P. 'Juan' Shinobis Katana angreifst.

pt.original: Try strafing around your enemies while you attack them with O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi's Katana.
pt.translation: Tente rodear seus inimigos enquanto os ataca com a katana de O.P. "Juan" Shinobi.

fr.original: Try strafing around your enemies while you attack them with O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi's Katana.
fr.translation: Essayez de vous déplacer furtivement autour de vos ennemis lorsque vous voulez les attaquer avec le katana d'O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi.

tip_text.text: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

de.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
de.translation: Links unten im Spielfenster siehst du, wie viele Bausteine du hast. Grab für mehr Bausteine!

es.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

pt.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de Tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais Tijolos.

fr.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
fr.translation: Votre nombre total de briques est affiché en bas à gauche de l'écran. Creusez pour en récupérer davantage.

ru.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
ru.translation: Общее количество кирпичей указано в левом нижнем углу экрана. Копай, чтобы получить больше кирпичей.

tip_text.text: O.P.’s Ninja Stars inflict bleed damage with each hit

de.original: O.P.’s Ninja Stars inflict bleed damage with each hit
de.translation: Die Ninja-Sterne von O.P. bringen deine Gegner mit jedem Treffer zum Bluten.

es.original: O.P.’s Ninja Stars inflict bleed damage with each hit
es.translation: Las estrellas ninja causan daño con cada impacto.

pt.original: O.P.’s Ninja Stars inflict bleed damage with each hit
pt.translation: As Estrelas Ninja de O.P causam danos de sangramento a cada acerto.

fr.original: O.P.’s Ninja Stars inflict bleed damage with each hit
fr.translation: Chaque attaque de shurikens réussie fera saigner votre cible.

ru.original: O.P.’s Ninja Stars inflict bleed damage with each hit
ru.translation: Сюрикен O.P. наносит урон, вызывая кровотечение.

tip_text.text: Place a Ninja Shrine by pressing <BINDING_DEVICE1> and holding <BINDING_CAST2>.

de.original: Place a Ninja Shrine by pressing <BINDING_DEVICE1> and holding <BINDING_CAST2>.
de.translation: Wähl den Ninja-Schrein mit <BINDING_DEVICE1> aus und nutze zum Bauen die <BINDING_Cast2>.

es.original: Place a Ninja Shrine by pressing <BINDING_DEVICE1> and holding <BINDING_CAST2>.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_DEVICE1> y luego mantén presionado <BINDING_CAST2> para construir un torii.

pt.original: Place a Ninja Shrine by pressing <BINDING_DEVICE1> and holding <BINDING_CAST2>.
pt.translation: Construa um Santuário Ninja pressionando a tecla <BINDING_DEVICE1> e segurando <BINDING_CAST2>.

fr.original: Place a Ninja Shrine by pressing <BINDING_DEVICE1> and holding <BINDING_CAST2>.
fr.translation: Placez un temple ninja en appuyant sur la touche <BINDING_DEVICE1> et en maintenant le <BINDING_CAST2> enfoncé.

ru.original: Place a Ninja Shrine by pressing <BINDING_DEVICE1> and holding <BINDING_CAST2>.
ru.translation: Размести святыню ниндзя, нажав «<BINDING_DEVICE1>» и удерживая «<BINDING_CAST2>».

tip_text.text: When O.P. uses his Active Ability by pressing <BINDING_USEABILITY>, he will teleport to the Shrine, gaining some health and ammo.

de.original: When O.P. uses his Active Ability by pressing <BINDING_USEABILITY>, he will teleport to the Shrine, gaining some health and ammo.
de.translation: Wenn O.P. seine aktive Fähigkeit benutzt (<BINDING_USEABILITY>), wird er zu seinem Schrein teleportiert und erhält etwas Gesundheit und Munition.

es.original: When O.P. uses his Active Ability by pressing <BINDING_USEABILITY>, he will teleport to the Shrine, gaining some health and ammo.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_USEABILITY> para usar la destreza activa «Desaparecer» de Juan. Te teletransportarás al torii y aumentará su salud y sus municiones.

pt.original: When O.P. uses his Active Ability by pressing <BINDING_USEABILITY>, he will teleport to the Shrine, gaining some health and ammo.
pt.translation: Quando O.P. usa sua habilidade ativa pressionando a tecla <BINDING_USEABILITY>, ele se teleporta para o Santuário, ganhando pontos de vida e munição no processo.

fr.original: When O.P. uses his Active Ability by pressing <BINDING_USEABILITY>, he will teleport to the Shrine, gaining some health and ammo.
fr.translation: Lorsque O.P. utilise sa capacité active (touche <BINDING_USEABILITY>), il se téléporte jusqu'à son temple, récupérant ainsi des points de vie et des munitions.

ru.original: When O.P. uses his Active Ability by pressing <BINDING_USEABILITY>, he will teleport to the Shrine, gaining some health and ammo.
ru.translation: Когда O.P. применяет свою активную способность (<BINDING_USEABILITY>), он телепортируется к святыне, получая при этом здоровье и боеприпасы.

tip_text.text: After pressing <BINDING_Cast2> while your Katana is equipped, don’t forget to reload by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD> so you can throw another!

de.original: After pressing <BINDING_Cast2> while your Katana is equipped, don’t forget to reload by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD> so you can throw another!
de.translation: Nachdem du die <BINDING_Cast2> mit ausgerüstetem Katana gedrückt hast, vergiss nicht, mit <BINDING_RELOAD> nachzuladen, damit du mehr werfen kannst.

es.original: After pressing <BINDING_Cast2> while your Katana is equipped, don’t forget to reload by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD> so you can throw another!
es.translation: Luego de ejecutar el ataque secundario de la katana (<BINDING_CAST2>), no olvides recargarlo (<BINDING_RELOAD>) para poder lanzar otra bomba.

pt.original: After pressing <BINDING_Cast2> while your Katana is equipped, don’t forget to reload by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD> so you can throw another!
pt.translation: Depois que pressionar a tecla <BINDING_Cast2> com a Katana equipada, não esqueça de recarregar pressionando <BINDING_RELOAD> para que você possa jogar outra!

fr.original: After pressing <BINDING_Cast2> while your Katana is equipped, don’t forget to reload by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD> so you can throw another!
fr.translation: Après avoir appuyé sur le <BINDING_Cast2> pour activer l'action secondaire de votre katana, n'oubliez pas de le recharger (<BINDING_RELOAD>) pour lancer une autre bombe !

ru.original: After pressing <BINDING_Cast2> while your Katana is equipped, don’t forget to reload by pressing <BINDING_RELOAD> so you can throw another!
ru.translation: Нажав «<BINDING_Cast2>» при использовании катаны, не забудь перезарядиться при помощи кнопки «<BINDING_RELOAD>», чтобы иметь возможность повторить бросок.

tip_text.text: Tony’s Active Ability <BINDING_USEABILITY> allows him and any nearby teammates to build more quickly for a short time.

de.original: Tony’s Active Ability <BINDING_USEABILITY> allows him and any nearby teammates to build more quickly for a short time.

de.translation: Links unten im Spielfenster siehst du, wie viele Bausteine du hast. Grab für mehr Bausteine!
