ru.translation: Общее количество кирпичей указано в левом нижнем углу экрана. Копай, чтобы получить больше кирпичей.

pt.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de Tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais Tijolos.

tip_text.text: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.

de.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
de.translation: Roly Polys TankBall-Kanonen verfügen über eine gute Reichweite und Genauigkeit. Nutze sie für beständige Angriffe auf deine Gegner.

pt.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
pt.translation: Os canhões da TanqueBola de Roly Poly oferecem bom alcance e precisão. Use-os para atirar continuamente no inimigo.

fr.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
fr.translation: Les lance-missiles de la Rolymobile ont une portée et une précision redoutables, ce qui est idéal pour faire pleuvoir un feu nourri sur vos ennemis.

es.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
es.translation: Los cañones tienen largo alcance y gran precisión. Úsalos para dispararles a tus rivales de manera continua.

ru.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
ru.translation: У Roly Poly есть отличные танковые пушки — они очень точные, далеко стреляют и словно созданы, чтобы поливать врага огнем.

tip_text.text: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.

de.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
de.translation: Halte die <BINDING_Cast2> gedrückt, um mit dem alternativen Angriff von Roly Polys TankBall ein Paar hochexplosive Patronen abzuschießen.

pt.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
pt.translation: Use o tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) para lançar um par de projéteis altamente explosíveis dos canhões da TanqueBola de Roly Poly.

fr.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
fr.translation: Utilisez l'action secondaire (<BINDING_Cast2>) pour catapulter deux obus surpuissants grâce aux lance-missiles de la Rolymobile.

es.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_Cast2> para efectuar el ataque secundario de los cañones. Su gran potencia los hace ideales para destruir fortines y defensas.

ru.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
ru.translation: Зажми <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь), из пушек Roly Poly вылетит два очень мощных снаряда.

tip_text.text: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.

de.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
de.translation: Durch die Booster-Raketen erhält Roly Poly ein bisschen mehr Mobilität. Nutze sie für einen Sturmangriff.

pt.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
pt.translation: Os Foguetes Propulsores dão a Roly Poly um pouco mais de mobilidade. Use-os para dar um curto ataque de propulsão.

fr.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
fr.translation: Grâce à son Roquettoboost, Roly Poly peut se déplacer plus rapidement. Utilisez-le pour foncer sur vos adversaires.

es.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
es.translation: Los propulsores aumentan la velocidad de desplazamiento durante un breve instante.

ru.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
ru.translation: Когда Roly Poly стреляет реактивными ракетами, сила тяги толкает ее вперед, и она может сделать небольшой рывок в сторону врага.

tip_text.text: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.

de.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
de.translation: Drück die <BINDING_Cast2>, um mit dem alternativen Angriff von Roly Poly Fat Fats Booster-Raketen giftiges Gas zu hinterlassen. Nutze es, um deine Gegner aufzuhalten oder einen Rückzug anzutreten.

pt.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
pt.translation: Crie poças de gosma tóxica atrás de Roly Poly Fat Fat usando o tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) com os foguetes propulsores.

fr.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
fr.translation: Laissez des flaques de boue toxique derrière Roly Poly Fat Fat grâce à l'action secondaire (<BINDING_Cast2>) de son Roquettoboost. Cela vous permettra de bloquer l'accès à une zone à vos ennemis, ou de vous aider à vous échapper.

es.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_Cast2> para activar el ataque secundario de los propulsores y crear charcos de líquido tóxico pegajoso, ideales para ayudarte a huir o para anegar una zona.

ru.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
ru.translation: Если хочешь создать позади Roly Poly Fat Fat лужи с пузырящейся ядовитой слизью, нажми <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь), когда выпустишь реактивные ракеты. Используй, чтобы не отдать область врагу или осуществить побег.

tip_text.text: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.

de.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.
de.translation: Roly Polys TankBall-Rüstung schützt sie vor kritischen Treffern. Nutze sie, um so viel Schaden abzuwehren wie möglich.

pt.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.
pt.translation: A Blindagem da TanqueBola de Roly Poly evita que ela seja atingida por acertos críticos. Use-a para absorver o maior dano possível.

fr.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.
fr.translation: Grâce à sa capacité Rolymobile blindée, Roly Poly est protégée des coups critiques. Utilisez-la pour absorber le plus de dégâts possible.

es.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.
es.translation: Al usar Armadura tendrás inmunidad ante los golpes críticos. Úsala para absorber todo el daño posible.

ru.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.
ru.translation: Танковая броня Roly Poly — гарантия защиты от критических ударов. Поможет свести урон к минимуму.

tip_text.text: Emplacement Mode shifts power to Roly Poly’s defensive systems, making her more resistant to damage but disabling movement for a short duration.

de.original: Emplacement Mode shifts power to Roly Poly’s defensive systems, making her more resistant to damage but disabling movement for a short duration.
de.translation: Der Stellungsmodus lenkt Energie in das Defensivsystem von Roly Poly Fat Fat, wodurch sie für kurze Zeit weniger Schaden erleidet, sich jedoch auch nicht bewegen kann.

pt.original: Emplacement Mode shifts power to Roly Poly’s defensive systems, making her more resistant to damage but disabling movement for a short duration.
pt.translation: O Modo Plataforma transfere a energia elétrica para os sistemas defensivos de Roly Poly, tornando-a mais resistente a danos, mas desativando os movimentos normais por um curto período.

fr.original: Emplacement Mode shifts power to Roly Poly’s defensive systems, making her more resistant to damage but disabling movement for a short duration.
fr.translation: Mise en batterie active les systèmes défensifs de Roly Poly, ce qui lui permet de résister aux dégâts, mais l'empêche de se déplacer pendant quelques secondes.

es.original: Emplacement Mode shifts power to Roly Poly’s defensive systems, making her more resistant to damage but disabling movement for a short duration.
es.translation: Al usar Cortina protectora se activa el sistema defensivo de la bola y mientras dure su efecto será resistente al daño pero no podrá moverse.

ru.original: Emplacement Mode shifts power to Roly Poly’s defensive systems, making her more resistant to damage but disabling movement for a short duration.
ru.translation: В режиме агрессивной защиты Roly Poly становится неуязвимой, но ненадолго теряет способность передвигаться.

tip_text.text: You can cancel Emplacement Mode while it’s in use by pressing the active ability button again.

de.original: You can cancel Emplacement Mode while it’s in use by pressing the active ability button again.
de.translation: Du kannst den Stellungsmodus deaktivieren, indem du die Taste für die aktive Fähigkeit erneut benutzt.

pt.original: You can cancel Emplacement Mode while it’s in use by pressing the active ability button again.
pt.translation: Você pode cancelar o Modo Plataforma quando ele estiver em uso pressionando novamente o botão da habilidade ativa.

fr.original: You can cancel Emplacement Mode while it’s in use by pressing the active ability button again.
fr.translation: Pour désactiver Mise en batterie, appuyez sur la touche de votre clavier associée à votre capacité active.

es.original: You can cancel Emplacement Mode while it’s in use by pressing the active ability button again.
es.translation: Para cancelar Cortina protectora, vuelve a oprimir el botón de destreza activa.

ru.original: You can cancel Emplacement Mode while it’s in use by pressing the active ability button again.
ru.translation: Чтобы отключить режим, просто снова задействуй свою активную способность.

tip_text.text: Roly Poly’s Hero Block, Toxic Waste, is dangerously unstable. Place them in areas where you can destroy them to deal explosion damage.

de.original: Roly Poly’s Hero Block, Toxic Waste, is dangerously unstable. Place them in areas where you can destroy them to deal explosion damage.
de.translation: Roly Polys Heldenblock, Giftmüll, ist gefährlich instabil. Platzier ihn in Gegenden, wo du ihn zum Explodieren bringen kannst, um ordentlich Schaden anzurichten.

pt.original: Roly Poly’s Hero Block, Toxic Waste, is dangerously unstable. Place them in areas where you can destroy them to deal explosion damage.
pt.translation: O bloco de herói de Roly Poly, Lixo Tóxico, é perigosamente instável. Coloque-o em áreas onde você possa destruí-lo para causar danos explosivos.

fr.original: Roly Poly’s Hero Block, Toxic Waste, is dangerously unstable. Place them in areas where you can destroy them to deal explosion damage.
fr.translation: Le bloc spécial de Roly Poly, Déchets toxiques, est dangereusement instable. Placez vos blocs dans des zones où vous pouvez les détruire pour infliger des dégâts d'explosion.

es.original: Roly Poly’s Hero Block, Toxic Waste, is dangerously unstable. Place them in areas where you can destroy them to deal explosion damage.
es.translation: El barril de Residuos tóxicos explota al ser destruido. Colócalo en zonas donde sea fácil de romper y así causar daño explosivo.

ru.original: Roly Poly’s Hero Block, Toxic Waste, is dangerously unstable. Place them in areas where you can destroy them to deal explosion damage.
ru.translation: У Roly Poly есть особый блок — бочка с взрывоопасными ядовитыми отходами. Ставь бочки там, где много врагов, а затем взрывай, когда они приблизятся к ним.

tip_text.text: Toxic Waste can also be used to leave behind pools of poisonous chemicals upon being destroyed. Use it to help cover an area.

de.original: Toxic Waste can also be used to leave behind pools of poisonous chemicals upon being destroyed. Use it to help cover an area.
de.translation: Giftmüll kann auch eingesetzt werden, um giftige Chemikalien zu hinterlassen, wenn er zerstört wird. Nutze ihn um ganze Bereiche abzudecken.

pt.original: Toxic Waste can also be used to leave behind pools of poisonous chemicals upon being destroyed. Use it to help cover an area.
pt.translation: O Lixo Tóxico também pode ser usado para liberar uma poça de gosma venenosa com a explosão. Faça isso para ajudar a cobrir uma área.

fr.original: Toxic Waste can also be used to leave behind pools of poisonous chemicals upon being destroyed. Use it to help cover an area.
fr.translation: Lorsqu'il est détruit, le bloc Déchets toxiques dégage également un nuage de vapeurs chimiques empoisonnées. Utilisez-le pour couvrir une zone.

es.original: Toxic Waste can also be used to leave behind pools of poisonous chemicals upon being destroyed. Use it to help cover an area.
es.translation: El barril de Residuos tóxicos también emite líquidos venenosos tras ser destruido. Úsalo para darle refuerzos a tus compañeros y cubrir una zona.

ru.original: Toxic Waste can also be used to leave behind pools of poisonous chemicals upon being destroyed. Use it to help cover an area.
ru.translation: При взрыве образуются лужи ядовитых химикатов. Отличное прикрытие, когда нужно быстро отступить.

tip_text.text: Radars provide your whole team with vision of enemy players and blocks within their range. Build lots of them to support your team on attack and defense!

de.original: Radars provide your whole team with vision of enemy players and blocks within their range. Build lots of them to support your team on attack and defense!
de.translation: Radare decken für dein ganzes Team nahe Gegner und ihre Blöcke auf. Bau viele davon und unterstütze so dein Team beim Angriff und der Verteidigung.

pt.original: Radars provide your whole team with vision of enemy players and blocks within their range. Build lots of them to support your team on attack and defense!
pt.translation: Radares proporcionam a toda a sua equipe uma visão dos jogadores e blocos inimigos que estiverem ao alcance. Construa diversos deles para dar suporte a sua equipe tanto para ataque quanto para defesa!

fr.original: Radars provide your whole team with vision of enemy players and blocks within their range. Build lots of them to support your team on attack and defense!
fr.translation: Les radars permettent à vos coéquipiers de repérer les héros et blocs ennemis à proximité. Placez-en plusieurs pour soutenir votre équipe en attaque comme en défense !

es.original: Radars provide your whole team with vision of enemy players and blocks within their range. Build lots of them to support your team on attack and defense!
es.translation: Los radares le permiten a tu equipo saber dónde están los personajes y bloques enemigos dentro de su radio de alcance. Colócalos en todos lados, ya que son una buena estrategia tanto defensiva como ofensiva.

ru.original: Radars provide your whole team with vision of enemy players and blocks within their range. Build lots of them to support your team on attack and defense!
ru.translation: Радары помогут твоему отряду засекать врага и определять местоположение блоков, если они будут в радиусе действия радара. Строй радары: они очень пригодятся как в атаке, так и в обороне.

tip_text.text: Respawn Pads provide a forward operating base but at a high cost, place them well.

de.translation: Respawnfelder ermöglichen dir ein schnelles Vorrücken, sind jedoch teuer. Platzier sie gut!

pt.translation: Pontos de Ressurgimento servem de base operacional de dianteira, mas com um custo alto. Posicione-os com sabedoria.

es.original: Respawn Pads provide a forward operating base but at a high cost, place them well.
es.translation: Los bloques de reaparición te permiten comenzar en una posición de avanzada pero cuestan bastante.

ru.original: Respawn Pads provide a forward operating base but at a high cost, place them well.
ru.translation: Платформы возрождения хороши для создания передовой базы, но дорого стоят. Размещай их с умом.

de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_HEROINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Helden anzusehen.

fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_HEROINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le héros sélectionné.

pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_HEROINFO> no jogo para ver informações detalhadas sobre o herói selecionado.

de.original: Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves primary attack <BINDING_Cast1> fires his Boxing Gloves at range. Use them to attack enemies from distance.
de.translation: Der Hauptangriff der Erstrecko-Handschuhe (<BINDING_Cast1>) schleudert Boxhandschuhe nach vorne. Nutze sie, um Gegner aus der Ferne anzugreifen.

fr.original: Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves primary attack <BINDING_Cast1> fires his Boxing Gloves at range. Use them to attack enemies from distance.
fr.translation: Propulsez les gants à ressort de Kreepy pour une attaque puissante à distance en utilisant leur action principale (<BINDING_Cast1>). Parfait pour attaquer les ennemis de loin.

pt.original: Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves primary attack <BINDING_Cast1> fires his Boxing Gloves at range. Use them to attack enemies from distance.
pt.translation: O ataque primário das Luvas Extendo de Kreepy (<BINDING_Cast1>) dispara luvas de boxe à distância. Use-o para atacar os inimigos de longe.

es.translation: <BINDING_CAST1> para atacar a distancia. Kreepy lanzará un puñetazo con sus brazos extensibles y golpeará a los enemigos que estén lejos.

ru.original: Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves primary attack <BINDING_Cast1> fires his Boxing Gloves at range. Use them to attack enemies from distance.
ru.translation: Основная атака (<BINDING_Cast1>) удлиняющих перчаток Kreepy позволяет выстрелить боксерскими перчатками. Используйте их для поражения врагов на расстоянии.

tip_text.text: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves turns him into a wind-milling attacking Klown. Use it up close against your enemies.

de.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves turns him into a wind-milling attacking Klown. Use it up close against your enemies.
de.translation: Der alternative Angriff von Kreepys Erstrecko-Handschuhen (<BINDING_Cast2>) verwandelt ihn in einen um sich schlagenden Wirbelwind. Nutze ihn, wenn dir deine Gegner zu nahe rücken!

fr.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves turns him into a wind-milling attacking Klown. Use it up close against your enemies.
fr.translation: Leur action secondaire (<BINDING_Cast2>) déclenche un tourbillon de coups de poing. Utilisez cette attaque en combat rapproché.

pt.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves turns him into a wind-milling attacking Klown. Use it up close against your enemies.
pt.translation: O tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) das Luvas Extendo de Kreepy desferem golpes giratórios. Use-o quando estiver perto dos inimigos.

es.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves turns him into a wind-milling attacking Klown. Use it up close against your enemies.
es.translation: <BINDING_CAST2> para atacar de cerca. Kreepy comenzará a girar como un trompo y le dará puñetazos a los enemigos que estén cerca.

ru.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of Kreepy’s Extendo Gloves turns him into a wind-milling attacking Klown. Use it up close against your enemies.
ru.translation: Альтернативная атака (<BINDING_Cast2>) удлиняющих перчаток Kreepy превращает его в настоящую боевую мельницу. Используйте ее в ближнем бою.

tip_text.text: The Trick Bananas can be thrown across Arenas. Find a spot and throw it on to your enemies.

de.original: The Trick Bananas can be thrown across Arenas. Find a spot and throw it on to your enemies.
de.translation: Die Scherzbananen können durch die Arena geworfen werden. Finde eine gute Stelle und wirf sie auf deine Gegner!

fr.original: The Trick Bananas can be thrown across Arenas. Find a spot and throw it on to your enemies.
fr.translation: Vous pouvez lancer vos bananes farceuses à travers l'arène. Choisissez bien votre position, et balancez-en sur vos ennemis.

pt.original: The Trick Bananas can be thrown across Arenas. Find a spot and throw it on to your enemies.
pt.translation: As Bananas Traiçoeiras podem ser jogadas pela arena. Encontre o lugar adequado e as jogue nos inimigos.

es.original: The Trick Bananas can be thrown across Arenas. Find a spot and throw it on to your enemies.
es.translation: Arroja las bananas explosivas a tus enemigos.

ru.original: The Trick Bananas can be thrown across Arenas. Find a spot and throw it on to your enemies.
ru.translation: Безумные бананы можно бросать на большое расстояние. Найдите удобное место, чтобы бросать их во врагов.

tip_text.text: Trick Bananas alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> can cause enemies to slip as well as take damage. Hide them well to surprise them.

de.original: Trick Bananas alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> can cause enemies to slip as well as take damage. Hide them well to surprise them.
de.translation: Der alternative Angriff der Scherzbananen (<BINDING_Cast2>) kann Gegner zum Ausrutschen bringen und sie beschädigen.

fr.original: Trick Bananas alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> can cause enemies to slip as well as take damage. Hide them well to surprise them.
fr.translation: L'action secondaire des bananes farceuses (<BINDING_Cast2>) fait déraper vos ennemis et leur inflige des dégâts. Cachez-les soigneusement pour prendre vos adversaires par surprise !

pt.original: Trick Bananas alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> can cause enemies to slip as well as take damage. Hide them well to surprise them.
pt.translation: O tiro secundário das Bananas Traiçoeiras (<BINDING_Cast2>) podem fazer os inimigos escorregar e sofrer danos. Esconda-as bem para surpreendê-los.

es.original: Trick Bananas alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> can cause enemies to slip as well as take damage. Hide them well to surprise them.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_Cast2> para lanzar el ataque secundario de las bananas. Los enemigos que las pisen se resbalarán, así que escóndelas en lugares estratégicos.

ru.original: Trick Bananas alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> can cause enemies to slip as well as take damage. Hide them well to surprise them.
ru.translation: Альтернативная атака (<BINDING_Cast2>) безумных бананов заставляет врагов поскользнуться и получить урон. Спрячьте их как следует, чтобы удивить врагов.

tip_text.text: With the power of his Klown Shoes Passive Ability, Kreepy takes less fall damage than other heroes.

de.original: With the power of his Klown Shoes Passive Ability, Kreepy takes less fall damage than other heroes.
de.translation: Durch die passive Fähigkeit der Clownschuhe erleidet Kreepy weniger Fallschaden als andere Helden.

fr.original: With the power of his Klown Shoes Passive Ability, Kreepy takes less fall damage than other heroes.
fr.translation: Grâce à sa puissante capacité passive Chaussures de clown, Kreepy subit moins de dégâts que les autres héros en cas de chute.

pt.original: With the power of his Klown Shoes Passive Ability, Kreepy takes less fall damage than other heroes.
pt.translation: Com o poder da sua habilidade passiva Sapatos de Palhaço, Kreepy sofre menos danos de queda que os outros heróis.

es.original: With the power of his Klown Shoes Passive Ability, Kreepy takes less fall damage than other heroes.
es.translation: Gracias a su destreza pasiva "Zapatos muy grandes", Kreepy sufre menos daño ante caídas que los demás personajes.

ru.original: With the power of his Klown Shoes Passive Ability, Kreepy takes less fall damage than other heroes.
ru.translation: Пассивная способность «Обувь клоуна» позволяет Kreepy получать меньше урона при падении, чем другие герои.

tip_text.text: Jump higher! Klown Shoes, Kreepy’s Passive Ability, allows him to jump higher than many other heroes.

de.original: Jump higher! Klown Shoes, Kreepy’s Passive Ability, allows him to jump higher than many other heroes.
de.translation: Spring hoch hinaus! Durch die Clownschuhe, Kreepys passive Fähigkeit, kann er höher springen als die meisten anderen Helden.

fr.original: Jump higher! Klown Shoes, Kreepy’s Passive Ability, allows him to jump higher than many other heroes.
fr.translation: L'important, c'est de sauter ! Grâce à sa capacité passive Chaussures de clown, Kreepy peut sauter plus haut que la plupart des héros.

pt.original: Jump higher! Klown Shoes, Kreepy’s Passive Ability, allows him to jump higher than many other heroes.
pt.translation: Pule mais alto! Sapatos de Palhaço, a habilidade passiva de Kreepy, permite que ele pule mais alto que muitos outros heróis.

es.original: Jump higher! Klown Shoes, Kreepy’s Passive Ability, allows him to jump higher than many other heroes.
es.translation: Su destreza activa le permite a Kreepy saltar más alto que los demás personajes.

ru.original: Jump higher! Klown Shoes, Kreepy’s Passive Ability, allows him to jump higher than many other heroes.
ru.translation: Прыгайте выше! Пассивная способность «Обувь клоуна» позволяет Kreepy прыгать выше многих других героев.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to activate Killer Klown and unleash a terrifying psychic attack on all nearby enemies.

de.original: Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to activate Killer Klown and unleash a terrifying psychic attack on all nearby enemies.
de.translation: Drück '<BINDING_USEABILITY>', um Killerclown zu aktivieren und eine fürchterliche Psychoattacke auf alle nahen Gegner loszulassen.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to activate Killer Klown and unleash a terrifying psychic attack on all nearby enemies.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_USEABILITY> pour déclencher sa capacité active Clown tueur et faire déferler un vent de terreur sur tous vos ennemis à proximité.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to activate Killer Klown and unleash a terrifying psychic attack on all nearby enemies.
pt.translation: Pressione (<BINDING_USEABILITY>) para ativar Palhaçada Apavorante e infligir um ataque psíquico aterrorizante em todos os inimigos próximos.

es.original: Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to activate Killer Klown and unleash a terrifying psychic attack on all nearby enemies.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_USEABILITY> para activar Broma malévola y atacar a los enemigos cercanos.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to activate Killer Klown and unleash a terrifying psychic attack on all nearby enemies.
ru.translation: Нажмите <BINDING_USEABILITY>, чтобы активировать «Убийцу клоуна» и испугать всех окружающих врагов безумной атакой.

tip_text.text: Any enemies who pass near the Kreepy in the Box Hero Block will be hit by Klown Gloves which deal damage and knock them back.

de.original: Any enemies who pass near the Kreepy in the Box Hero Block will be hit by Klown Gloves which deal damage and knock them back.
de.translation: Gegner, die an der Kreepy-Geschenkbox vorbeilaufen, werden von Clownhandschuhen angegriffen, die Schaden auslösen und sie zurückwerfen.

fr.original: Any enemies who pass near the Kreepy in the Box Hero Block will be hit by Klown Gloves which deal damage and knock them back.
fr.translation: Dès qu'un ennemi passe à proximité, le bloc spécial Kreepy en boîte se déclenche et des gants à ressort en jaillissent, infligeant des dégâts au malheureux et le projetant en arrière.

pt.original: Any enemies who pass near the Kreepy in the Box Hero Block will be hit by Klown Gloves which deal damage and knock them back.
pt.translation: Qualquer inimigo que passar por perto do bloco Caixa de Kreepy será atingido pelas Luvas de Palhaço, que causam dano e empurram o inimigo para trás.

es.original: Any enemies who pass near the Kreepy in the Box Hero Block will be hit by Klown Gloves which deal damage and knock them back.
es.translation: Cuando un enemigo se acerca, la caja se abre y un guante sale y lo golpea.

ru.original: Any enemies who pass near the Kreepy in the Box Hero Block will be hit by Klown Gloves which deal damage and knock them back.
ru.translation: Враги, оказавшиеся рядом с особым блоком «Kreepy в коробке», получат удар клоунскими перчатками, которые наносят урон и отбрасывают противников.

tip_text.text: Each Kreepy in the Box Hero Block can only attack one victim before it falls apart and has to be replaced.

de.original: Each Kreepy in the Box Hero Block can only attack one victim before it falls apart and has to be replaced.
de.translation: Jede Kreepy-Geschenkbox kann nur einen Gegner angreifen, bevor sie ersetzt werden muss.

fr.original: Each Kreepy in the Box Hero Block can only attack one victim before it falls apart and has to be replaced.
fr.translation: Un bloc Kreepy en boîte ne peut attaquer qu'une seule victime : ensuite, il tombera en miettes et devra être remplacé.

pt.original: Each Kreepy in the Box Hero Block can only attack one victim before it falls apart and has to be replaced.
pt.translation: Cada Caixa de Kreepy só pode atacar uma vítima antes de se desintegrar e ter que ser substituída.

es.original: Each Kreepy in the Box Hero Block can only attack one victim before it falls apart and has to be replaced.
es.translation: Cada caja puede atacar a una sola víctima antes de consumirse.

ru.original: Each Kreepy in the Box Hero Block can only attack one victim before it falls apart and has to be replaced.
ru.translation: Каждый особый блок «Kreepy в коробке» может атаковать только одну жертву, после чего разваливается на части, и его нужно заменить.

tip_text.text: Place Kreepy in the Box Hero Blocks in small holes to surprise any enemies that are rushing forwards.

de.original: Place Kreepy in the Box Hero Blocks in small holes to surprise any enemies that are rushing forwards.
de.translation: Platzier Kreepy-Geschenkboxen in kleinen Löchern, um vorbeilaufenden Gegnern eine böse Überraschung zu hinterlassen.

fr.original: Place Kreepy in the Box Hero Blocks in small holes to surprise any enemies that are rushing forwards.
fr.translation: Creusez un trou, puis placez-y vos blocs Kreepy en boîte pour prendre vos ennemis par surprise.

pt.original: Place Kreepy in the Box Hero Blocks in small holes to surprise any enemies that are rushing forwards.
pt.translation: Coloque Caixas de Kreepy em pequenos buracos para surpreender uma ofensiva inimiga.

es.original: Place Kreepy in the Box Hero Blocks in small holes to surprise any enemies that are rushing forwards.
es.translation: Coloca Caja de sorpresas en pequeños huecos para sorprender a los enemigos que pasen corriendo.

ru.original: Place Kreepy in the Box Hero Blocks in small holes to surprise any enemies that are rushing forwards.
ru.translation: Размещайте особые блоки «Kreepy в коробке» в незаметных местах, чтобы застать несущихся вперед врагов врасплох.

es.translation: Las cajas de municiones recargan las armas de tus aliados. Escóndelas para que tus rivales no las destruyan.

es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

fr.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_USEABILITY> para ejecutar la destreza activa de Trondson «¡Hey, ho!». Úsala cerca de tus aliados cuando estén cavando para ayudarlos.

fr.original: Trondson's "Heigh-Ho!" Active Ability can be triggered with the <BINDING_USEABILITY> key. Use it near your allies when they're digging to help them out.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_USEABILITY> pour activer la capacité active Appel de la mine de Trondson. Déclenchez-la à proximité de vos alliés lorsqu'ils sont en train de creuser afin de les aider.

pt.original: Trondson's "Heigh-Ho!" Active Ability can be triggered with the <BINDING_USEABILITY> key. Use it near your allies when they're digging to help them out.
pt.translation: A habilidade ativa Escavando e Cantando de Trondson pode ser acionada com a tecla <BINDING_USEABILITY>. Use-a perto dos aliados quando estiverem escavando para ajudá-los.

de.original: Trondson's "Heigh-Ho!" Active Ability can be triggered with the <BINDING_USEABILITY> key. Use it near your allies when they're digging to help them out.

ru.original: Trondson's "Heigh-Ho!" Active Ability can be triggered with the <BINDING_USEABILITY> key. Use it near your allies when they're digging to help them out.

es.translation: El bloque «Torpedo excavador» puede usarse para cavar túneles y también dañará los dispositivos enemigos que encuentre en su camino.

fr.translation: Le bloc spécial Torpille lourde permet de creuser rapidement de petits tunnels, et inflige des dégâts aux dispositifs ennemis sur son chemin.

pt.original: The Tunnelling Torpedo Hero Block can be used to quickly dig small tunnels, and will even damage enemy Devices that it runs in to.

de.original: The Tunnelling Torpedo Hero Block can be used to quickly dig small tunnels, and will even damage enemy Devices that it runs in to.

ru.original: The Tunnelling Torpedo Hero Block can be used to quickly dig small tunnels, and will even damage enemy Devices that it runs in to.

tip_text.text: The "Tunnel Rat" passive ability makes Trondson the fastest moving hero while crouching.

es.original: The "Tunnel Rat" passive ability makes Trondson the fastest moving hero while crouching.

fr.original: The "Tunnel Rat" passive ability makes Trondson the fastest moving hero while crouching.

pt.original: The "Tunnel Rat" passive ability makes Trondson the fastest moving hero while crouching.
pt.translation: A habilidade passiva Rato de Túnel torna o Trondson o herói mais rápido enquanto agachado.

de.original: The "Tunnel Rat" passive ability makes Trondson the fastest moving hero while crouching.
de.translation: Durch die passive Fähigkeit 'Tunnelratte' ist Trondson beim Ducken der schnellste der Helden.

ru.original: The "Tunnel Rat" passive ability makes Trondson the fastest moving hero while crouching.

<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Sweet Science

Sweet Science’s secret training base is full of traps. No surprise there - a dangerous man is bound to have a dangerous home.

ru.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Sweet Science

Sweet Science’s secret training base is full of traps. No surprise there - a dangerous man is bound to have a dangerous home.
ru.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Карта:</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Герой:</color> Sweet Science

Секретная тренировочная база Sweet Science полна ловушек. Удивляться тут нечему: у опасного человека должен быть опасный дом.

de.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Sweet Science

Sweet Science’s secret training base is full of traps. No surprise there - a dangerous man is bound to have a dangerous home.
de.translation:
<color=“#cf9736“>Parcours:</color> Luftschloss
<color=“#cf9736“>Held:</color> Sweet Science

Die geheime Trainingsbasis von Sweet Science ist voller Fallen. Es wird wohl niemanden groß überraschen, dass ein gefährlicher Mann auch ein gefährliches Zuhause hat.

fr.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Sweet Science

Sweet Science’s secret training base is full of traps. No surprise there - a dangerous man is bound to have a dangerous home.
fr.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Parcours :</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Héros :</color> Sweet Science

La base d'entraînement secrète de Sweet Science est truffée de pièges. Mais ça n'étonnera personne : tout castagneur qui se respecte se doit d'avoir un chez-lui tout aussi dangereux !

es.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Sweet Science

Sweet Science’s secret training base is full of traps. No surprise there - a dangerous man is bound to have a dangerous home.
es.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Desafío:</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Personaje:</color> Sweet Science

Recorre el castillo secreto de Sweet Science, un lugar lleno de trampas, como era de esperar de un hombre tan peligroso.

pt.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Sweet Science

Sweet Science’s secret training base is full of traps. No surprise there - a dangerous man is bound to have a dangerous home.
pt.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Percurso:</color> Luftschloss
<color="#cf9736">Herói:</color> Sweet Science

A base secreta de treinamento de Sweet Science é cheia de armadilhas. Isso não é surpresa nenhuma - um homem perigoso há de ter uma casa perigosa.

<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> ‘Doc’ Eliza Doolally

Eliza has left her Hazmat suit back in her lab. Run the gas-filled gauntlet as fast as you can and avoid taking an early acid-bath.

de.original:

<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> ‘Doc’ Eliza Doolally

Eliza has left her Hazmat suit back in her lab. Run the gas-filled gauntlet as fast as you can and avoid taking an early acid-bath.
de.translation:
<color=“#cf9736“>Parcours:</color> Laborrattenrennen
<color=“#cf9736“>Held:</color> 'Doc' Eliza Doolally

Eliza hat ihren Gefahrengutkittel im Labor gelassen. Renn so schnell du kannst durch den Parcours und vermeide ein verfrühtes Säurebad!

fr.original:

fr.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Parcours :</color> Lab Rat Run
<color="#cf9736">Héros :</color> ‘Doc’ Eliza Doolally

Eliza a laissé sa combi Hazmat au vestiaire. Traversez ce parcours aux vapeurs toxiques le plus vite possible et tâchez de ne pas plonger dans un bain d'acide.

pt.original:

pt.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Percurso:</color> Lab Rat Run
<color="#cf9736">Herói:</color> "Doc" Eliza Doolally

Eliza deixou sua roupa protetora no laboratório. Corra pelos corredores cheios de gases o mais rápido possível e evite tomar um banho de ácido.

es.original:

<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> ‘Doc’ Eliza Doolally

es.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Desafío:</color> Carrera en el laboratorio
<color="#cf9736">Personaje:</color> 'Doc' Eliza Doolally

Eliza olvidó su traje en el laboratorio. ¿Podrías ayudarla a recuperarlo? Completa el recorrido lo más rápido posible y evita caer en el ácido.

ru.translation:

<color=»#cf9736»>Персонаж:</color> ‘Doc’ Eliza Doolally

description.text:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Cogwheel
It shouldn’t be possible for a robot to have an ego but from the size of the construction here you would never guess that. Our coal-fired Hero is going to need to use all of his steam power to blast through to the end of this assault course.

de.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Cogwheel
It shouldn’t be possible for a robot to have an ego but from the size of the construction here you would never guess that. Our coal-fired Hero is going to need to use all of his steam power to blast through to the end of this assault course.
de.translation:
<color=“#cf9736“>Parcours:</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color=“#cf9736“>Held:</color> Cogwheel
Ein Roboter sollte eigentlich kein ausgeprägtes Ego haben, aber bei der Größe dieser Konstruktion hier kann man das kaum glauben. Unser kohlebeheizter Held wird all seine Dampfkraft verwenden, um bis ans Ende dieses Parcours durchzubrechen!

fr.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Cogwheel
It shouldn’t be possible for a robot to have an ego but from the size of the construction here you would never guess that. Our coal-fired Hero is going to need to use all of his steam power to blast through to the end of this assault course.
fr.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Parcours :</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color="#cf9736">Héros :</color> Cogwheel
Normalement, un robot, ça n'a pas d'égo, mais vu la taille de cette construction, il est permis d'en douter ! Notre héros de métal va devoir foncer à toute vapeur pour arriver à la fin du parcours.

pt.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Cogwheel
It shouldn’t be possible for a robot to have an ego but from the size of the construction here you would never guess that. Our coal-fired Hero is going to need to use all of his steam power to blast through to the end of this assault course.
pt.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Percurso:</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color="#cf9736">Herói:</color> Cogwheel
Em tese é impossível que um robô tenha um ego, mas a julgar pelo tamanho desta construção, talvez não seja tão impossível assim. Nosso herói movido a carvão vai precisar de toda a sua energia a vapor para atravessar este percurso de assalto.

es.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Cogwheel
It shouldn’t be possible for a robot to have an ego but from the size of the construction here you would never guess that. Our coal-fired Hero is going to need to use all of his steam power to blast through to the end of this assault course.
es.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Desafío:</color> Monstruosidad metálica
<color="#cf9736">Personaje:</color> Cogwheel

A juzgar por el tamaño de este lugar, nadie diría que los robots no tienen vanidad. Nuestro autómata a vapor favorito deberá usar toda su potencia para llegar al final de este escenario.

ru.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Cogwheel
It shouldn’t be possible for a robot to have an ego but from the size of the construction here you would never guess that. Our coal-fired Hero is going to need to use all of his steam power to blast through to the end of this assault course.
ru.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Карта:</color> Metal Monstrosity
<color="#cf9736">Герой:</color> Cogwheel
У робота вроде бы не может быть самомнения, но, судя по масштабу строительства здесь, вы бы никогда так не подумали. Нашему герою, работающему на угольном топливе, понадобится вся его паровая энергия, чтобы добраться до конца этой блиц-игры.

<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Raiders of the Lost Block
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Nigel Purdey-Longshott

Play like Indiana Longshott and run the gauntlet of sneaky tikis from the chamber of destiny to the frightening pit of doom.

<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Raiders of the Lost Block

Play like Indiana Longshott and run the gauntlet of sneaky tikis from the chamber of destiny to the frightening pit of doom.
fr.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Parcours :</color> Les aventuriers du bloc perdu
<color="#cf9736">Héros :</color> Nigel Purdey-Longshott

Devenez Indiana Longshott le temps d'un parcours : évitez les tikis vicieux, découvrez la Chambre de la destinée et l'effrayante fosse maudite.

description.text:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Path to Light
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Dream Genie
Many traps lay dormant, what treasures do they protect? Those who have gone before have never returned, do you have what it takes to battle the Path to Light to claim Queen Ifriti's treasure?

Created by community member sanojLeOne

pt.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Path to Light
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Dream Genie
Many traps lay dormant, what treasures do they protect? Those who have gone before have never returned, do you have what it takes to battle the Path to Light to claim Queen Ifriti's treasure?

Created by community member sanojLeOne
pt.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Percurso:</color> Path to Light
<color="#cf9736">Herói:</color> Dream Genie
Muitas armadilhas descansam no local, mas que tesouros elas protegem? Aqueles que já estiveram aqui nunca mais voltaram. Você tem as habilidades necessárias para passar pelo caminho da luz e conquistar o tesouro da Rainha Ifriti?

Criado pelo membro da comunidade sanojLeOne

fr.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Path to Light
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Dream Genie
Many traps lay dormant, what treasures do they protect? Those who have gone before have never returned, do you have what it takes to battle the Path to Light to claim Queen Ifriti's treasure?

Created by community member sanojLeOne
fr.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Parcours :</color> Path to Light
<color="#cf9736">Héros :</color> Dream Genie
Quels sont ces trésors que protègent ces pièges enfouis ? Ceux qui s'y sont aventurés ne sont jamais revenus... Aurez-vous le courage d'emprunter ce chemin semé d'embûches pour mettre la main sur le trésor de la reine Ifriti ?

Carte créée par sanojLeOne, membre de la communauté.

es.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Path to Light
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Dream Genie
Many traps lay dormant, what treasures do they protect? Those who have gone before have never returned, do you have what it takes to battle the Path to Light to claim Queen Ifriti's treasure?

Created by community member sanojLeOne
es.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Desafío:</color> Sendero hacia la luz
<color="#cf9736">Personaje:</color> Dream Genie

Hay muchas trampas que esperan por su presa, pero... ¿qué tesoros ocultan? Quienes se han aventurado, nunca han regresado... ¿Tienes el coraje de encontrar el sendero hacia la luz y hallar el tesoro de la reina Ifriti?

Creado por sanojLeOne

ru.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Path to Light
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Dream Genie
Many traps lay dormant, what treasures do they protect? Those who have gone before have never returned, do you have what it takes to battle the Path to Light to claim Queen Ifriti's treasure?

Created by community member sanojLeOne
ru.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Карта:</color> Путь к свету
<color="#cf9736">Герой:</color> Dream Genie
Путь усеян ловушками: какие сокровища они прячут? Многие пытались это узнать, но так и не вернулись... Сумеешь ли ты пройти Путь к свету и завладеть сокровищами Королевы ифритов?

Автор: sanojLeOne

de.original:
<color="#cf9736">Course:</color> Path to Light
<color="#cf9736">Hero:</color> Dream Genie
Many traps lay dormant, what treasures do they protect? Those who have gone before have never returned, do you have what it takes to battle the Path to Light to claim Queen Ifriti's treasure?

Created by community member sanojLeOne
de.translation:
<color="#cf9736">Parcours:</color> Weg des Lichts
<color=“#cf9736“>Held:</color> Dream Genie
Viele Fallen liegen verborgen, doch welche Schätze beherbergen sie? Niemand ist von diesem Weg je zurückgekehrt – hast du das Zeug dazu, den Weg des Lichts zu beschreiten, um dir Königin Ifritis Schatz zu holen?

Von Community-Mitglied sanojLeOne hergestellt!

title.text: Everyone has a bad game now and again. Maybe take a break and come back and play later.

ru.original: Everyone has a bad game now and again. Maybe take a break and come back and play later.
ru.translation: Это был не лучший ваш матч. Может быть, стоит передохнуть?

fr.original: Everyone has a bad game now and again. Maybe take a break and come back and play later.
fr.translation: Ça arrive à tout le monde d'échouer. Faites une pause, et revenez jouer plus tard.

pt.original: Everyone has a bad game now and again. Maybe take a break and come back and play later.
pt.translation: Todo mundo tem uma partida ruim vez por outra. Talvez seja melhor fazer uma pausa e voltar para jogar mais tarde.

es.original: Everyone has a bad game now and again. Maybe take a break and come back and play later.
es.translation: Quizás sea mejor que te tomes un descanso y vuelvas a jugar más tarde.

de.original: Everyone has a bad game now and again. Maybe take a break and come back and play later.
de.translation: Jeder hat mal einen schlechten Tag. Vielleicht solltest du eine Pause einlegen und später wiederkommen.

title.text: You have repeatedly failed to accept a match. You will be blocked from queuing for a time.

ru.original: You have repeatedly failed to accept a match. You will be blocked from queuing for a time.
ru.translation: Вы многократно не приняли матч и не сможете играть некоторое время.

fr.original: You have repeatedly failed to accept a match. You will be blocked from queuing for a time.
fr.translation: Vous avez à plusieurs reprises décidé de ne pas accepter une partie. Vous ne pourrez plus rejoindre la file d'attente pendant un certain temps.

pt.original: You have repeatedly failed to accept a match. You will be blocked from queuing for a time.
pt.translation: Você deixou de aceitar uma partida repetidas vezes. A fila ficará bloqueada para você por um tempo.

es.original: You have repeatedly failed to accept a match. You will be blocked from queuing for a time.
es.translation: Rechazaste partidas de manera reiterada y no podrás acceder a la lista de espera durante un tiempo.

de.original: You have repeatedly failed to accept a match. You will be blocked from queuing for a time.
de.translation: Du hast Matche wiederholt nicht angenommen und kannst für kurze Zeit keiner Warteschleife mehr beitreten.

title.text: Quitting matches harms your team's chances of winning.

ru.original: Quitting matches harms your team's chances of winning.
ru.translation: Выходя из игры, вы снижаете вероятность победы вашей команды.

fr.original: Quitting matches harms your team's chances of winning.
fr.translation: Ça n'aidera pas votre équipe si vous quittez la partie.

pt.original: Quitting matches harms your team's chances of winning.
pt.translation: Sair de uma partida prejudica as chances de vitória da sua equipe.

es.original: Quitting matches harms your team's chances of winning.
es.translation: Si abandonas partidas, reduces las posibilidades de que tu equipo gane.

de.original: Quitting matches harms your team's chances of winning.
de.translation: Wenn du Matche verlässt, sinkt dadurch die Chance deines Teams auf den Sieg.

title.text: You have been detected cheating. If you continue to do so you will be banned.

ru.original: You have been detected cheating. If you continue to do so you will be banned.
ru.translation: С вашей стороны обнаружено читерство. Если это будет продолжаться, возможна блокировка пользователя.

fr.original: You have been detected cheating. If you continue to do so you will be banned.
fr.translation: Des soupçons de tricherie pèsent sur vous. Si vous continuez, vous aller vous faire exclure.

pt.original: You have been detected cheating. If you continue to do so you will be banned.
pt.translation: Sua trapaça foi detectada. Se continuar, você será banido.

es.original: You have been detected cheating. If you continue to do so you will be banned.
es.translation: Descubrimos que estuviste haciendo trampa. Si sigues infringiendo las reglas, recibirás una sanción.

de.original: You have been detected cheating. If you continue to do so you will be banned.
de.translation: Du wurdest beim Cheaten erwischt. Wenn du so weitermachst, wirst du gebannt.

title.text: Being inactive in matches hurts your team's chances of winning.

ru.original: Being inactive in matches hurts your team's chances of winning.
ru.translation: Не стой без дела во время боя, а то не видать твоей команде победы.

fr.original: Being inactive in matches hurts your team's chances of winning.
fr.translation: Votre inactivité durant une partie n'aidera pas vos coéquipiers à gagner.

pt.original: Being inactive in matches hurts your team's chances of winning.
pt.translation: Ficar inativo em uma partida prejudica as chances de vitória da sua equipe.

es.original: Being inactive in matches hurts your team's chances of winning.
es.translation: Si no participas de manera activa en las partidas, tu equipo no ganará.

de.original: Being inactive in matches hurts your team's chances of winning.
de.translation: Wenn du während eines Matches inaktiv bist, sinkt dadurch die Chance deines Teams auf den Sieg.

tips.text: You can customize your key bindings in the settings menu.

ru.original: You can customize your key bindings in the settings menu.
ru.translation: Привязку кнопок можно изменить в меню настроек.

es.original: You can customize your key bindings in the settings menu.
es.translation: Puedes personalizar los atajos de teclado en el menú de ajustes.

de.original: You can customize your key bindings in the settings menu.
de.translation: Tastenkürzel können im Einstellungsmenü angepasst werden.

pt.original: You can customize your key bindings in the settings menu.
pt.translation: Você pode personalizar suas teclas no menu de configurações.

fr.original: You can customize your key bindings in the settings menu.
fr.translation: Vous pouvez personnaliser vos raccourcis clavier grâce au menu des options.

tips.text: Supply Drops award all of your teammates a sizeable amount of bricks. Try to pick them up before your enemies do.

ru.original: Supply Drops award all of your teammates a sizeable amount of bricks. Try to pick them up before your enemies do.
ru.translation: Ящики с ресурсами дают твоей команде немалое количество ресурсов. Старайся подбирать их раньше врагов.

es.original: Supply Drops award all of your teammates a sizeable amount of bricks. Try to pick them up before your enemies do.
es.translation: Las provisiones que caen del cielo otorgan gran cantidad de cubos. ¡Tómalas antes que tus enemigos!

de.original: Supply Drops award all of your teammates a sizeable amount of bricks. Try to pick them up before your enemies do.
de.translation: Nachschubkisten versorgen alle deine Teamkollegen mit Bausteinen. Versuch also, sie vor deinen Gegnern zu finden.

pt.original: Supply Drops award all of your teammates a sizeable amount of bricks. Try to pick them up before your enemies do.
pt.translation: Suprimentos de paraquedas fornecem a todos seus colegas de equipe uma quantia considerável de blocos. Tente pegá-los antes dos seus inimigos.

fr.original: Supply Drops award all of your teammates a sizeable amount of bricks. Try to pick them up before your enemies do.
fr.translation: Les approvisionnements de matériel fournissent à l'ensemble de vos coéquipiers une quantité de briques significative. Essayez de vous en emparer avant vos ennemis.

tips.text: Speed influences how far you jump. You can sprint and jump for a longer leap, or use Speed Blocks and Bounce Pads.

ru.original: Speed influences how far you jump. You can sprint and jump for a longer leap, or use Speed Blocks and Bounce Pads.
ru.translation: Скорость влияет на дальность прыжка. Ты можешь прыгать с разбега, чтобы прыжок был дальше, или использовать ускорители и батуты.

es.original: Speed influences how far you jump. You can sprint and jump for a longer leap, or use Speed Blocks and Bounce Pads.
es.translation: La velocidad afecta tus saltos. ¡Corre para saltar más lejos! Esto también se aplica a los resortes y aceleradores.

de.original: Speed influences how far you jump. You can sprint and jump for a longer leap, or use Speed Blocks and Bounce Pads.
de.translation: Deine Geschwindigkeit beeinflusst deine Sprungweite. Renn und spring für einen weiten Sprung oder verwende Beschleunigungs- und Sprungblöcke.

pt.original: Speed influences how far you jump. You can sprint and jump for a longer leap, or use Speed Blocks and Bounce Pads.
pt.translation: Sua velocidade influencia a distância do seu pulo. Você pode dar uma arrancada e pular para saltar mais longe ou usar placas aceleradoras e pula-pulas.

fr.original: Speed influences how far you jump. You can sprint and jump for a longer leap, or use Speed Blocks and Bounce Pads.
fr.translation: Votre vitesse détermine la longueur de votre saut. Vous pouvez donc courir puis sauter pour effectuer un bond plus long, ou bien utiliser des accélérateurs et blocs à ressort.

tips.text: All player-built devices can be salvaged for half of their standard construction cost.

ru.original: All player-built devices can be salvaged for half of their standard construction cost.
ru.translation: Любые построенные игроками устройства можно вернуть за половину обычной стоимости строительства.

es.original: All player-built devices can be salvaged for half of their standard construction cost.
es.translation: Todos los bloques que colocan los jugadores pueden ser recuperados por la mitad de su costo normal de construcción.

de.original: All player-built devices can be salvaged for half of their standard construction cost.
de.translation: Alle von Spielern gebauten Geräte können für die Hälfte der Standardbaukosten wiederverwertet werden.

pt.original: All player-built devices can be salvaged for half of their standard construction cost.
pt.translation: Todos os dispositivos construídos por jogadores podem ser recuperados, mas você só recebe metade do custo de construção padrão.

fr.original: All player-built devices can be salvaged for half of their standard construction cost.
fr.translation: Tous les dispositifs construits par des joueurs peuvent être récupérés contre la moitié de leur coût de construction.

tips.text: You can't shoot while sprinting, but you can reload.

ru.original: You can't shoot while sprinting, but you can reload.
ru.translation: Во время бега нельзя стрелять, но можно перезаряжаться.

es.original: You can't shoot while sprinting, but you can reload.
es.translation: Mientras corres no puedes disparar, pero puedes recargar.

de.original: You can't shoot while sprinting, but you can reload.
de.translation: Du kannst beim Rennen nicht schießen, dafür aber nachladen.

pt.original: You can't shoot while sprinting, but you can reload.
pt.translation: Você não pode atirar enquanto estiver dando uma arrancada, mas pode recarregar a arma.

fr.original: You can't shoot while sprinting, but you can reload.
fr.translation: Vous ne pouvez pas tirer en courant, mais vous pouvez recharger votre arme.

tips.text: You can sprint up 1 high blocks without jumping.

ru.original: You can sprint up 1 high blocks without jumping.
ru.translation: Можно бегом взобраться на 1 высокий блок без прыжка.

es.original: You can sprint up 1 high blocks without jumping.
es.translation: Para trepar un solo bloque no hace falta que saltes.

de.original: You can sprint up 1 high blocks without jumping.
de.translation: Du kannst 1 Block hoch rennen, ohne zu springen.

pt.original: You can sprint up 1 high blocks without jumping.
pt.translation: Você pode dar uma arrancada e subir a altura de um bloco sem pular.

fr.original: You can sprint up 1 high blocks without jumping.
fr.translation: Vous pouvez sauter par-dessus 1 bloc en courant sans avoir à utiliser la touche de saut.

tips.text: Running, jumping, and crouching will modify the accuracy of most weapons. Try to find the right shooting conditions for your playstyle.

ru.original: Running, jumping, and crouching will modify the accuracy of most weapons. Try to find the right shooting conditions for your playstyle.
ru.translation: Для большей части оружия точность меняется, если ты бежишь, прыгаешь или приседаешь. Попробуй определить, какой способ стрельбы лучше подходит для твоего стиля игры.

es.original: Running, jumping, and crouching will modify the accuracy of most weapons. Try to find the right shooting conditions for your playstyle.
es.translation: La precisión de las armas cambiará de acuerdo a si corres, saltas o te agachas.

de.original: Running, jumping, and crouching will modify the accuracy of most weapons. Try to find the right shooting conditions for your playstyle.
de.translation: Rennen, springen und ducken beeinflussen die Genauigkeit der meisten Waffen. Finde die optimalen Schussbedingungen für deinen Spielstil.

pt.original: Running, jumping, and crouching will modify the accuracy of most weapons. Try to find the right shooting conditions for your playstyle.
pt.translation: Correr, pular e agachar são ações que modificam a precisão da maioria das armas. Tente encontrar a melhor condição para atirar de acordo com o seu estilo de jogo.

fr.original: Running, jumping, and crouching will modify the accuracy of most weapons. Try to find the right shooting conditions for your playstyle.
fr.translation: La plupart des armes deviennent plus ou moins précises lorsque vous courez, sautez, et vous accroupissez. Trouvez les conditions de tir qui conviennent le mieux à votre style de jeu.

tips.text: Shooting an enemy at close range will usually do more damage than taking pot shots at them from a distance.

ru.original: Shooting an enemy at close range will usually do more damage than taking pot shots at them from a distance.
ru.translation: Стрельба по врагу вблизи обычно наносит больше урона, чем попытки попасть по нему издалека.

es.original: Shooting an enemy at close range will usually do more damage than taking pot shots at them from a distance.
es.translation: Al disparar de cerca causarás más daño que al intentar acertar desde lejos.

de.original: Shooting an enemy at close range will usually do more damage than taking pot shots at them from a distance.
de.translation: Wenn du deine Gegner auf nahe Distanz angreifst, löst das meist mehr Schaden aus, als sie aus der Ferne aufs Geratewohl anzugreifen.

pt.original: Shooting an enemy at close range will usually do more damage than taking pot shots at them from a distance.
pt.translation: Atirar num inimigo à curta distância costuma causar mais danos que ficar atirando à distância.

fr.original: Shooting an enemy at close range will usually do more damage than taking pot shots at them from a distance.
fr.translation: Vous causerez en général plus de dégâts à un ennemi à bout portant qu'en tirant sur lui à distance sans viser.

tips.text: Some weapons do different amounts of damage to Heroes and Blocks.

ru.original: Some weapons do different amounts of damage to Heroes and Blocks.
ru.translation: Некоторое оружие наносит различный урон героям и блокам.

es.original: Some weapons do different amounts of damage to Heroes and Blocks.
es.translation: Algunas armas causan diferente intensidad de daño a bloques y enemigos.

de.original: Some weapons do different amounts of damage to Heroes and Blocks.
de.translation: Einige Waffen verursachen bei Gegnern und Blöcken unterschiedlich hohen Schaden.

pt.original: Some weapons do different amounts of damage to Heroes and Blocks.
pt.translation: Algumas armas causam quantias diferentes de dano a heróis e blocos.

fr.original: Some weapons do different amounts of damage to Heroes and Blocks.
fr.translation: Certaines armes infligent un nombre de dégâts différent aux héros et aux blocs.

tips.text: If your opponents have set up a powerful defense line, try using indirect fire (grenades, mortar) to weaken their defenses before you charge in.

ru.original: If your opponents have set up a powerful defense line, try using indirect fire (grenades, mortar) to weaken their defenses before you charge in.
ru.translation: Если противник возвел мощную линию обороны, попробуй стрелять непрямой наводкой (гранатами или мортирами), чтобы ослабить его оборону перед атакой.

es.original: If your opponents have set up a powerful defense line, try using indirect fire (grenades, mortar) to weaken their defenses before you charge in.
es.translation: Si el enemigo creó una fuerte línea de defensa, usa un ataque indirecto (con granadas o mortero) para debilitarla antes de avanzar.

de.original: If your opponents have set up a powerful defense line, try using indirect fire (grenades, mortar) to weaken their defenses before you charge in.
de.translation: Wenn deine Gegner eine gute Verteidigung errichtet haben, versuch sie zunächst durch indirekte Angriffe (zum Beispiel mit Granaten) zu schwächen, bevor du sie stürmst.

pt.original: If your opponents have set up a powerful defense line, try using indirect fire (grenades, mortar) to weaken their defenses before you charge in.
pt.translation: Se seus oponentes tiverem montado uma poderosa linha de defesa, tente usar fogo indireto (granadas, morteiro) para enfraquecer as defesas deles antes de invadir.

fr.original: If your opponents have set up a powerful defense line, try using indirect fire (grenades, mortar) to weaken their defenses before you charge in.
fr.translation: Si vos adversaires ont établi une ligne défensive robuste, utilisez des projectiles indirects (grenades, mortier) pour affaiblir leurs défenses avant de lancer l'offensive.

tips.text: Some weapons have an Alt-Fire function instead of aiming down the sights.

ru.original: Some weapons have an Alt-Fire function instead of aiming down the sights.
ru.translation: У некоторых видов оружия вместо прицеливания есть функция альтернативного огня.

es.original: Some weapons have an Alt-Fire function instead of aiming down the sights.
es.translation: Algunas armas tienen una mira de precisión como función secundaria y otras un ataque alternativo.

de.original: Some weapons have an Alt-Fire function instead of aiming down the sights.
de.translation: Einige Waffen verfügen über alternative Angriffe ohne Anvisierung.

pt.original: Some weapons have an Alt-Fire function instead of aiming down the sights.
pt.translation: Algumas armas possuem uma função de tiro secundário em vez de usar a mira da arma.

fr.original: Some weapons have an Alt-Fire function instead of aiming down the sights.
fr.translation: Certaines armes offrent une action secondaire, au lieu d'améliorer la visée.

tips.text: Cubes must be destroyed in order before the Base becomes vulnerable to attacks.

ru.original: Cubes must be destroyed in order before the Base becomes vulnerable to attacks.
ru.translation: Кубы нужно уничтожить, прежде чем база станет уязвимой для атак.

es.original: Cubes must be destroyed in order before the Base becomes vulnerable to attacks.
es.translation: Para poder atacar el núcleo, primero debes destruir los generadores.

de.original: Cubes must be destroyed in order before the Base becomes vulnerable to attacks.
de.translation: Die Generatoren müssen der Reihe nach zerstört werden, bevor du die Basis angreifen kannst.

pt.original: Cubes must be destroyed in order before the Base becomes vulnerable to attacks.
pt.translation: Os Cubos devem ser destruídos para que a Base fique vulnerável a ataques.

fr.original: Cubes must be destroyed in order before the Base becomes vulnerable to attacks.
fr.translation: Vous devez d'abord détruire les cubes pour que la base soit vulnérable aux attaques.

tips.text: Press TAB while chatting to switch between team chat and general chat.

ru.original: Press TAB while chatting to switch between team chat and general chat.
ru.translation: Нажимай TAB во время общения в чате, чтобы переключаться между командным и общим чатом.

es.original: Press TAB while chatting to switch between team chat and general chat.
es.translation: Oprime la tecla Tab mientras estás chateando para cambiar entre el chat de equipo y el chat general.

de.original: Press TAB while chatting to switch between team chat and general chat.
de.translation: Drück die TAB-Taste, um zwischen dem allgemeinen und dem Team-Chat zu wechseln.

pt.original: Press TAB while chatting to switch between team chat and general chat.
pt.translation: Pressione a tecla TAB enquanto bate papo para alternar entre bate-papo da equipe e bate-papo geral.

fr.original: Press TAB while chatting to switch between team chat and general chat.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche TAB pendant une discussion pour passer de la discussion d'équipe à la discussion générale.

tips.text: Bombs can be defused by digging them with your tool.

ru.original: Bombs can be defused by digging them with your tool.
ru.translation: Бомбы можно обезвредить при помощи инструментов.

es.original: Bombs can be defused by digging them with your tool.
es.translation: Para desactivar las bombas, atácalas con tu herramienta.

de.original: Bombs can be defused by digging them with your tool.
de.translation: Du kannst Bomben entschärfen, indem du sie mit deinem Werkzeug bearbeitest.

pt.original: Bombs can be defused by digging them with your tool.
pt.translation: Bombas podem ser desarmadas escavando-as com sua ferramenta.

fr.original: Bombs can be defused by digging them with your tool.
fr.translation: Vous pouvez désamorcer des bombes en utilisant votre outil pour les dégager.

tips.text: Heroes are split into three roles. Each role has access to specialized role blocks, as well as a generic set of blocks that all heroes have access to.

ru.original: Heroes are split into three roles. Each role has access to specialized role blocks, as well as a generic set of blocks that all heroes have access to.
ru.translation: Герои делятся на три группы, исполняющие разные роли. Каждая имеет доступ к специальным блокам, но есть блоки, которые доступны всем героям.

es.original: Heroes are split into three roles. Each role has access to specialized role blocks, as well as a generic set of blocks that all heroes have access to.
es.translation: Los personajes se dividen en tres categorías y cada uno de ellos posee bloques exclusivos, además de los bloques que están disponibles para todos los personajes.

de.original: Heroes are split into three roles. Each role has access to specialized role blocks, as well as a generic set of blocks that all heroes have access to.
de.translation: Helden sind in drei Gruppen eingeteilt, von denen jede über spezielle Blöcke verfügt, die die anderen nicht haben. Andere Blöcke wiederum stehen allen Helden zur Verfügung.

pt.original: Heroes are split into three roles. Each role has access to specialized role blocks, as well as a generic set of blocks that all heroes have access to.
pt.translation: Heróis são divididos em três funções. Cada função tem acesso a blocos específicos dela, além de blocos genéricos que todos os heróis podem acessar.

fr.original: Heroes are split into three roles. Each role has access to specialized role blocks, as well as a generic set of blocks that all heroes have access to.
fr.translation: Les héros sont répartis en trois rôles. Chaque rôle a accès à des blocs spécialisés ainsi qu'à un ensemble de blocs génériques auquel tous les héros ont accès.

tips.text: Explosive damage is absorbed by nearby blocks. So if you hide behind sturdy blocks like Concrete, Bricks or Sandbags they will take damage first.

ru.original: Explosive damage is absorbed by nearby blocks. So if you hide behind sturdy blocks like Concrete, Bricks or Sandbags they will take damage first.
ru.translation: Урон от взрывов поглощается ближайшими блоками. Если ты спрячешься за прочными бетонными блоками, кирпичами или мешками с песком, они получат урон первыми.

es.original: Explosive damage is absorbed by nearby blocks. So if you hide behind sturdy blocks like Concrete, Bricks or Sandbags they will take damage first.
es.translation: El daño explosivo es absorbido por los bloques cercanos. Si te refugias detrás de un bloque rígido como ladrillos o arena, los bloques absorberán el impacto antes de que logre herirte.

de.original: Explosive damage is absorbed by nearby blocks. So if you hide behind sturdy blocks like Concrete, Bricks or Sandbags they will take damage first.
de.translation: Explosionsschaden wird von nahen Blöcken absorbiert. Wenn du dich also hinter festen Blöcken aus Beton oder Sandsäcken duckst, nehmen diese zuerst Schaden.

pt.original: Explosive damage is absorbed by nearby blocks. So if you hide behind sturdy blocks like Concrete, Bricks or Sandbags they will take damage first.
pt.translation: Danos de explosões são absorvidos por blocos vizinhos. Portanto, se você se esconder atrás de blocos resistentes, como concreto, tijolos ou sacos de areia, eles vão sofrer o dano primeiro.

fr.original: Explosive damage is absorbed by nearby blocks. So if you hide behind sturdy blocks like Concrete, Bricks or Sandbags they will take damage first.
fr.translation: Les dégâts d'une explosion sont absorbés par les blocs à proximité. Cachez-vous derrière des blocs solides, comme des blocs en ciment, des briques ou des blocs de sable, pour que ces blocs subissent les dégâts avant vous.

tips.text: The healing effect from the Heal Station does not stack with itself. The same applies to the Ammo Crate.

ru.original: The healing effect from the Heal Station does not stack with itself. The same applies to the Ammo Crate.
ru.translation: Эффект лечения от лечебного блока не суммируется. То же самое относится к ящику с боеприпасами.

es.original: The healing effect from the Heal Station does not stack with itself. The same applies to the Ammo Crate.
es.translation: El efecto de los bloques curativos no es acumulable. Lo mismo ocurre con la caja de municiones.

de.original: The healing effect from the Heal Station does not stack with itself. The same applies to the Ammo Crate.
de.translation: Der Heileffekt einer Heilstation wird nicht durch andere Heilstationen zusätzlich erhöht. Dasselbe gilt für Munitionskisten.

pt.original: The healing effect from the Heal Station does not stack with itself. The same applies to the Ammo Crate.
pt.translation: O efeito de cura da estação de cura não é acumulável. O mesmo vale para caixotes de munição.

fr.original: The healing effect from the Heal Station does not stack with itself. The same applies to the Ammo Crate.
fr.translation: L'effet guérisseur de la station de soins ne peut être cumulé plusieurs fois. La même règle s'applique à la caisse de munitions.

tips.text: When assaulting enemy defenses, try to establish a small forward base. Just one Heal Station planted in a hole in the ground can make a difference.

ru.original: When assaulting enemy defenses, try to establish a small forward base. Just one Heal Station planted in a hole in the ground can make a difference.
ru.translation: Когда ты штурмуешь оборонительные сооружения противника, попробуй создать небольшую передовую базу. Даже один лечебный блок может многое изменить.

es.original: When assaulting enemy defenses, try to establish a small forward base. Just one Heal Station planted in a hole in the ground can make a difference.
es.translation: Al atacar defensas enemigas, establece un pequeño puesto de avanzada. Un solo bloque curativo colocado en el lugar adecuado puede hacer una gran diferencia.

de.original: When assaulting enemy defenses, try to establish a small forward base. Just one Heal Station planted in a hole in the ground can make a difference.
de.translation: Wenn du die gegnerische Verteidigung angreifst, versuch zunächst, eine vorgeschobene Operationsbasis zu errichten. Eine einzige Heilstation in einer Grube kann schon einen entscheidenden Unterschied machen!

pt.original: When assaulting enemy defenses, try to establish a small forward base. Just one Heal Station planted in a hole in the ground can make a difference.
pt.translation: Ao atacar defesas inimigas, tente estabelecer uma pequena base avançada. Até mesmo uma só estação de cura posicionada num buraco no chão pode fazer a diferença.

fr.original: When assaulting enemy defenses, try to establish a small forward base. Just one Heal Station planted in a hole in the ground can make a difference.
fr.translation: Lorsque vous attaquez les défenses ennemies, essayez d'établir une base avancée. Une simple station de soins placée dans un trou au sol peut faire toute la différence.

tips.text: If you build chains of Speed Blocks, try putting traps between your Speed Blocks to deny their use to your opponents.

ru.original: If you build chains of Speed Blocks, try putting traps between your Speed Blocks to deny their use to your opponents.
ru.translation: Если создаешь цепочку из ускорителей, установи между ними ловушки, чтобы ими не мог воспользоваться враг.

es.original: If you build chains of Speed Blocks, try putting traps between your Speed Blocks to deny their use to your opponents.
es.translation: Si construyes una cadena de bloques aceleradores, coloca minas entre ellos para que tus enemigos no puedan usarla.

de.original: If you build chains of Speed Blocks, try putting traps between your Speed Blocks to deny their use to your opponents.
de.translation: Wenn du eine Reihe von Beschleunigungsblöcken errichtest, platziere Fallen zwischen ihnen, damit deine Gegner sie nicht für sich selbst nutzen können!

pt.original: If you build chains of Speed Blocks, try putting traps between your Speed Blocks to deny their use to your opponents.
pt.translation: Se você construir sequências de placas aceleradoras, tente colocar armadilhas entre as placas para que seus inimigos não possam utilizá-las.

fr.original: If you build chains of Speed Blocks, try putting traps between your Speed Blocks to deny their use to your opponents.
fr.translation: Si vous construisez une série d'accélérateurs, essayez de placer des pièges entre chacun d'entre eux pour empêcher les ennemis de les utiliser.

tips.text: Be careful when using Land Mines. Building a bunch of mines that can be easily shot by your opponents is the same as building free bombs for your opponents to use.

ru.original: Be careful when using Land Mines. Building a bunch of mines that can be easily shot by your opponents is the same as building free bombs for your opponents to use.
ru.translation: Будь осторожнее при использовании мин. Куча мин, в которые противник может с легкостью выстрелить, — это все равно что бомбы, которые ты ему даришь.

es.original: Be careful when using Land Mines. Building a bunch of mines that can be easily shot by your opponents is the same as building free bombs for your opponents to use.
es.translation: Ten cuidado al usar minas. Colocar un grupo de minas al que tus enemigos pueden dispararle fácilmente es sinónimo de regalarles bombas.

de.original: Be careful when using Land Mines. Building a bunch of mines that can be easily shot by your opponents is the same as building free bombs for your opponents to use.
de.translation: Sei vorsichtig beim Einsetzen von Landminen! Minen, die deine Gegner leicht unter Beschuss nehmen können, sind quasi Gratisbomben für sie.

pt.original: Be careful when using Land Mines. Building a bunch of mines that can be easily shot by your opponents is the same as building free bombs for your opponents to use.
pt.translation: Tome cuidado ao usar minas terrestres. Construir um monte de minas que podem ser facilmente explodidas pelo seu oponente é a mesma coisa que construir bombas grátis para seu inimigo usar contra você.

fr.original: Be careful when using Land Mines. Building a bunch of mines that can be easily shot by your opponents is the same as building free bombs for your opponents to use.
fr.translation: Faites attention en utilisant des mines terrestres. Placer une série de mines à portée des tirs ennemis revient à placer gratuitement des bombes que vos adversaires pourront utiliser.
