tips.text: The Fake Block takes on the appearance of the block it is built from. When an enemy steps on it, it disappears. You can dig some trap pits and cover them up with Fake Blocks.

ru.original: The Fake Block takes on the appearance of the block it is built from. When an enemy steps on it, it disappears. You can dig some trap pits and cover them up with Fake Blocks.
ru.translation: Ложный блок принимает вид блока, рядом с которым он построен, и пропадает, когда враг на него наступает. Можно устанавливать ловушки и прикрывать их ложными блоками.

es.original: The Fake Block takes on the appearance of the block it is built from. When an enemy steps on it, it disappears. You can dig some trap pits and cover them up with Fake Blocks.
es.translation: Los bloques falsos lucen igual que sus bloques contiguos, pero se desmoronan cuando un enemigo los pisa. Puedes cavar una fosa, llenarla de trampas y cubrirla de bloques falsos.

de.original: The Fake Block takes on the appearance of the block it is built from. When an enemy steps on it, it disappears. You can dig some trap pits and cover them up with Fake Blocks.
de.translation: Blockattrappen sehen so aus wie die Blöcke, auf denen sie gebaut wurden. Tritt ein Gegner auf sie drauf, verschwindet die Attrappe. Errichte Fallgruben und decke sie mit Attrappen ab!

pt.original: The Fake Block takes on the appearance of the block it is built from. When an enemy steps on it, it disappears. You can dig some trap pits and cover them up with Fake Blocks.
pt.translation: O bloco falso assume a aparência do bloco a partir do qual ele é construído. Quando um inimigo pisa nele, o bloco falso desaparece. Você pode cavar fossos de armadilha e cobri-los com blocos falsos.

fr.original: The Fake Block takes on the appearance of the block it is built from. When an enemy steps on it, it disappears. You can dig some trap pits and cover them up with Fake Blocks.
fr.translation: Le bloc factice prend l'apparence du bloc sur lequel il est construit. Lorsqu'un ennemi y pose le pied, ce bloc disparaît. Vous pouvez ainsi construire des pièges, puis les dissimuler avec des blocs factices.

tips.text: The Force Gate block lets friendly team-mates through. Use it to build a door to your fortifications that enemies can't get through.

ru.original: The Force Gate block lets friendly team-mates through. Use it to build a door to your fortifications that enemies can't get through.
ru.translation: Силовое поле пропускает только твоих товарищей. Используй его в качестве дверей для доступа к вашим укреплениям, куда враг не сможет проникнуть.

es.original: The Force Gate block lets friendly team-mates through. Use it to build a door to your fortifications that enemies can't get through.
es.translation: Usa los campos de fuerza como puertas de tus fortificaciones, de modo que tus compañeros puedan ingresar pero los enemigos no.

de.original: The Force Gate block lets friendly team-mates through. Use it to build a door to your fortifications that enemies can't get through.
de.translation: Kraftfeldblöcke lassen nur Teammitglieder durch. Nutze sie als Tür für eure Befestigungsanlagen, damit Gegner nicht hineinkommen.

pt.original: The Force Gate block lets friendly team-mates through. Use it to build a door to your fortifications that enemies can't get through.
pt.translation: O bloco de barreira de força deixa companheiros de equipe passarem. Use-o para construir uma porta para suas fortificações que os inimigos não podem atravessar.

fr.original: The Force Gate block lets friendly team-mates through. Use it to build a door to your fortifications that enemies can't get through.
fr.translation: Le champ de force peut être traversé par vos coéquipiers. Vous pouvez l'utiliser pour bâtir une entrée vers votre forteresse accessible à vos alliés, mais pas à vos ennemis.

tips.text: You can cover the area in front of your defensive walls with several rows of Glue. This will give you time to stop enemy bombers when defending your wall.

ru.original: You can cover the area in front of your defensive walls with several rows of Glue. This will give you time to stop enemy bombers when defending your wall.
ru.translation: Можно покрыть область перед вашими стенами клеем. Это даст вам больше времени, чтобы остановить использующих бомбы врагов при обороне стены.

es.original: You can cover the area in front of your defensive walls with several rows of Glue. This will give you time to stop enemy bombers when defending your wall.
es.translation: Coloca pegamento delante de tus muros defensivos para frenar a quienes intenten bombardearlos.

de.original: You can cover the area in front of your defensive walls with several rows of Glue. This will give you time to stop enemy bombers when defending your wall.
de.translation: Du kannst den Bereich vor euren Defensivmauern mit Reihen von Klebstoff versetzen, um gegnerische Bombenleger zu verlangsamen.

pt.original: You can cover the area in front of your defensive walls with several rows of Glue. This will give you time to stop enemy bombers when defending your wall.
pt.translation: Você pode cobrir a área na frente de suas muralhas de defesa com diversas fileiras de cola. Isso faz com que você tenha mais tempo de impedir bombardeiros inimigos ao defender sua muralha.

fr.original: You can cover the area in front of your defensive walls with several rows of Glue. This will give you time to stop enemy bombers when defending your wall.
fr.translation: Vous pouvez recouvrir la zone située devant vos remparts défensifs de plusieurs rangées de blocs adhésifs. Cela vous donnera le temps d'arrêter les lanceurs de bombes ennemis et de défendre vos remparts.

tips.text: Caltrops will weaken enemies and give you the upper hand when defending.

ru.original: Caltrops will weaken enemies and give you the upper hand when defending.
ru.translation: Колючки ослабляют врагов и дают вам преимущество во время обороны.

es.original: Caltrops will weaken enemies and give you the upper hand when defending.
es.translation: Los abrojos debilitarán a tus enemigos a bajo costo.

de.original: Caltrops will weaken enemies and give you the upper hand when defending.
de.translation: Krähenfüße schwächen deine Gegner. Behalte bei der Verteidigung die Oberhand!

pt.original: Caltrops will weaken enemies and give you the upper hand when defending.
pt.translation: Estrepes enfraquecem inimigos e colocam você numa posição de vantagem ao defender.

fr.original: Caltrops will weaken enemies and give you the upper hand when defending.
fr.translation: Les chausse-trapes affaibliront les ennemis et vous donneront l'avantage en défense.

tips.text: Building a Bounce Pad next to a Speed Block, then sprinting into the combo will allow you to super-leap at the cost of a rough landing. You’ll take some fall damage.

ru.original: Building a Bounce Pad next to a Speed Block, then sprinting into the combo will allow you to super-leap at the cost of a rough landing. You’ll take some fall damage.
ru.translation: Поставь ускоритель рядом с батутом, а потом прыгни с разбега. Ты совершишь суперпрыжок, но приземление будет жестким, и ты получишь немного урона после падения.

es.original: Building a Bounce Pad next to a Speed Block, then sprinting into the combo will allow you to super-leap at the cost of a rough landing. You’ll take some fall damage.
es.translation: Si colocas un resorte al lado de un acelerador podrás saltar a gran altura. Pero ten cuidado al caer, ya que podrás hacerte daño.

de.original: Building a Bounce Pad next to a Speed Block, then sprinting into the combo will allow you to super-leap at the cost of a rough landing. You’ll take some fall damage.
de.translation: Platziere einen Sprungblock hinter einem Beschleunigungsblock und sprinte hinein, um einen Supersprung auszuführen. Einziger Nachteil ist die harte Landung, bei der du etwas Schaden erleidest.

pt.original: Building a Bounce Pad next to a Speed Block, then sprinting into the combo will allow you to super-leap at the cost of a rough landing. You’ll take some fall damage.
pt.translation: Construir um pula-pula ao lado de uma placa aceleradora e depois correr sobre eles resulta num supersalto, com uma aterrissagem brutal. Você sofre um pouco de dano na queda.

fr.original: Building a Bounce Pad next to a Speed Block, then sprinting into the combo will allow you to super-leap at the cost of a rough landing. You’ll take some fall damage.
fr.translation: Placez un bloc à ressort à côté d'un accélérateur, puis courez sur les deux blocs pour effectuer un bond prodigieux, au prix d'un atterrissage un peu brusque. Vous subirez des dégâts en retombant.

tips.text: Players who cooperate with their team win more matches.

pt.original: Players who cooperate with their team win more matches.
pt.translation: Os jogadores que cooperam com sua equipe vencem mais partidas.

ru.original: Players who cooperate with their team win more matches.
ru.translation: Игроки, сотрудничающие со своей командой, выигрывают больше матчей.

fr.original: Players who cooperate with their team win more matches.
fr.translation: Les joueurs qui coopèrent avec leur équipe ont tendance à remporter plus de parties.

de.original: Players who cooperate with their team win more matches.
de.translation: Spieler, die mit ihrem Team zusammenarbeiten, gewinnen mehr Matche.

es.original: Players who cooperate with their team win more matches.
es.translation: Coopera con tus compañeros para lograr la victoria.

tips.text: If your enemies have deployed Respawn Pads near your base, try to find them and take them out as soon as possible.

ru.original: If your enemies have deployed Respawn Pads near your base, try to find them and take them out as soon as possible.
ru.translation: Если противник установил площадки возрождения возле вашей базы, попробуй найти и уничтожить их как можно быстрее.

es.original: If your enemies have deployed Respawn Pads near your base, try to find them and take them out as soon as possible.
es.translation: Si tus enemigos colocaron bloques de reaparición cerca de tu núcleo, encuéntralos y elimínalos lo antes posible.

de.original: If your enemies have deployed Respawn Pads near your base, try to find them and take them out as soon as possible.
de.translation: Wenn deine Gegner Respawnfelder neben eurer Basis errichtet haben, solltest du sie so schnell wie möglich finden und zerstören.

pt.original: If your enemies have deployed Respawn Pads near your base, try to find them and take them out as soon as possible.
pt.translation: Se seus inimigos tiverem posicionado pontos de ressurgimento perto da sua base, tente encontrá-los e destruí-los o mais rápido possível.

fr.original: If your enemies have deployed Respawn Pads near your base, try to find them and take them out as soon as possible.
fr.translation: Si vos ennemis ont déployé des blocs de réapparition près de votre base, repérez-les et détruisez-les le plus vite possible.

tips.text: Remember that you can build Respawn Pads underground, but you'll need 2 blocks of vertical space for the pad to work.

ru.original: Remember that you can build Respawn Pads underground, but you'll need 2 blocks of vertical space for the pad to work.
ru.translation: Можно строить площадки возрождения под землей, но над ними должно быть два свободных блока, а иначе платформы не сработают.

es.original: Remember that you can build Respawn Pads underground, but you'll need 2 blocks of vertical space for the pad to work.
es.translation: Puedes colocar bloques de reaparición subterráneos, pero necesitarás al menos dos espacios verticales libres para que funcionen.

de.original: Remember that you can build Respawn Pads underground, but you'll need 2 blocks of vertical space for the pad to work.
de.translation: Du kannst Respawnfelder auch unterirdisch errichten. Damit sie funktionieren sind jedoch zwei senkrecht angeordnete, leere Blockfelder nötig.

pt.original: Remember that you can build Respawn Pads underground, but you'll need 2 blocks of vertical space for the pad to work.
pt.translation: Lembre-se de que você pode construir pontos de ressurgimento subterrâneos, mas precisa de 2 blocos de espaço vertical para que o ponto funcione.

fr.original: Remember that you can build Respawn Pads underground, but you'll need 2 blocks of vertical space for the pad to work.
fr.translation: N'oubliez pas que vous pouvez placer des blocs de réapparition sous terre, mais qu'il faut un espace libre équivalant à deux blocs au-dessus de ces blocs pour pouvoir les utiliser.

tips.text: Use your role blocks to support your team with supplies, healing, improved mobility, and tactical advantages.

ru.original: Use your role blocks to support your team with supplies, healing, improved mobility, and tactical advantages.
ru.translation: Используй блоки своего класса, чтобы помочь команде ресурсами, лечением, повышением подвижности и тактическим превосходством.

es.original: Use your role blocks to support your team with supplies, healing, improved mobility, and tactical advantages.
es.translation: Usa tus bloques exclusivos para darle apoyo a tu equipo mediante municiones, curaciones y ventajas tácticas.

de.original: Use your role blocks to support your team with supplies, healing, improved mobility, and tactical advantages.
de.translation: Nutze deine rollenspezifischen Blöcke, um dein Team mit Baumaterialien, Gesundheit, besserer Beweglichkeit und taktischen Vorteilen zu unterstützen.

pt.original: Use your role blocks to support your team with supplies, healing, improved mobility, and tactical advantages.
pt.translation: Use os blocos designados à sua função para ajudar sua equipe com suprimentos, cura, melhor mobilidade e vantagens táticas.

fr.original: Use your role blocks to support your team with supplies, healing, improved mobility, and tactical advantages.
fr.translation: Utilisez les blocs spécifiques à votre rôle pour aider votre équipe en lui apportant du matériel, des soins, une meilleure mobilité, et des avantages tactiques.

tips.text: Heroes have Passive and Active Abilities. You can learn more about them on the Hero's Shop page.

ru.original: Heroes have Passive and Active Abilities. You can learn more about them on the Hero's Shop page.
ru.translation: Герои обладают пассивными и активными способностями. Подробнее о них можно узнать в главном меню.

es.original: Heroes have Passive and Active Abilities. You can learn more about them on the Hero's Shop page.
es.translation: Todos los personajes tienen destrezas activas y pasivas. Para más información, consulta la sección correspondiente en la pestaña de la tienda.

de.original: Heroes have Passive and Active Abilities. You can learn more about them on the Hero's Shop page.
de.translation: Alle Helden verfügen über passive und aktive Fähigkeiten. Auf den Heldenseiten im Shop erfährst du mehr über sie.

pt.original: Heroes have Passive and Active Abilities. You can learn more about them on the Hero's Shop page.
pt.translation: Heróis possuem habilidades passivas e ativas. Você pode aprender mais sobre elas na página Loja do herói.

fr.original: Heroes have Passive and Active Abilities. You can learn more about them on the Hero's Shop page.
fr.translation: Chaque héros possède des capacités actives et passives. Vous trouverez plus d'informations à leur sujet dans la section Héros du magasin.

tips.text: Enemies spotted by Nigel's Spot Prey ability are exposed to all teammates.

ru.original: Enemies spotted by Nigel's Spot Prey ability are exposed to all teammates.
ru.translation: Враг, обнаруженный Nigel при помощи «Выслеживания», становится видимым для всей команды.

es.original: Enemies spotted by Nigel's Spot Prey ability are exposed to all teammates.
es.translation: Los enemigos que detecta Nigel mediante su destreza «Localizador de presas» son revelados a todos sus compañeros.

de.original: Enemies spotted by Nigel's Spot Prey ability are exposed to all teammates.
de.translation: Die Position aller durch Nigels Zielerfassung erspähten Gegner wird auch den anderen Teamkollegen angezeigt.

pt.original: Enemies spotted by Nigel's Spot Prey ability are exposed to all teammates.
pt.translation: Inimigos detectados pela habilidade Localizador de Presas de Nigel ficam expostos para todos os outros colegas de equipe.

fr.original: Enemies spotted by Nigel's Spot Prey ability are exposed to all teammates.
fr.translation: Les ennemis repérés par la capacité Ciblage de proie de Nigel peuvent être vus par tous ses coéquipiers.

tips.text: O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi can use hit and run tactics to wear down enemies with his bleeding attacks and active ability.

ru.original: O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi can use hit and run tactics to wear down enemies with his bleeding attacks and active ability.
ru.translation: O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi может применять тактику наскока и отхода, чтобы измотать врагов атаками, вызывающими кровотечение, и использованием активной способности.

es.original: O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi can use hit and run tactics to wear down enemies with his bleeding attacks and active ability.
es.translation: Una de las especialidades tácticas de Juan es atacar por sorpresa y huir rápidamente gracias a su destreza activa.

de.original: O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi can use hit and run tactics to wear down enemies with his bleeding attacks and active ability.
de.translation: O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi kann seine Gegner allmählich in die Knie zwingen, indem er sie überfallartig angreift und zum Bluten bringt.

pt.original: O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi can use hit and run tactics to wear down enemies with his bleeding attacks and active ability.
pt.translation: O.P. "Juan" Shinobi pode se utilizar de táticas evasivas para desgastar os inimigos com seus ataques de sangramento e sua habilidade ativa.

fr.original: O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi can use hit and run tactics to wear down enemies with his bleeding attacks and active ability.
fr.translation: O.P. 'Juan' Shinobi a recours à des attaques éclair pour épuiser ses ennemis avec ses effets de saignement et sa capacité active.

tips.text: Tony Turretto can repair teammates blocks and repair and buff his turrets with the caulk gun.

ru.original: Tony Turretto can repair teammates blocks and repair and buff his turrets with the caulk gun.
ru.translation: Tony Turretto может чинить блоки и турели участников своей команды при помощи суперклей-пушки. Во время починки турелей наносимый ими урон повышается.

es.original: Tony Turretto can repair teammates blocks and repair and buff his turrets with the caulk gun.
es.translation: Tony puede reparar bloques y torretas con la pistola selladora.

de.original: Tony Turretto can repair teammates blocks and repair and buff his turrets with the caulk gun.
de.translation: Tony Turretto kann Blöcke seiner Teamkollegen reparieren sowie seine Gefechtstürme mit der Fugenpistole reparieren und verstärken.

pt.original: Tony Turretto can repair teammates blocks and repair and buff his turrets with the caulk gun.
pt.translation: Tony Turretto pode reparar blocos de companheiro e aperfeiçoar suas torres de tiro com a arma de vedação.

fr.original: Tony Turretto can repair teammates blocks and repair and buff his turrets with the caulk gun.
fr.translation: Tony Turretto peut réparer les blocs de ses coéquipiers, ainsi que restaurer et améliorer ses tourelles avec son pistolet à colle.

tips.text: Tony Turretto can quickly establish a forward base with his Active Ability.

ru.original: Tony Turretto can quickly establish a forward base with his Active Ability.
ru.translation: Tony Turretto может быстро создать передовую базу с помощью своей активной способности.

es.original: Tony Turretto can quickly establish a forward base with his Active Ability.
es.translation: Tony puede erigir un puesto de avanzada rápidamente gracias a su destreza activa.

de.original: Tony Turretto can quickly establish a forward base with his Active Ability.
de.translation: Seine aktive Fähigkeit erlaubt es Tony Turretto, vorgeschobene Operationsbasen schnell zu errichten.

pt.original: Tony Turretto can quickly establish a forward base with his Active Ability.
pt.translation: Tony Turretto pode montar rapidamente uma base avançada com sua habilidade ativa.

fr.original: Tony Turretto can quickly establish a forward base with his Active Ability.
fr.translation: Tony Turretto peut établir une base avancée en un éclair grâce à sa capacité active.

tips.text: Doc Eliza can lob acid bubbles over enemy walls with the Globe Gun Alt-Fire.

ru.original: Doc Eliza can lob acid bubbles over enemy walls with the Globe Gun Alt-Fire.
ru.translation: Eliza может кидать кислотные шарики сквозь стены противника, используя альтернативный огонь Шариковой пушки.

es.original: Doc Eliza can lob acid bubbles over enemy walls with the Globe Gun Alt-Fire.
es.translation: Eliza puede usar la función secundaria de su lanzaesferas para arrojar burbujas de ácido por encima de los muros enemigos.

de.original: Doc Eliza can lob acid bubbles over enemy walls with the Globe Gun Alt-Fire.
de.translation: Mit dem alternativen Angriff des Säurekugelgewehrs kann Doc Eliza Säurekugeln über gegnerische Wände schießen.

pt.original: Doc Eliza can lob acid bubbles over enemy walls with the Globe Gun Alt-Fire.
pt.translation: Doc Eliza pode jogar bolhas de ácido por cima de muralhas inimigas com o tiro secundário da Arma de Glóbulos.

fr.original: Doc Eliza can lob acid bubbles over enemy walls with the Globe Gun Alt-Fire.
fr.translation: Doc Eliza peut lancer des bulles acides par-dessus les murs ennemis grâce à l'action secondaire de son fusil corrosif.

tips.text: Doc Eliza can force enemies out of a fortified position with her Chem Grenades.

ru.original: Doc Eliza can force enemies out of a fortified position with her Chem Grenades.
ru.translation: Eliza может заставить врагов покинуть убежище с помощью химических гранат.

es.original: Doc Eliza can force enemies out of a fortified position with her Chem Grenades.
es.translation: Eliza puede usar sus granadas químicas para desalojar una posición fortificada.

de.original: Doc Eliza can force enemies out of a fortified position with her Chem Grenades.
de.translation: Mit ihren Chemiegranaten kann Doc Eliza Gegner aus ihren Verteidigungspositionen treiben.

pt.original: Doc Eliza can force enemies out of a fortified position with her Chem Grenades.
pt.translation: Doc Eliza pode tirar inimigos de sua fortificações à força com suas Granadas Químicas.

fr.original: Doc Eliza can force enemies out of a fortified position with her Chem Grenades.
fr.translation: Doc Eliza peut forcer les ennemis à sortir d'une zone fortifiée grâce à ses grenades chimiques.

tips.text: Doc Eliza is good at pushing forward with her team and keeping them alive.

ru.original: Doc Eliza is good at pushing forward with her team and keeping them alive.
ru.translation: Eliza отлично показывает себя в атаке, поскольку она не даст товарищам умереть.

es.original: Doc Eliza is good at pushing forward with her team and keeping them alive.
es.translation: Una de las especialidades tácticas de Eliza es curar a sus compañeros de equipo.

de.original: Doc Eliza is good at pushing forward with her team and keeping them alive.
de.translation: Doc Eliza ist sehr gut im Vorrücken mit ihrem Team und sorgt dafür, dass ihre Teamkollegen am Leben bleiben.

pt.original: Doc Eliza is good at pushing forward with her team and keeping them alive.
pt.translation: Doc Eliza é excelente para avançar com sua equipe e manter seus companheiros vivos.

fr.original: Doc Eliza is good at pushing forward with her team and keeping them alive.
fr.translation: Doc Eliza est très efficace lorsqu'il s'agit de mener l'offensive avec son équipe tout en gardant ses alliés en vie.

tips.text: Having no more that one of each hero can provide a great symmetry in your team and make sure all roles are fulfilled.

fr.original: Having no more that one of each hero can provide a great symmetry in your team and make sure all roles are fulfilled.
fr.translation: Pour garantir le bon équilibre de votre équipe et une répartition des rôles adaptée, mieux vaut ne pas avoir plus d'un héros de chaque catégorie.

de.original: Having no more that one of each hero can provide a great symmetry in your team and make sure all roles are fulfilled.
de.translation: Wenn man jeden Helden jeweils nur einmal im Team hat, erreicht man die beste Balance und erfüllt alle wichtigen Rollen.

es.original: Having no more that one of each hero can provide a great symmetry in your team and make sure all roles are fulfilled.
es.translation: Es aconsejable tener un personaje de cada tipo en el equipo para cubrir todos los roles y diversificar ataque y defensa.

pt.original: Having no more that one of each hero can provide a great symmetry in your team and make sure all roles are fulfilled.
pt.translation: Ter somente um de cada herói na sua equipe pode propiciar um bom equilíbrio e garantir que todos os papéis serão cumpridos.

ru.original: Having no more that one of each hero can provide a great symmetry in your team and make sure all roles are fulfilled.
ru.translation: Для идеального баланса каждый герой в команде должен быть только один, так что следите за тем, чтобы все роли были заняты.

tips.text: Sometimes attacking solo won't end well. Team up and co-ordinate your attacks.

fr.original: Sometimes attacking solo won't end well. Team up and co-ordinate your attacks.
fr.translation: Les attaques solo peuvent parfois mal tourner. Coordonnez vos attaques avec celles de vos coéquipiers.

de.original: Sometimes attacking solo won't end well. Team up and co-ordinate your attacks.
de.translation: Manchmal ist es keine gute Idee, alleine anzugreifen. Koordiniere deine Angriffe mit deinen Teamkollegen!

es.original: Sometimes attacking solo won't end well. Team up and co-ordinate your attacks.
es.translation: Es aconsejable coordinar tus ataques en grupo, ya que al atacar por tu propia cuenta es poco probable que tengas éxito.

pt.original: Sometimes attacking solo won't end well. Team up and co-ordinate your attacks.
pt.translation: Às vezes, atacar sozinho não dá muito certo. Trabalhe com sua equipe para coordenar seus ataques.

ru.original: Sometimes attacking solo won't end well. Team up and co-ordinate your attacks.
ru.translation: Иногда нападение в одиночку ничем хорошим не заканчивается. Работай в команде и совместно разрабатывай стратегию.

tips.text: Your Block Tool is the key to damaging Cubes and Bases. Make sure to have it ready on that final push.

fr.original: Your Block Tool is the key to damaging Cubes and Bases. Make sure to have it ready on that final push.
fr.translation: Votre outil est essentiel pour détruire les cubes et les bases. Gardez-le à portée de main lors de l'assaut final.

de.original: Your Block Tool is the key to damaging Cubes and Bases. Make sure to have it ready on that final push.
de.translation: Dein Werkzeug ist unerlässlich beim Beschädigen von Generatoren und der Basis. Halte es also immer einsatzbereit.

es.original: Your Block Tool is the key to damaging Cubes and Bases. Make sure to have it ready on that final push.
es.translation: Recuerda usar tu herramienta para dañar los generadores y los núcleos.

pt.original: Your Block Tool is the key to damaging Cubes and Bases. Make sure to have it ready on that final push.
pt.translation: Sua ferramenta de escavação é essencial para danificar Cubos e Bases. Fique com ela à disposição naqueles momentos finais.

ru.original: Your Block Tool is the key to damaging Cubes and Bases. Make sure to have it ready on that final push.
ru.translation: Уничтожать кубы и базы лучше всего с помощью инструментов. Стоит приготовить его в конце боя.

tips.text: The BlockBuster Boost drops at set times in the match. Fight your opponents to pick it up and grant your team a boost!

fr.original: The BlockBuster Boost drops at set times in the match. Fight your opponents to pick it up and grant your team a boost!
fr.translation: Un Bloc-Xtra sera largué à certains moments précis pendant la partie. Affrontez vos adversaires pour le récupérer et rafler un bonus pour votre équipe !

de.original: The BlockBuster Boost drops at set times in the match. Fight your opponents to pick it up and grant your team a boost!
de.translation: Der Blockbuster wird zu bestimmten Zeiten losgelassen. Erreiche ihn schneller als deine Gegner und hol den Boost für dein Team!

es.original: The BlockBuster Boost drops at set times in the match. Fight your opponents to pick it up and grant your team a boost!
es.translation: Durante la partida caerán algunas megaprovisiones que pueden darle a tu equipo una gran ventaja sobre el enemigo. ¡Tómalas ante que tus adversarios!

pt.original: The BlockBuster Boost drops at set times in the match. Fight your opponents to pick it up and grant your team a boost!
pt.translation: O auxílio do superbloco é largado em determinados momentos da partida. Dispute os espólios com seus oponentes para ajudar a sua equipe!

ru.original: The BlockBuster Boost drops at set times in the match. Fight your opponents to pick it up and grant your team a boost!
ru.translation: Усиление «Суперблок» сбрасывается в определенное время матча. Стоит сражаться за него с противниками, чтобы получить усиление для своей команды!

tips.text: The Blockbuster must be destroyed before it can be picked up. Work with your team to destroy it quickly.

fr.original: The Blockbuster must be destroyed before it can be picked up. Work with your team to destroy it quickly.
fr.translation: Le Bloc-Xtra doit être détruit avant d'être récupéré. Faites équipe avec vos alliés pour le détruire rapidement.

de.original: The Blockbuster must be destroyed before it can be picked up. Work with your team to destroy it quickly.
de.translation: Der Blockbuster muss zerstört werden, bevor er genutzt werden kann. Arbeite mit deinem Team zusammen!

es.original: The Blockbuster must be destroyed before it can be picked up. Work with your team to destroy it quickly.
es.translation: Para acceder a las megaprovisiones, primero deberás destruir su exterior. Colabora con tu equipo para hacerlo más rápidamente.

pt.original: The Blockbuster must be destroyed before it can be picked up. Work with your team to destroy it quickly.
pt.translation: O Superbloco deve ser destruído antes que alguém o pegue. Trabalhe com sua equipe para destruí-lo rapidamente.

ru.original: The Blockbuster must be destroyed before it can be picked up. Work with your team to destroy it quickly.
ru.translation: Чтобы получить бонус от суперблока, его сначала нужно разбить. Для быстрого уничтожения работайте всей командой.

tips.text: Going AFK will get you kicked from the game. Don't be a bad sport!

fr.original: Going AFK will get you kicked from the game. Don't be a bad sport!
fr.translation: Une trop longue période d'inactivité entraînera votre exclusion de la partie. Ne soyez pas mauvais joueur !

de.original: Going AFK will get you kicked from the game. Don't be a bad sport!
de.translation: Wenn du zu lange AFK bist, wirst du aus dem Match geworfen. Sei kein Spielverderber!

es.original: Going AFK will get you kicked from the game. Don't be a bad sport!
es.translation: Si te ausentas de la partida, te expulsarán del juego.

pt.original: Going AFK will get you kicked from the game. Don't be a bad sport!
pt.translation: Você será expulso do jogo se ficar muito tempo longe do teclado. Não estrague a brincadeira!

ru.original: Going AFK will get you kicked from the game. Don't be a bad sport!
ru.translation: За отход от клавиатуры игрока исключают из матча. Воздерживайся от неспортивного поведения!

tips.text: Constant bad behaviour will result in a ban, restricting access to your games. Don't end up there!

fr.original: Constant bad behaviour will result in a ban, restricting access to your games. Don't end up there!
fr.translation: À force de mal vous comporter, vous finirez par vous faire exclure, ce qui limitera votre accès aux parties. Faites attention !

de.original: Constant bad behaviour will result in a ban, restricting access to your games. Don't end up there!
de.translation: Wenn du dich ständig daneben benimmst, wirst du verbannt und dein Spielzugang wird eingeschränkt. Lass es nicht dazu kommen!

es.original: Constant bad behaviour will result in a ban, restricting access to your games. Don't end up there!
es.translation: Si te comportas de manera inadecuada, te expulsarán del juego y se te prohibirá volver a ingresar.

pt.original: Constant bad behaviour will result in a ban, restricting access to your games. Don't end up there!
pt.translation: Maus comportamentos constantes resultam em banimento, restringindo acesso às suas partidas. Não vá parar lá!

ru.original: Constant bad behaviour will result in a ban, restricting access to your games. Don't end up there!
ru.translation: Если будешь вести себя плохо и дальше, окажешься на кладбище и не сможешь участвовать в матчах. Постарайся туда не попасть!

tips.text: There is always more than one way to the objective. If the main path is too well defended, create your own path.

fr.original: There is always more than one way to the objective. If the main path is too well defended, create your own path.
fr.translation: Il existe plusieurs façons d'atteindre un objectif. Si l'accès principal est trop bien gardé, créez-vous votre propre chemin.

de.original: There is always more than one way to the objective. If the main path is too well defended, create your own path.
de.translation: Es gibt immer mehr als einen Weg zum Angriffsziel. Wenn der Hauptweg zu gut verteidigt wird, dann bahn dir deinen eigenen!

es.original: There is always more than one way to the objective. If the main path is too well defended, create your own path.
es.translation: Siempre hay más de un modo de atacar a los objetivos. Si el camino principal está demasiado protegido, crea tu propio camino.

pt.original: There is always more than one way to the objective. If the main path is too well defended, create your own path.
pt.translation: Sempre existe mais de um caminho para chegar a um objetivo. Se o caminho principal estiver sendo muito bem defendido, crie o seu próprio caminho.

ru.original: There is always more than one way to the objective. If the main path is too well defended, create your own path.
ru.translation: К любой цели может быть несколько путей. Если основной путь хорошо защищен, просто создай новый.

tips.text: Build off of a ledge to create bridges, paving new access routes across arenas.

fr.original: Build off of a ledge to create bridges, paving new access routes across arenas.
fr.translation: Construisez un rebord pour bâtir des ponts, qui vous ouvriront de nouvelles voies pour traverser les arènes.

de.original: Build off of a ledge to create bridges, paving new access routes across arenas.
de.translation: Bau von einem Vorsprung aus, um Brücken zu errichten und so neue Routen durch die Arena zu kreieren.

es.original: Build off of a ledge to create bridges, paving new access routes across arenas.
es.translation: Construye pasarelas para crear puentes y establecer nuevas rutas de acceso.

pt.original: Build off of a ledge to create bridges, paving new access routes across arenas.
pt.translation: Construa um peitoril para criar pontes, pavimentando novas rotas de acesso para atravessar arenas.

ru.original: Build off of a ledge to create bridges, paving new access routes across arenas.
ru.translation: Строй мосты над расщелинами, чтобы создавать новые маршруты.

tips.text: Each hero has their own unique Hero Block. This block is always the first block in each hero's block load out.

fr.original: Each hero has their own unique Hero Block. This block is always the first block in each hero's block load out.
fr.translation: Chaque héros dispose d'un bloc spécial unique, qui apparaîtra toujours en premier dans la sélection de blocs proposée.

de.original: Each hero has their own unique Hero Block. This block is always the first block in each hero's block load out.
de.translation: Jeder Held hat seinen persönlichen Heldenblock. Er erscheint bei der Blockauswahl immer an erster Stelle.

es.original: Each hero has their own unique Hero Block. This block is always the first block in each hero's block load out.
es.translation: Cada personaje posee un tipo de bloque exclusivo. Dicho bloque aparece siempre en la primera posición del inventario elegido.

pt.original: Each hero has their own unique Hero Block. This block is always the first block in each hero's block load out.
pt.translation: Cada herói possui seu bloco especial exclusivo. Esse bloco é sempre o primeiro que aparece na lista de blocos de cada herói.

ru.original: Each hero has their own unique Hero Block. This block is always the first block in each hero's block load out.
ru.translation: У каждого героя есть свой уникальный блок. Он всегда находится на первом месте в снаряжении героя.

tips.text: Tony Turretto's Caulk Gun Alt-Fire repairs even faster at the cost of consuming more ammunition.

fr.original: Tony Turretto's Caulk Gun Alt-Fire repairs even faster at the cost of consuming more ammunition.
fr.translation: L'action secondaire du pistolet à colle de Tony Turretto peut réparer les blocs encore plus rapidement, mais cela consommera davantage de munitions.

de.original: Tony Turretto's Caulk Gun Alt-Fire repairs even faster at the cost of consuming more ammunition.
de.translation: Der alternative Angriff von Tony Turrettos Fugenpistole repariert auf Kosten von mehr Munition noch schneller.

es.original: Tony Turretto's Caulk Gun Alt-Fire repairs even faster at the cost of consuming more ammunition.
es.translation: El ataque alternativo de la pistola selladora de Tony repara más rápidamente a cambio de más municiones.

pt.original: Tony Turretto's Caulk Gun Alt-Fire repairs even faster at the cost of consuming more ammunition.
pt.translation: O tiro secundário da Arma de Vedação de Tony Turretto repara ainda mais rápido com um consumo maior de munição.

ru.original: Tony Turretto's Caulk Gun Alt-Fire repairs even faster at the cost of consuming more ammunition.
ru.translation: Пушка-конопатка Tony Turretto обладает альтернативным режимом, который ускоряет починку, но при этом расходуется больше боеприпасов.

tips.text: Sometimes it pays to let your enemies pass you by while you remain undetected and push on to the objective.

fr.original: Sometimes it pays to let your enemies pass you by while you remain undetected and push on to the objective.
fr.translation: Il est parfois plus avisé de ne pas attaquer les ennemis à proximité afin de ne pas vous faire repérer et poursuivre votre avancée vers votre objectif.

de.original: Sometimes it pays to let your enemies pass you by while you remain undetected and push on to the objective.
de.translation: Manchmal ist es vorteilhafter, Gegner an sich vorbeilaufen zu lassen, um dann unbemerkt zu den Zielen vorzurücken.

es.original: Sometimes it pays to let your enemies pass you by while you remain undetected and push on to the objective.
es.translation: A veces es preferible dejar que los enemigos pasen por delante sin que adviertan tu presencia y así seguir avanzando hacia el objetivo.

pt.original: Sometimes it pays to let your enemies pass you by while you remain undetected and push on to the objective.
pt.translation: Às vezes, vale a pena deixar seus inimigos passarem enquanto você se dirige ao objetivo e permanece oculto.

ru.original: Sometimes it pays to let your enemies pass you by while you remain undetected and push on to the objective.
ru.translation: Иногда стоит дать врагам пройти мимо, оставаясь незамеченным, после чего продолжить двигаться к цели.

tips.text: Look out for the radar trace icon in the bottom middle of the HUD alerting you to your presence on enemy radars.

fr.original: Look out for the radar trace icon in the bottom middle of the HUD alerting you to your presence on enemy radars.
fr.translation: Si l'icône de radar s'affiche au bas de l'écran, cela signifie que les radars ennemis peuvent vous repérer.

de.original: Look out for the radar trace icon in the bottom middle of the HUD alerting you to your presence on enemy radars.
de.translation: Halte ein Auge nach dem Radarverfolgungssymbol offen, das unten in der Mitte erscheint, wenn deine Position auf den gegnerischen Radaren angezeigt wird.

es.original: Look out for the radar trace icon in the bottom middle of the HUD alerting you to your presence on enemy radars.
es.translation: Si aparece el ícono de un radar en el panel inferior, significa que los radares enemigos te detectaron.

pt.original: Look out for the radar trace icon in the bottom middle of the HUD alerting you to your presence on enemy radars.
pt.translation: Fique de olho no ícone de detecção de radares que aparece na parte central inferior da sua tela, alertando sua presença em radares inimigos.

ru.original: Look out for the radar trace icon in the bottom middle of the HUD alerting you to your presence on enemy radars.
ru.translation: Следи за значком обнаружения радаром, появляющимся внизу экрана посредине. Он предупреждает о том, что радары противника тебя засекли.

tips.text: Build walls around the sides of Tony Turretto's turrets to protect them from ranged attacks and focus their fire.

fr.original: Build walls around the sides of Tony Turretto's turrets to protect them from ranged attacks and focus their fire.
fr.translation: Construisez des murs autour des tourelles de Tony Turretto pour les protéger des attaques à distance et guider leur angle de tir.

de.original: Build walls around the sides of Tony Turretto's turrets to protect them from ranged attacks and focus their fire.
de.translation: Bau Mauern um Tony Turrettos Gefechtstürme herum, um sie vor Fernangriffen zu schützen und ihr Feuer zu fokussieren.

es.original: Build walls around the sides of Tony Turretto's turrets to protect them from ranged attacks and focus their fire.
es.translation: Levanta muros a los lados de las torretas para protegerlas de ataques a distancia y concentrar sus disparos.

pt.original: Build walls around the sides of Tony Turretto's turrets to protect them from ranged attacks and focus their fire.
pt.translation: Construa muros em volta das torres de tiro de Tony Turretto para protegê-las de ataques à distância e para concentrar seus disparos.

ru.original: Build walls around the sides of Tony Turretto's turrets to protect them from ranged attacks and focus their fire.
ru.translation: Строй стены вокруг турелей Tony Turretto, чтобы защитить их от уничтожения противником и сузить сектор обстрела.

tips.text: Place Tony Turretto's turrets in pill boxes to conceal their location and protect them from ranged attacks and mortar fire.

fr.original: Place Tony Turretto's turrets in pill boxes to conceal their location and protect them from ranged attacks and mortar fire.
fr.translation: Abritez les tourelles de Tony Turretto afin de les cacher et de les protéger des attaques à distance et des tirs de mortier.

de.original: Place Tony Turretto's turrets in pill boxes to conceal their location and protect them from ranged attacks and mortar fire.
de.translation: Bau Mauern um Tony Turrettos Gefechtstürme herum, um sie zu verstecken und vor Fernangriffen und Granatwerfern zu schützen.

es.original: Place Tony Turretto's turrets in pill boxes to conceal their location and protect them from ranged attacks and mortar fire.
es.translation: Coloca las torretas dentro de fortines para esconder su ubicación y protegerlas del fuego enemigo.

pt.original: Place Tony Turretto's turrets in pill boxes to conceal their location and protect them from ranged attacks and mortar fire.
pt.translation: Coloque as torres de tiro de Tony Turretto sobre estações de cura para mantê-las escondidas, bem como protegê-las de ataques a distância e tiros de morteiro.

ru.original: Place Tony Turretto's turrets in pill boxes to conceal their location and protect them from ranged attacks and mortar fire.
ru.translation: Строй турели Tony Turretto в блиндажах, чтобы скрыть их местоположение и защитить от огня мортир и уничтожения издалека.

tips.text: Try not to place mines too close together! They will set each other off in a chain reaction. Unless that's what you want, of course!

fr.original: Try not to place mines too close together! They will set each other off in a chain reaction. Unless that's what you want, of course!
fr.translation: Évitez de placer des mines trop proches les unes des autres, car si l'une d'elles explose, cela déclenchera une réaction en chaîne. Sauf si c'est que vous voulez, bien sûr !

de.original: Try not to place mines too close together! They will set each other off in a chain reaction. Unless that's what you want, of course!
de.translation: Platziere Minen nicht zu nahe beieinander, sonst lösen sie sich in einer Kettenreaktion gegenseitig aus! Es sei denn natürlich, das ist deine Absicht!

es.original: Try not to place mines too close together! They will set each other off in a chain reaction. Unless that's what you want, of course!
es.translation: No es recomendable colocar minas demasiado cerca entre sí, ya que eso provocará una reacción en cadena, a menos que ese sea tu plan.

pt.original: Try not to place mines too close together! They will set each other off in a chain reaction. Unless that's what you want, of course!
pt.translation: Tente não colocar minas muito próximas uma da outra, pois elas se detonam em cadeia! A menos que seja isso que você queira, é claro!

ru.original: Try not to place mines too close together! They will set each other off in a chain reaction. Unless that's what you want, of course!
ru.translation: Не ставь мины слишком близко друг от друга, иначе взрыв одной из них может вызвать цепную реакцию. Ты же не хочешь потерять все мины сразу!

tips.text: Dig a pit right down to the lava and cover with Fake Blocks for an insta-death trap.

fr.original: Dig a pit right down to the lava and cover with Fake Blocks for an insta-death trap.
fr.translation: Creusez un puits ouvert sur la lave et recouvrez-le de blocs factices pour en faire un piège mortel.

de.original: Dig a pit right down to the lava and cover with Fake Blocks for an insta-death trap.
de.translation: Grab eine Grube bis runter zur Lava und bedecke sie mit Blockattrappen, um deine Gegner in den sofortigen Tod zu schicken.

es.original: Dig a pit right down to the lava and cover with Fake Blocks for an insta-death trap.
es.translation: Cava una fosa profunda que llegue hasta la lava y cúbrela con bloques falsos para matar a tus rivales al instante.

pt.original: Dig a pit right down to the lava and cover with Fake Blocks for an insta-death trap.
pt.translation: Cave um poço diretamente para a lava e cubra-o com blocos falsos para montar uma armadilha de morte instantânea.

ru.original: Dig a pit right down to the lava and cover with Fake Blocks for an insta-death trap.
ru.translation: Можно выкопать яму до самой лавы и скрыть ее с помощью ложных блоков, создав ловушку, мгновенно убивающую врагов.

tips.text: Want to become an expert in an arena? Jump into a 'Custom Game' and play the arena in your own time.

fr.original: Want to become an expert in an arena? Jump into a 'Custom Game' and play the arena in your own time.
fr.translation: Vous voulez connaître les arènes comme votre poche ? Créez une partie personnalisée et découvrez l'arène sous toutes les coutures.

de.original: Want to become an expert in an arena? Jump into a 'Custom Game' and play the arena in your own time.
de.translation: Möchtest du Experte für eine Arena werden? Dann erstell ein 'Eigenes Match' und schau dir jeden Winkel in aller Ruhe an.

es.original: Want to become an expert in an arena? Jump into a 'Custom Game' and play the arena in your own time.
es.translation: Usa el «Modo personalizado» para practicar y perfeccionar tu estilo de juego.

pt.original: Want to become an expert in an arena? Jump into a 'Custom Game' and play the arena in your own time.
pt.translation: Quer se tornar um perito em uma arena? Entre numa "Partida Personalizada" e jogue na arena no seu próprio ritmo.

ru.original: Want to become an expert in an arena? Jump into a 'Custom Game' and play the arena in your own time.
ru.translation: Хочешь досконально изучить какую-либо карту? Создай «свою игру» и играй на ней сколько угодно.

tips.text: Aim for the head for critical damage! Ding!

fr.original: Aim for the head for critical damage! Ding!
fr.translation: Visez la tête pour infliger des dégâts critiques ! Ding !

de.original: Aim for the head for critical damage! Ding!
de.translation: Ziel auf den Kopf, um kritischen Schaden auszulösen!

es.original: Aim for the head for critical damage! Ding!
es.translation: ¡Apunta a la cabeza para causar más daño!

pt.original: Aim for the head for critical damage! Ding!
pt.translation: Mire na cabeça para causar danos críticos! Pei!

ru.original: Aim for the head for critical damage! Ding!
ru.translation: Целься в голову, чтобы нанести критический урон!

tips.text: Teammates perform worse if you harass them after a mistake.

pt.original: Teammates perform worse if you harass them after a mistake.
pt.translation: Os companheiros têm um desempenho pior quando você não perdoa os seus erros.

ru.original: Teammates perform worse if you harass them after a mistake.
ru.translation: Участники команды работают хуже, если укорять их за каждую ошибку.

fr.original: Teammates perform worse if you harass them after a mistake.
fr.translation: Vos coéquipiers joueront moins bien si vous les harcelez après qu'ils ont fait une erreur.

de.original: Teammates perform worse if you harass them after a mistake.
de.translation: Teamkollegen spielen schlechter, wenn du sie nach einem Fehler fertigmachst.

es.original: Teammates perform worse if you harass them after a mistake.
es.translation: No maltrates a los compañeros que hayan cometido un error.

tips.text: Don't run away - disarm an enemy bomb with your digging tool!

fr.original: Don't run away - disarm an enemy bomb with your digging tool!
fr.translation: Ne fuyez pas, désarmez une bombe ennemie avec votre outil !

de.original: Don't run away - disarm an enemy bomb with your digging tool!
de.translation: Hier wird nicht weggelaufen! Entschärfe gegnerische Bomben mit deinem Werkzeug!

es.original: Don't run away - disarm an enemy bomb with your digging tool!
es.translation: Al toparte con una bomba enemiga, intenta desactivarla con tu herramienta en vez de huir.

pt.original: Don't run away - disarm an enemy bomb with your digging tool!
pt.translation: Não saia correndo - desarme uma bomba do inimigo com sua ferramenta de escavação!

ru.original: Don't run away - disarm an enemy bomb with your digging tool!
ru.translation: Нужно не убегать от бомб противника, а попробовать обезвредить их при помощи инструментов.

tips.text: Dig a hole and hide objects like Radars, Heal Stations and Ammo Crates.

fr.original: Dig a hole and hide objects like Radars, Heal Stations and Ammo Crates.
fr.translation: Creusez un trou pour y cacher des radars, des stations de soins et des caisses de munitions.

de.original: Dig a hole and hide objects like Radars, Heal Stations and Ammo Crates.
de.translation: Grab eine Grube und versteck Objekte wie Radare, Heilstationen oder Munitionskisten darin.

es.original: Dig a hole and hide objects like Radars, Heal Stations and Ammo Crates.
es.translation: Cava una fosa para esconder radares, bloques curativos o municiones bajo tierra.

pt.original: Dig a hole and hide objects like Radars, Heal Stations and Ammo Crates.
pt.translation: Cave um buraco e esconda objetos, como radares, blocos de cura e caixotes de munição.

ru.original: Dig a hole and hide objects like Radars, Heal Stations and Ammo Crates.
ru.translation: Копай ямы и прячь в них радары, лечебные блоки и ящики с боеприпасами.

tips.text: Need more brick resources to build more blocks? Get digging!

fr.original: Need more brick resources to build more blocks? Get digging!
fr.translation: Vous avez besoin de plus de ressources pour construire des blocs ? Au boulot, il faut creuser !

de.original: Need more brick resources to build more blocks? Get digging!
de.translation: Brauchst du mehr Ressourcen, um Blöcke zu bauen? Dann ab ans Graben!

es.original: Need more brick resources to build more blocks? Get digging!
es.translation: ¿Necesitas más recursos para construir más bloques? ¡Ponte a cavar!

pt.original: Need more brick resources to build more blocks? Get digging!
pt.translation: Precisa de mais recursos para construir mais blocos? Comece a escavar a arena!

ru.original: Need more brick resources to build more blocks? Get digging!
ru.translation: Не хватает кирпичных ресурсов для строительства блоков? Тогда копай!

tips.text: Your teammates' bullets won't hurt you, but in Ranked mode their explosives will! Be careful with globe-guns, rocket-launchers, and cannons.

fr.original: Your teammates' bullets won't hurt you, but in Ranked mode their explosives will! Be careful with globe-guns, rocket-launchers, and cannons.
fr.translation: Les balles de vos coéquipiers ne vous infligeront pas de dégâts, mais ce n'est pas le cas de leurs explosifs en mode Classé ! Faites attention aux fusils corrosifs, lance-roquettes et canons.

de.original: Your teammates' bullets won't hurt you, but in Ranked mode their explosives will! Be careful with globe-guns, rocket-launchers, and cannons.
de.translation: Die Kugeln deiner Teamkollegen verletzen dich nicht, ihre Explosionen in der Liga allerdings schon! Vorsicht bei Säurekugelgewehren, Raketenwerfern und Kanonen!

es.original: Your teammates' bullets won't hurt you, but in Ranked mode their explosives will! Be careful with globe-guns, rocket-launchers, and cannons.
es.translation: Los disparos de tus compañeros no te harán daño, pero sus explosivos sí en el modo clasificatorio. Ten cuidado con los lanzaesferas, lanzacohetes y cañones.

pt.original: Your teammates' bullets won't hurt you, but in Ranked mode their explosives will! Be careful with globe-guns, rocket-launchers, and cannons.
pt.translation: As balas dos seus companheiros de equipe não machucam você, mas no Modo Classificatório os explosivos machucam! Tome cuidado com armas de glóbulos, lança-foguetes e canhões.

ru.original: Your teammates' bullets won't hurt you, but in Ranked mode their explosives will! Be careful with globe-guns, rocket-launchers, and cannons.
ru.translation: Пули товарищей не причинят тебе вреда, а вот все, что взрывается, может. Остерегайся пушек и базук.

tips.text: Players perform better if you give them constructive feedback after a mistake.

pt.original: Players perform better if you give them constructive feedback after a mistake.
pt.translation: Os jogadores têm um desempenho melhor quando você dá opiniões construtivas sobre um erro.

ru.original: Players perform better if you give them constructive feedback after a mistake.
ru.translation: Игроки будут играть лучше, если после совершения ошибки получат от тебя конструктивный отзыв.

fr.original: Players perform better if you give them constructive feedback after a mistake.
fr.translation: Vos coéquipiers joueront mieux si vous leur faites des commentaires constructifs après qu'ils ont fait une erreur.

de.original: Players perform better if you give them constructive feedback after a mistake.
de.translation: Spieler werden besser, wenn du ihnen konstruktives Feedback nach einem Fehler gibst.

es.original: Players perform better if you give them constructive feedback after a mistake.
es.translation: Si un compañero cometió un error, bríndale una crítica constructiva en lugar de maltratarlo.

tips.text: Astarella’s Active Ability can increase the movement speed of nearby teammates. Use it at the start of a game for a quick start!

de.original: Astarella’s Active Ability can increase the movement speed of nearby teammates. Use it at the start of a game for a quick start!
de.translation: Astarellas aktive Fähigkeit kann nahe Teamkollegen beschleunigen. Nutze sie am Anfang des Spiels für einen schnellen Start!

es.original: Astarella’s Active Ability can increase the movement speed of nearby teammates. Use it at the start of a game for a quick start!
es.translation: La destreza activa «Impulso meteórico» de Astarella acelera a todos sus aliados cercanos. ¡Úsala al comienzo de una partida para empezar rápidamente!

pt.original: Astarella’s Active Ability can increase the movement speed of nearby teammates. Use it at the start of a game for a quick start!
pt.translation: A habilidade ativa de Astarella pode aumentar a velocidade dos seus companheiro de equipe próximos. Use-a no início do jogo para dar uma arrancada!

fr.original: Astarella’s Active Ability can increase the movement speed of nearby teammates. Use it at the start of a game for a quick start!
fr.translation: La capacité active d'Astarella fait gagner en vitesse ses coéquipiers à proximité. Utilisez-la en début de partie pour commencer sur les chapeaux de roue !

ru.original: Astarella’s Active Ability can increase the movement speed of nearby teammates. Use it at the start of a game for a quick start!
ru.translation: Активная способность Astarella может повысить скорость передвижения участников команды, находящихся рядом. Используй ее в начале игры для быстрого старта!

tips.text: Astarella’s double jump Passive Ability makes it easy to cross Arenas.

de.original: Astarella’s double jump Passive Ability makes it easy to cross Arenas.
de.translation: Durch Astarellas Doppelsprung kommst du einfach durch die Arena.

es.original: Astarella’s double jump Passive Ability makes it easy to cross Arenas.
es.translation: El salto doble de Astarella le permite cruzar los escenarios con facilidad.

pt.original: Astarella’s double jump Passive Ability makes it easy to cross Arenas.
pt.translation: A habilidade passiva de salto duplo de Astarella facilita a travessia de arenas.

fr.original: Astarella’s double jump Passive Ability makes it easy to cross Arenas.
fr.translation: La capacité passive Bottes fusées d'Astarella lui permet de traverser les arènes en un clin d'œil.

ru.original: Astarella’s double jump Passive Ability makes it easy to cross Arenas.
ru.translation: Astarella может быстро попасть в другой конец поля боя — для этого она использует пассивную способность двойного прыжка.

tips.text: Astarella’s Saucer Launcher can be used to create a huge explosion. Trigger them all remotely for a huge explosion!

de.original: Astarella’s Saucer Launcher can be used to create a huge explosion. Trigger them all remotely for a huge explosion!
de.translation: Astarellas fliegende Untertassen explodieren! Löse mit ihnen aus der Entfernung riesige Explosionen aus!

es.original: Astarella’s Saucer Launcher can be used to create a huge explosion. Trigger them all remotely for a huge explosion!
es.translation: El lanzaplatillos de Astarella puede usarse para crear una gran explosión. ¡Actívalos a distancia para demoler una zona!

pt.original: Astarella’s Saucer Launcher can be used to create a huge explosion. Trigger them all remotely for a huge explosion!
pt.translation: O Lança-discos de Astarella pode ser usado para criar uma enorme explosão. Dispare todos à distância para uma explosão arrasadora!

fr.original: Astarella’s Saucer Launcher can be used to create a huge explosion. Trigger them all remotely for a huge explosion!
fr.translation: Le lance-soucoupes d'Astarella peut créer une explosion impressionnante. Lancez-les toutes à distance pour tout faire sauter !

ru.original: Astarella’s Saucer Launcher can be used to create a huge explosion. Trigger them all remotely for a huge explosion!
ru.translation: Astarella может взрывать бомбы на расстоянии. Она просто стреляет по ним из тарелкомета, и всё взлетает на воздух!

tips.text: Sweet Science’s Blitz Stance can charge a dash attack to travel or destroy anything in his way.

de.original: Sweet Science’s Blitz Stance can charge a dash attack to travel or destroy anything in his way.
de.translation: Mit seiner Kobrahaltung kann Sweet Science einen Sturmangriff zum schnellen Reisen oder Zerstören ausführen.

es.original: Sweet Science’s Blitz Stance can charge a dash attack to travel or destroy anything in his way.
es.translation: Gracias a «Puños de mármol», Sweet Science carga un ataque en el que corre y destruye lo que se le cruza en su camino.

pt.original: Sweet Science’s Blitz Stance can charge a dash attack to travel or destroy anything in his way.
pt.translation: A Postura Relâmpago de Sweet Science pode carregar um ataque de investida para se locomover ou destruir qualquer coisa em seu caminho.

fr.original: Sweet Science’s Blitz Stance can charge a dash attack to travel or destroy anything in his way.
fr.translation: Grâce à Combat éclair, Sweet Science peut lancer une attaque éclair pour se déplacer ou tout détruire sur son passage.

ru.original: Sweet Science’s Blitz Stance can charge a dash attack to travel or destroy anything in his way.
ru.translation: Если Sweet Science хочет быстро попасть в нужное место или смести все и вся со своего пути, он просто принимает стойку «Молния», а затем стремительно бросается вперед.

tips.text: Players who curse at teammates lose more matches.

pt.original: Players who curse at teammates lose more matches.
pt.translation: Os jogadores que xingam os companheiros perdem mais partidas.

ru.original: Players who curse at teammates lose more matches.
ru.translation: Игроки, которые насылают проклятия на участников свеой команды, чаще проигрывают.

fr.original: Players who curse at teammates lose more matches.
fr.translation: Les joueurs qui insultent leurs coéquipiers ont tendance à perdre plus de parties.

de.original: Players who curse at teammates lose more matches.
de.translation: Spieler, die ihre Teamkollegen beschimpfen, verlieren mehr Matche.

es.original: Players who curse at teammates lose more matches.
es.translation: No insultes a tus compañeros.

tips.text: Sweet Science’s Gravity Well makes for a deadly trap, combine with a Land Mine for massive damage.

de.original: Sweet Science’s Gravity Well makes for a deadly trap, combine with a Land Mine for massive damage.
de.translation: Das Gravitationsfeld von Sweet Science ist eine tödliche Falle. Kombinier sie mit Landminen, um massiven Schaden anzurichten.

es.original: Sweet Science’s Gravity Well makes for a deadly trap, combine with a Land Mine for massive damage.
es.translation: Para crear una trampa mortal, combina un «Pozo gravitatorio» de Sweet Science con una mina terrestre.

pt.original: Sweet Science’s Gravity Well makes for a deadly trap, combine with a Land Mine for massive damage.
pt.translation: O Poço Gravitacional de Sweet Science forma uma armadilha mortal. Combine-o com uma mina terrestre para causar danos substanciais.

fr.original: Sweet Science’s Gravity Well makes for a deadly trap, combine with a Land Mine for massive damage.
fr.translation: Le puits gravitationnel de Sweet Science constitue un piège diabolique. Combinez-le à une mine terrestre pour des dégâts spectaculaires.

ru.original: Sweet Science’s Gravity Well makes for a deadly trap, combine with a Land Mine for massive damage.
ru.translation: Когда Sweet Science хочет разнести врага в пух и прах, он закладывает мину, а затем активирует гравитационный колодец.

tips.text: Sweet Science gains a shield from sprinting. Use this to reduce incoming damage

de.original: Sweet Science gains a shield from sprinting. Use this to reduce incoming damage
de.translation: Beim Sprinten ist Sweet Science durch einen Schild geschützt. Nutze ihn, um weniger Schaden zu erleiden.

es.original: Sweet Science gains a shield from sprinting. Use this to reduce incoming damage
es.translation: Sweet Science se vuelve inmune al correr. Usa esta característica para reducir el daño.

pt.original: Sweet Science gains a shield from sprinting. Use this to reduce incoming damage
pt.translation: Sweet Science obtém um escudo quando dá uma arrancada. Use-o para reduzir danos recebidos.

fr.original: Sweet Science gains a shield from sprinting. Use this to reduce incoming damage
fr.translation: Sweet Science est protégé par un bouclier lorsqu'il court. Idéal pour réduire les dégâts subis.

ru.original: Sweet Science gains a shield from sprinting. Use this to reduce incoming damage
ru.translation: Чем больше Sweet Science бегает, тем лучше он защищен. А всё потому, что вокруг него образуется силовое поле.

tips.text: Dream Genie can throw blocks! Combine this with a Big Bomb to make life painful for your enemies.

de.original: Dream Genie can throw blocks! Combine this with a Big Bomb to make life painful for your enemies.
de.translation: Dream Genie kann Blöcke werfen! Kombiniere sie mit großen Bomben, um deinen Gegnern das Leben schwer zu machen.

es.original: Dream Genie can throw blocks! Combine this with a Big Bomb to make life painful for your enemies.
es.translation: Dream Genie puede construir bloques a distancia. Coloca bombas desde lejos para hacerle la vida más difícil a tus enemigos.

pt.original: Dream Genie can throw blocks! Combine this with a Big Bomb to make life painful for your enemies.
pt.translation: Dream Genie pode lançar blocos! Combine essa habilidade com uma Bomba Grande para tornar a vida de seus inimigos muito mais sofrida.

fr.original: Dream Genie can throw blocks! Combine this with a Big Bomb to make life painful for your enemies.
fr.translation: Dream Genie peut lancer des blocs ! Combinée à l'utilisation de bombes, cette capacité va transformer la vie de vos ennemis en cauchemar.

ru.original: Dream Genie can throw blocks! Combine this with a Big Bomb to make life painful for your enemies.
ru.translation: Dream Genie может бросаться блоками, а если он начнет швыряться еще и большими бомбами, врагам мало места будет.

tips.text: Dream Genie’s Ifrit’s Grudge unleashes a slow but heavy orb dealing damage to enemies in its path making for a great defensive weapon.

de.original: Dream Genie’s Ifrit’s Grudge unleashes a slow but heavy orb dealing damage to enemies in its path making for a great defensive weapon.
de.translation: Mit 'Ifrits Rache' löst Dream Genie eine große, langsame Kugel aus, die alles in ihrem Weg zerstört. Eine super Waffe für die Defensive!

es.original: Dream Genie’s Ifrit’s Grudge unleashes a slow but heavy orb dealing damage to enemies in its path making for a great defensive weapon.
es.translation: Al ejecutar la «Venganza del ifrit», Dream Genie lanza una esfera grande y lenta que daña a los enemigos que se crucen en su camino.

pt.original: Dream Genie’s Ifrit’s Grudge unleashes a slow but heavy orb dealing damage to enemies in its path making for a great defensive weapon.
pt.translation: O Rancor de Ifrit de Dream Genie lança um orbe lento e pesado que causa danos em inimigos em seu caminho, sendo uma excelente arma defensiva.

fr.original: Dream Genie’s Ifrit’s Grudge unleashes a slow but heavy orb dealing damage to enemies in its path making for a great defensive weapon.
fr.translation: Rancune d'ifrit permet à Dream Genie de projeter un orbe lent et lourd qui inflige des dégâts aux ennemis sur son chemin. Une arme défensive parfaite.

ru.original: Dream Genie’s Ifrit’s Grudge unleashes a slow but heavy orb dealing damage to enemies in its path making for a great defensive weapon.
ru.translation: Если Dream Genie нужно отразить атаку врага, он швыряет в него увесистую сферу, которая хоть и летит медленно, но легко может сразить противника наповал. Эта способность называется «Гнев ифрита».

tips.text: You can see your Brick total in the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

de.original: You can see your Brick total in the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
de.translation: Links unten im Spielfenster siehst du, wie viele Bausteine du hast. Grab für mehr Bausteine!

es.original: You can see your Brick total in the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

pt.original: You can see your Brick total in the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais tijolos.

fr.original: You can see your Brick total in the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
fr.translation: Votre nombre total de briques est affiché en bas à gauche de l'écran. Creusez pour en récupérer davantage.

ru.original: You can see your Brick total in the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
ru.translation: Общее количество кирпичей указано в левом нижнем углу экрана. Копай, чтобы получить больше кирпичей.

tips.text: Heroes with long-range weapons, such as Nigel's "Nellie" rifle, can take out turrets from a safe distance.

pt.original: Heroes with long-range weapons, such as Nigel's "Nellie" rifle, can take out turrets from a safe distance.
pt.translation: Heróis com armas de longo alcance, como o rifle Nellie de Nigel, podem destruir torres de tiro de longe.

ru.original: Heroes with long-range weapons, such as Nigel's "Nellie" rifle, can take out turrets from a safe distance.
ru.translation: Герои с оружием дальнего боя, вроде Nigel и его винтовки Нелли, могут уничтожать турели с безопасного расстояния.

fr.original: Heroes with long-range weapons, such as Nigel's "Nellie" rifle, can take out turrets from a safe distance.
fr.translation: Les héros armés d'armes de longue portée, comme Lucille, le fusil de Nigel, peuvent éliminer des tourelles à distance.

de.original: Heroes with long-range weapons, such as Nigel's "Nellie" rifle, can take out turrets from a safe distance.
de.translation: Helden mit Distanz-Waffen, wie Nigels Gewehr Nellie, können Gefechtstürme aus sicherer Entfernung zerstören.

es.original: Heroes with long-range weapons, such as Nigel's "Nellie" rifle, can take out turrets from a safe distance.
es.translation: Los personajes que tienen armas de larga distancia, como Nigel y su escopeta, pueden derribar torretas a la distancia de manera segura.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.

de.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_HEROINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Helden anzusehen.

es.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_HEROINFO> para ver información detallada del personaje elegido.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_HEROINFO> no jogo para ver informações detalhadas sobre o herói selecionado.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_HEROINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le héros sélectionné.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_HEROINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном герое.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.

de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_DEVICEINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Block anzusehen.

es.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> para ver información detallada del bloque elegido.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> no jogo para ver informações sobre o bloco selecionado.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le bloc sélectionné.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном блоке.

tip_text.text: Cogwheel is very tough but moves slowly.

ru.original: Cogwheel is very tough but moves slowly.
ru.translation: Cogwheel — очень крепкий парень, но двигается медленно.

es.original: Cogwheel is very tough but moves slowly.
es.translation: Cogwheel es muy resistente pero también es muy lento.

de.original: Cogwheel is very tough but moves slowly.
de.translation: Cogwheel ist sehr robust, dafür aber auch relativ langsam.

pt.original: Cogwheel is very tough but moves slowly.
pt.translation: Cogwheel é bem durão, mas se move lentamente.

fr.original: Cogwheel is very tough but moves slowly.
fr.translation: Cogwheel est très résistant, mais se déplace lentement.

tip_text.text: Radars are important for spotting enemy Heroes and blocks. Place plenty around your base!

de.original: Radars are important for spotting enemy Heroes and blocks. Place plenty around your base!
de.translation: Radare sind wichtig, um Gegner und Blöcke zu finden. Errichte viele von ihnen bei eurer Basis!

es.original: Radars are important for spotting enemy Heroes and blocks. Place plenty around your base!
es.translation: Los radares sirven para detectar jugadores y bloques enemigos. ¡Coloca muchos cerca de tu núcleo!

pt.original: Radars are important for spotting enemy Heroes and blocks. Place plenty around your base!
pt.translation: Radares são importantes para detectar heróis inimigos e blocos. Posicione vários deles em volta da sua Base!

fr.original: Radars are important for spotting enemy Heroes and blocks. Place plenty around your base!
fr.translation: Les radars sont essentiels pour repérer les ennemis et leurs blocs. Placez-en plusieurs autour de votre base !

ru.original: Radars are important for spotting enemy Heroes and blocks. Place plenty around your base!
ru.translation: Радары нужны для того, чтобы засекать вражеских героев и блоки. Обязательно поставь побольше вокруг своей базы!

tip_text.text: Cogwheel's main fire modes are better at mid-range combat while the Alt-Fire modes are more suited to short range combat.

ru.original: Cogwheel's main fire modes are better at mid-range combat while the Alt-Fire modes are more suited to short range combat.
ru.translation: Основный режим огня, используемый Cogwheel, лучше подходит для средней дальности, а альтернативный огонь — для ближнего боя.

es.original: Cogwheel's main fire modes are better at mid-range combat while the Alt-Fire modes are more suited to short range combat.
es.translation: El modo de disparo principal de Cogwheel es más eficaz en el combate a media distancia, mientras que el modo alternativo es mejor para combates a corta distancia.

de.original: Cogwheel's main fire modes are better at mid-range combat while the Alt-Fire modes are more suited to short range combat.
de.translation: Cogwheels Hauptangriffsmodi eignen sich am besten für den Kampf auf mittlere Distanz, während seine alternativen Angriffe im Nahkampf am verheerendsten sind.

pt.original: Cogwheel's main fire modes are better at mid-range combat while the Alt-Fire modes are more suited to short range combat.
pt.translation: Os modos de tiro primário de Cogwheel são melhores em combate de médio alcance, e os modos de tiro secundário são mais adequados para combate de curto alcance.

fr.original: Cogwheel's main fire modes are better at mid-range combat while the Alt-Fire modes are more suited to short range combat.
fr.translation: Les modes de tir principaux de Cogwheel sont plus efficaces sur de moyennes distances, tandis que les modes de tir secondaires conviennent davantage à des combats rapprochés.

tip_text.text: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

de.translation: Deine Waffe kannst du mit <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> wechseln.

es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> para cambiar de arma.

pt.translation: Troque de armas com <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

fr.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
fr.translation: Changez d'arme en appuyant sur la touche <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

ru.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
ru.translation: Менять оружие можно при помощи «<BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>».

tip_text.text: Cogwheel is really strong in 1v1 close-up battles with his Rotary Cannon alt-fire (<BINDING_CAST2>).

de.original: Cogwheel is really strong in 1v1 close-up battles with his Rotary Cannon alt-fire (<BINDING_CAST2>).
de.translation: Durch den alternativen Angriff seiner Rotationskanone (<BINDING_CAST2>) ist Cogwheel sehr gut im direkten Zweikampf.

es.original: Cogwheel is really strong in 1v1 close-up battles with his Rotary Cannon alt-fire (<BINDING_CAST2>).

pt.original: Cogwheel is really strong in 1v1 close-up battles with his Rotary Cannon alt-fire (<BINDING_CAST2>).
pt.translation: Cogwheel é muito forte em batalhas mano a mano com o tiro secundário de sua metralhadora (<BINDING_CAST2>).

fr.original: Cogwheel is really strong in 1v1 close-up battles with his Rotary Cannon alt-fire (<BINDING_CAST2>).

ru.original: Cogwheel is really strong in 1v1 close-up battles with his Rotary Cannon alt-fire (<BINDING_CAST2>).
ru.translation: Cogwheel очень силен в ближнем бою 1 на 1 благодаря «альтернативному огню» своего многоствольного пулемета (<BINDING_CAST2>).

tip_text.text: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

es.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

pt.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de Tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais Tijolos.

fr.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
fr.translation: Votre nombre total de briques est affiché en bas à gauche de l'écran. Creusez pour en récupérer davantage.

ru.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
ru.translation: Общее количество кирпичей указано в левом нижнем углу экрана. Копай, чтобы получить больше кирпичей.

de.original: Land Mines placed together can often secure a kill.
