tip_text.text: Eliza’s Chem Grenade gas can pass through blocks. Use it to stop enemies tunneling below you.

de.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenade gas can pass through blocks. Use it to stop enemies tunneling below you.
de.translation: Das Gas von Elizas Chemiegranate wirkt durch Blöcke. Nutze es, um Gegner aufzuhalten, die sich unter dir hindurchgraben wollen.

es.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenade gas can pass through blocks. Use it to stop enemies tunneling below you.
es.translation: El humo de las granadas químicas de Eliza atraviesa los bloques. Úsalas para detener a los enemigos que cavan túneles debajo de tu posición.

pt.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenade gas can pass through blocks. Use it to stop enemies tunneling below you.
pt.translation: O gás da Granada Química de Eliza pode atravessar blocos. Use-a para impedir que inimigos caves túneis sob você.

fr.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenade gas can pass through blocks. Use it to stop enemies tunneling below you.
fr.translation: Le gaz des grenades chimiques d'Eliza traverse les blocs. Idéal pour arrêter les ennemis qui creusent des tunnels sous vos pieds.

ru.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenade gas can pass through blocks. Use it to stop enemies tunneling below you.
ru.translation: Газ химической гранаты Eliza способен просачиваться сквозь блоки. Используй его, чтобы остановить врагов, пробирающихся по туннелю.

tip_text.text: On death Eliza releases a cloud of chemical gas. Her Last Laugh Passive Ability can help your team after you die.

de.original: On death Eliza releases a cloud of chemical gas. Her Last Laugh Passive Ability can help your team after you die.
de.translation: Bei ihrem Tod hinterlässt Eliza eine giftige Gaswolke. Ihre passive Fähigkeit 'Wer zuletzt lacht' hilft deinem Team also sogar noch nach ihrem Tod.

es.original: On death Eliza releases a cloud of chemical gas. Her Last Laugh Passive Ability can help your team after you die.
es.translation: La destreza pasiva «Nube de gas» de Eliza se activa cuando mueres, lo que te permite ayudar a tu equipo incluso después de que te hayan matado.

pt.original: On death Eliza releases a cloud of chemical gas. Her Last Laugh Passive Ability can help your team after you die.
pt.translation: Ao morrer, Eliza solta uma nuvem de gás químico. Sua habilidade passiva Último Suspiro pode ajudar a sua equipe depois que você morrer.

fr.original: On death Eliza releases a cloud of chemical gas. Her Last Laugh Passive Ability can help your team after you die.
fr.translation: La capacité passive Hilarité fatale d'Eliza s'avèrera utile pour votre équipe car vous dégagerez un nuage toxique en mourant.

ru.original: On death Eliza releases a cloud of chemical gas. Her Last Laugh Passive Ability can help your team after you die.
ru.translation: Когда Eliza умирает, от нее остается облако ядовитого газа. С помощью пассивной способности «Прощальный привет» она может помочь команде и после смерти.

tip_text.text: Ammo Crates provide ammo to any teammates nearby, bury them for best results.

de.original: Ammo Crates provide ammo to any teammates nearby, bury them for best results.
de.translation: Munitionskisten versorgen nahe Teammitglieder mit Munition. Platzier sie für die besten Resultate geschützt im Boden.

es.original: Ammo Crates provide ammo to any teammates nearby, bury them for best results.
es.translation: Las cajas de municiones recargan las armas de tus aliados. Escóndelas para que tus rivales no las destruyan.

pt.original: Ammo Crates provide ammo to any teammates nearby, bury them for best results.
pt.translation: Caixotes de Munição proporcionam munição para quaisquer companheiros de equipe ao redor. Enterre-os para obter melhores resultados.

fr.original: Ammo Crates provide ammo to any teammates nearby, bury them for best results.
fr.translation: Les caisses de munitions réapprovisionnent vos coéquipiers à proximité en munitions. Placez-les sous terre pour une meilleure efficacité.

ru.original: Ammo Crates provide ammo to any teammates nearby, bury them for best results.
ru.translation: Ящики с боеприпасами обеспечивают боеприпасами находящихся поблизости участников команды. Закапывай их для достижения лучшего результата.

tip_text.text: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of the Globe Gun allows you to fire a short range Globe.

de.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of the Globe Gun allows you to fire a short range Globe.
de.translation: Mit dem alternativen Angriff des Säurekugelgewehrs (<BINDING_Cast2>) kannst du auf kurze Distanz Säurekugeln abschießen.

es.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of the Globe Gun allows you to fire a short range Globe.
es.translation: El ataque secundario del lanzaesferas (<BINDING_CAST2>) te permite atacar a corta distancia.

pt.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of the Globe Gun allows you to fire a short range Globe.
pt.translation: O tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) da Arma de Glóbulos permite que você dispare um glóbulo de curto alcance.

fr.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of the Globe Gun allows you to fire a short range Globe.
fr.translation: L'action secondaire du fusil corrosif (<BINDING_Cast2>) vous permet de lancer une bulle acide à bout portant.

ru.original: The alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> of the Globe Gun allows you to fire a short range Globe.
ru.translation: «Альтернативный огонь» (<BINDING_Cast2>) кислотной пушки дает возможность выстрелить шаром на короткой дистанции.

tip_text.text: Fire Traps can cause massive burn damage. On detonation they do damage and emit burning embers.

de.original: Fire Traps can cause massive burn damage. On detonation they do damage and emit burning embers.
de.translation: Feuerfallen lösen massiven Brandschaden aus. Bei ihrer Explosion richten sie Schaden an und hinterlassen ein brennendes Feld.

es.original: Fire Traps can cause massive burn damage. On detonation they do damage and emit burning embers.
es.translation: Las trampas ígneas causan daño por partida doble: primero al explotar y luego al llenar la zona de esquirlas ardientes.

pt.original: Fire Traps can cause massive burn damage. On detonation they do damage and emit burning embers.
pt.translation: Armadilhas de Fogo podem causar danos de queimadura colossais. Ao detonarem, elas causam danos e emitem fragmentos em brasa.

fr.original: Fire Traps can cause massive burn damage. On detonation they do damage and emit burning embers.
fr.translation: Les pièges incendiaires infligent des dégâts de feu considérables et laissent une traînée de braises après explosion.

ru.original: Fire Traps can cause massive burn damage. On detonation they do damage and emit burning embers.
ru.translation: Огненные ловушки могут нанести серьезный урон в виде ожогов. Взорвавшись, они наносят урон и образуют горящие угли.

tip_text.text: Eliza’s Chem Grenades provide fantastic crowd control. Use it to cover enemy bases.

de.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenades provide fantastic crowd control. Use it to cover enemy bases.
de.translation: Elizas Chemiegranaten sind perfekt geeignet für die Gebietskontrolle. Nutze sie, um die gegenerische Basis abzudecken.

es.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenades provide fantastic crowd control. Use it to cover enemy bases.
es.translation: Las granadas químicas son ideales para controlar zonas muy pobladas. Úsalas para llenar de humo los núcleos enemigos.

pt.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenades provide fantastic crowd control. Use it to cover enemy bases.
pt.translation: As Granadas Químicas de Eliza são excelentes para controle de massas. Use-as para cobrir Bases inimigas.

fr.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenades provide fantastic crowd control. Use it to cover enemy bases.
fr.translation: Les grenades chimiques d'Eliza sont idéales pour contrôler les foules. Lancez-les pour noyer les bases ennemies dans un nuage de gaz.

ru.original: Eliza’s Chem Grenades provide fantastic crowd control. Use it to cover enemy bases.

tip_text.text: The Chem Grenade can be charged and thrown and at full power it can cover a lot of distance.

de.original: The Chem Grenade can be charged and thrown and at full power it can cover a lot of distance.
de.translation: Du kannst die Chemiegranaten vor dem Werfen aufladen. Bei voller Ladung können sie weite Strecken überwinden.

es.original: The Chem Grenade can be charged and thrown and at full power it can cover a lot of distance.
es.translation: Mantén presionada la tecla durante más tiempo para lanzar las granadas químicas a mayor distancia.

pt.original: The Chem Grenade can be charged and thrown and at full power it can cover a lot of distance.

fr.original: The Chem Grenade can be charged and thrown and at full power it can cover a lot of distance.

ru.original: The Chem Grenade can be charged and thrown and at full power it can cover a lot of distance.

tip_text.text: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

de.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
de.translation: Links unten im Spielfenster siehst du, wie viele Bausteine du hast. Grab für mehr Bausteine!

es.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

pt.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de Tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais Tijolos.

fr.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

ru.original: You can see your Bricks total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

de.translation: Schneebälle sind Yurys effektivste Waffe, für Munition braucht er aber Schnee- oder Eisblöcke in der Nähe. Bau viel Schnee und Eis und du beherrschst das Gebiet!

es.original: Snowballs are Yury's most effective weapon, but he must be close to a Snow or Ice Block for ammo. Build lots of Snow and Ice to dominate an area!
es.translation: Las bolas de nieve son el arma más efectiva de Yury, pero debe estar cerca de un bloque de hielo o nieve para abastecerse de municiones. Coloca mucha nieve y hielo para dominar una zona.

fr.original: Snowballs are Yury's most effective weapon, but he must be close to a Snow or Ice Block for ammo. Build lots of Snow and Ice to dominate an area!
fr.translation: Les boules de neige de Yury sont ses armes les plus efficaces, mais il doit se tenir à proximité d'un bloc de neige ou d'un bloc de glace pour avoir une réserve de munitions. Placez un maximum de blocs de neige et de glace pour dominer une zone !

ru.original: Snowballs are Yury's most effective weapon, but he must be close to a Snow or Ice Block for ammo. Build lots of Snow and Ice to dominate an area!
ru.translation: Снежки ― самое опасное оружие в арсенале Yury, но если рядом нет снега или льда, он не сможет его применить. Сооружайте снежные и ледяные блоки, и вам не будет равных в бою.

pt.original: Snowballs are Yury's most effective weapon, but he must be close to a Snow or Ice Block for ammo. Build lots of Snow and Ice to dominate an area!
pt.translation: Bolas de Neve são a arma mais eficaz de Yury, mas ele precisa estar perto de um bloco de Neve ou Gelo para obter munição. Construa muitos blocos de Neve e Gelo para dominar uma área!

tip_text.text: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to charge up a powerful Snowball. The longer you charge, the faster and further it will be thrown.

de.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to charge up a powerful Snowball. The longer you charge, the faster and further it will be thrown.
de.translation: Halte die <BINDING_Cast2> gedrückt, um einen mächtigen Schneeball aufzuladen. Je länger du ihn auflädst, desto schneller und weiter wirfst du ihn.

es.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to charge up a powerful Snowball. The longer you charge, the faster and further it will be thrown.
es.translation: Mantén presionado <BINDING_Cast2> para cargar una poderosa bola de nieve. Cuanto más mantengas presionado, más lejos la lanzarás.

fr.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to charge up a powerful Snowball. The longer you charge, the faster and further it will be thrown.
fr.translation: Maintenez le <BINDING_Cast2> enfoncé pour charger une boule de neige puissante. Plus vous attendrez, plus elle gagnera en vitesse et portée.

ru.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to charge up a powerful Snowball. The longer you charge, the faster and further it will be thrown.
ru.translation: Нажми и держи <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь), чтобы слепить и швырнуть во врага смертельный снежок. Чем дольше держать кнопку, тем быстрее и дальше он полетит.

pt.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to charge up a powerful Snowball. The longer you charge, the faster and further it will be thrown.
pt.translation: Segure o tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) para carregar uma poderosa Bola de Neve. Quanto mais tempo você carregá-la, maior será sua velocidade e alcance.

tip_text.text: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

ru.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
ru.translation: Менять оружие можно при помощи «<BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>».

de.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
de.translation: Deine Waffe kannst du mit <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> wechseln.

es.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> para cambiar de arma.

fr.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
fr.translation: Changez d'arme en appuyant sur la touche <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

pt.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
pt.translation: Troque de armas com <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

tip_text.text: The SnowThrower 6000 SUX slows and damages enemy Heroes but does no damage to blocks. Use the alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to place snow blocks. Yury loves snow!

de.original: The SnowThrower 6000 SUX slows and damages enemy Heroes but does no damage to blocks. Use the alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to place snow blocks. Yury loves snow!
de.translation: Die Schneeschleuder 6000 SUX verlangsamt und beschädigt Gegner, jedoch keine Blöcke. Nutz die <BINDING_Cast2>, um Schneeblöcke zu platzieren. Yury liebt Schnee!

es.original: The SnowThrower 6000 SUX slows and damages enemy Heroes but does no damage to blocks. Use the alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to place snow blocks. Yury loves snow!
es.translation: El cañón de nieve ralentiza y hiere a los enemigos pero no destruye sus bloques. Oprime <BINDING_Cast2> para colocar bloques de nieve.

fr.original: The SnowThrower 6000 SUX slows and damages enemy Heroes but does no damage to blocks. Use the alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to place snow blocks. Yury loves snow!
fr.translation: Le NivoAtomiseur 6000 ralentit et inflige des dégâts aux ennemis, mais pas aux blocs. Utilisez son action secondaire (<BINDING_Cast2>) pour placer des blocs de neige. Yury adore la neige !

ru.original: The SnowThrower 6000 SUX slows and damages enemy Heroes but does no damage to blocks. Use the alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to place snow blocks. Yury loves snow!
ru.translation: Снегоуборщик 6000 SUX замедляет и травмирует вражеских героев, но абсолютно бесполезен против блоков. Нажми <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь), чтобы начать ставить снежные блоки. Yury обожает снег.

pt.original: The SnowThrower 6000 SUX slows and damages enemy Heroes but does no damage to blocks. Use the alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to place snow blocks. Yury loves snow!
pt.translation: A SnowThrower™ 6000 SUX desacelera e causa danos em heróis inimigos, mas não danifica blocos. Use o tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) para construir blocos de neve. Yury adora neve!

tip_text.text: Use the SnowThrower 6000 SUX's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to create a bridge which provides walk-ways for your teammates.

de.original: Use the SnowThrower 6000 SUX's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to create a bridge which provides walk-ways for your teammates.
de.translation: Nutz den alternativen Angriff der Schneeschleuder 6000 SUX (<BINDING_Cast2>), um Brücken für deine Teamkollegen zu errichten.

es.original: Use the SnowThrower 6000 SUX's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to create a bridge which provides walk-ways for your teammates.
es.translation: Usa el ataque secundario del cañón de nieve (<BINDING_Cast2>) para crear un puente que sirva de pasarela para tus aliados.

fr.original: Use the SnowThrower 6000 SUX's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to create a bridge which provides walk-ways for your teammates.
fr.translation: Utilisez l'action secondaire du NivoAtomiseur 6000 (<BINDING_Cast2>) pour construire un pont qui permettra à vos coéquipiers de se déplacer.

ru.original: Use the SnowThrower 6000 SUX's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to create a bridge which provides walk-ways for your teammates.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь), чтобы снегоуборщик 6000 SUX начал строить мост, которым смогут воспользоваться твои товарищи.

pt.original: Use the SnowThrower 6000 SUX's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to create a bridge which provides walk-ways for your teammates.
pt.translation: Use o tiro secundário da SnowThrower™ 6000 SUX (<BINDING_Cast2>) para criar uma ponte e proporcionar vias de acesso para seus companheiros de equipe.

tip_text.text: Yury's Passive Ability, Chilling Out, is the key to making the most of this Yeti warrior. Never go far from Snow or Ice without building more!

de.original: Yury's Passive Ability, Chilling Out, is the key to making the most of this Yeti warrior. Never go far from Snow or Ice without building more!
de.translation: Yurys passive Fähigkeit 'Chilling Out' trägt viel zum Erfolg mit dem Yeti-Krieger bei. Achte darauf, dass dir nie Eis und Schnee ausgehen!

es.original: Yury's Passive Ability, Chilling Out, is the key to making the most of this Yeti warrior. Never go far from Snow or Ice without building more!
es.translation: La destreza pasiva de Yury «Frío invernal» es esencial para sacar el mayor provecho de este guerrero yeti. Nunca te alejes de la nieve o el hielo sin antes construir.

fr.original: Yury's Passive Ability, Chilling Out, is the key to making the most of this Yeti warrior. Never go far from Snow or Ice without building more!
fr.translation: La capacité passive de Yury, Yéti-tude, est la clé de la puissance de ce guerrier Yéti. Si vous vous éloignez de vos blocs de neige ou blocs de glace, construisez-en d'autres !

ru.original: Yury's Passive Ability, Chilling Out, is the key to making the most of this Yeti warrior. Never go far from Snow or Ice without building more!
ru.translation: У Yury есть отличная пассивная способность — «Заморозка», которая и есть главным козырем Йети. Если рядом не будет снега или льда, добыть его теперь можно проще простого.

pt.original: Yury's Passive Ability, Chilling Out, is the key to making the most of this Yeti warrior. Never go far from Snow or Ice without building more!
pt.translation: A habilidade passiva de Yury, Fica Frio, é essencial para aproveitar ao máximo o talento deste guerreiro Yeti. Nunca saia de perto de blocos de Neve ou Gelo sem construir mais deles!

tip_text.text: Being near an Ice or Snow Block allows Yury to heal himself very slowly over time.

de.original: Being near an Ice or Snow Block allows Yury to heal himself very slowly over time.
de.translation: Wenn er in der Nähe von Eis- oder Schneeblöcken ist, kann sich Yury langsam mit der Zeit heilen.

es.original: Being near an Ice or Snow Block allows Yury to heal himself very slowly over time.
es.translation: Al estar cerca de los bloques de hielo o nieve, Yury puede curarse progresivamente.

fr.original: Being near an Ice or Snow Block allows Yury to heal himself very slowly over time.
fr.translation: Les blocs de glace et de neige régénèrent lentement les points de vie de Yury sur la durée s'il se tient à proximité.

ru.original: Being near an Ice or Snow Block allows Yury to heal himself very slowly over time.
ru.translation: Когда Yury стоит рядом со снежным или ледяным блоком, его раны медленно залечиваются.

pt.original: Being near an Ice or Snow Block allows Yury to heal himself very slowly over time.
pt.translation: Ficar perto de um bloco de Neve ou Gelo permite que Yury cure a si mesmo muito lentamente com o tempo.

tip_text.text: Avalanche leaves a slowing area for 4 seconds. Throw it where enemies are grouped or about to push.
Being close to Ice Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are tougher than Snow Blocks, and slippery for other Heroes.

de.original: Being close to Ice Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are tougher than Snow Blocks, and slippery for other Heroes.
de.translation: Yurys passive Fähigkeit wird in der Nähe von Eisblöcken aktiviert. Sie sind härter als Schneeblöcke und für andere Helden rutschig.

es.original: Being close to Ice Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are tougher than Snow Blocks, and slippery for other Heroes.
es.translation: La destreza pasiva de Yury se activa al estar cerca de los bloques de hielo. Son más resistentes que los bloques de nieve y resultan resbaladizos para los demás personajes.

fr.original: Being close to Ice Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are tougher than Snow Blocks, and slippery for other Heroes.
fr.translation: Les blocs de glace permettent à Yury d'activer sa capacité passive. Plus résistants que les blocs de neige, ils s'avèrent particulièrement glissants pour les autres héros.

ru.original: Being close to Ice Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are tougher than Snow Blocks, and slippery for other Heroes.
ru.translation: Когда Yury стоит рядом с ледяным блоком, его пассивная способность сразу становится активной. Лед прочнее снега и к тому же более скользкий.

pt.original: Being close to Ice Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are tougher than Snow Blocks, and slippery for other Heroes.
pt.translation: A proximidade com Blocos de Gelo ativa a habilidade passiva de Yury. Eles são mais resistentes que Blocos de Neve e escorregadios para outros heróis.

tip_text.text: Being close to Snow Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are weak and easily destroyed, so make sure you build a lot of them!

ru.original: Being close to Snow Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are weak and easily destroyed, so make sure you build a lot of them!
ru.translation: Когда Yury стоит рядом со снежным блоком, его пассивная способность сразу становится активной. Снежные блоки легко разрушить, так что их должно быть как можно больше.

de.original: Being close to Snow Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are weak and easily destroyed, so make sure you build a lot of them!
de.translation: Yurys passive Fähigkeit wird in der Nähe von Eisblöcken aktiviert. Sie können leicht zerstört werden, also bau viele!

es.original: Being close to Snow Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are weak and easily destroyed, so make sure you build a lot of them!
es.translation: La destreza pasiva de Yury se activa al estar cerca de los bloques de nieve. Son más frágiles que los bloques de hielo, así que asegúrate de construir muchos.

fr.original: Being close to Snow Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are weak and easily destroyed, so make sure you build a lot of them!
fr.translation: Les blocs de neige permettent à Yury d'activer sa capacité passive. Peu résistants, ils sont facilement destructibles. Placez-en un maximum !

pt.original: Being close to Snow Blocks activates Yury's Passive Ability. They are weak and easily destroyed, so make sure you build a lot of them!
pt.translation: A proximidade com Blocos de Neve ativa a habilidade passiva de Yury. Eles são fracos e podem ser facilmente destruídos, então construa vários deles!

tip_text.text: Yury's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but his Passive Ability gives him infinite ammo when close to Snow or Ice Blocks.

de.original: Yury's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but his Passive Ability gives him infinite ammo when close to Snow or Ice Blocks.
de.translation: Munitionskisten laden Yurys Waffen langsam auf, aber seine passive Fähigkeit verleiht ihm in der Nähe von Schnee und Eis unbegrenzte Munition.

es.original: Yury's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but his Passive Ability gives him infinite ammo when close to Snow or Ice Blocks.
es.translation: Las armas de Yury regeneran municiones muy lentamente a partir de las cajas de municiones, pero su destreza pasiva le brinda municiones infinitas al estar cerca de hielo o nieve.

fr.original: Yury's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but his Passive Ability gives him infinite ammo when close to Snow or Ice Blocks.
fr.translation: Les caisses de munitions permettent à Yury de régénérer ses munitions très lentement. En revanche, sa capacité passive lui confère des munitions illimitées s'il se tient près d'un bloc de neige ou de glace.

ru.original: Yury's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but his Passive Ability gives him infinite ammo when close to Snow or Ice Blocks.
ru.translation: Yury пополняет свой боекомплект с помощью ящика с боеприпасами или благодаря своей пассивной способности, когда стоит рядом со снегом или льдом. Во втором случае боеприпасы не иссякнут никогда.

pt.original: Yury's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but his Passive Ability gives him infinite ammo when close to Snow or Ice Blocks.
pt.translation: As armas de Yury recarregam sua munição muito lentamente com Caixotes de Munição, mas sua habilidade passiva proporciona a ele munição infinita quando próximo a blocos de Neve ou Gelo.

tip_text.text: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

de.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
de.translation: Links unten im Spielfenster siehst du, wie viele Bausteine du hast. Grab für mehr Bausteine!

es.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

fr.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
fr.translation: Votre nombre total de briques est affiché en bas à gauche de l'écran. Creusez pour en récupérer davantage.

ru.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
ru.translation: Общее количество кирпичей указано в левом нижнем углу экрана. Копай, чтобы получить больше кирпичей.

pt.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de Tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais Tijolos.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_HEROINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном герое.

de.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_HEROINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Helden anzusehen.

es.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_HEROINFO> para ver información detallada del personaje elegido.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_HEROINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le héros sélectionné.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected Hero.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_HEROINFO> no jogo para ver informações detalhadas sobre o herói selecionado.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном блоке.

de.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_DEVICEINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Block anzusehen.

es.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> para ver información detallada del bloque elegido.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le bloc sélectionné.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> no jogo para ver informações sobre o bloco selecionado.

tip_text.text: Hidari & Migi are Kira's customised SMGs. Although powerful, they are slow to reload, so keep a careful eye on your ammo.

de.original: Hidari & Migi are Kira's customised SMGs. Although powerful, they are slow to reload, so keep a careful eye on your ammo.
de.translation: Hidari & Migi sind Kiras modifizierte MPs. Ihr Einschlag ist mächtig, aber sie laden relativ langsam nach, also behalte deine Munition im Auge.

es.original: Hidari & Migi are Kira's customised SMGs. Although powerful, they are slow to reload, so keep a careful eye on your ammo.
es.translation: Hidari y Migi son las pistolas ametralladoras de Kira. Son potentes pero tardan bastante en recargarse, así que no es recomendable quedarte sin municiones.

fr.original: Hidari & Migi are Kira's customised SMGs. Although powerful, they are slow to reload, so keep a careful eye on your ammo.
fr.translation: Hidari & Migi sont les pistolets-mitrailleurs SMG de Kira. Bien qu'ils soient très puissants, leur temps de rechargement est assez long. Faites donc bien attention à votre quantité de munitions.

ru.original: Hidari & Migi are Kira's customised SMGs. Although powerful, they are slow to reload, so keep a careful eye on your ammo.
ru.translation: «Сладкая парочка» — это пара переделанных пистолетов-пулеметов из арсенала Kira. Это убойное оружие, но их очень долго перезаряжать, так что береги патроны.

pt.original: Hidari & Migi are Kira's customised SMGs. Although powerful, they are slow to reload, so keep a careful eye on your ammo.
pt.translation: Hidari & Migi são as submetralhadoras personalizadas de Kira. Apesar de serem poderosas, elas demoram para serem recarregadas, então fique sempre de olho na sua munição.

tip_text.text: In stable semi-auto shooting mode <BINDING_CAST1> Hidari & Migi deal sustained damage at medium to long range.

de.original: In stable semi-auto shooting mode <BINDING_CAST1> Hidari & Migi deal sustained damage at medium to long range.
de.translation: Nutz die <BINDING_CAST1>, um mit Hidari & Migi im beständigen, halbautomatischen Feuermodus auf mittlere und lange Distanz Schaden anzurichten.

es.original: In stable semi-auto shooting mode <BINDING_CAST1> Hidari & Migi deal sustained damage at medium to long range.
es.translation: En el modo estable semiautomático (<BINDING_CAST1>), las ametralladoras causan daño a medio y largo alcance.

fr.original: In stable semi-auto shooting mode <BINDING_CAST1> Hidari & Migi deal sustained damage at medium to long range.
fr.translation: En mode de tir semi-automatique (<BINDING_CAST1>), Hidari & Migi infligent des dégâts constants à moyenne et longue portée.

ru.original: In stable semi-auto shooting mode <BINDING_CAST1> Hidari & Migi deal sustained damage at medium to long range.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_CAST1>, чтобы стрелять очередями. Так ты сможешь вести прицельный огонь по врагу со средней и дальней дистанции.

pt.original: In stable semi-auto shooting mode <BINDING_CAST1> Hidari & Migi deal sustained damage at medium to long range.
pt.translation: No modo de tiro semiautomático (<BINDING_CAST1>), Hidari & Migi causam danos prolongados de médio a longo alcance.

tip_text.text: In full auto alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>, Hidari & Migi deal lots of damage very quickly, but are much less accurate. Use at close range!

de.original: In full auto alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>, Hidari & Migi deal lots of damage very quickly, but are much less accurate. Use at close range!
de.translation: Drück die <BINDING_CAST2>, um mit Hidari & Migi schnell viel Schaden anzurichten. Der Angriff ist jedoch weniger genau, also nutz ihn auf kurze Distanzen!

es.original: In full auto alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>, Hidari & Migi deal lots of damage very quickly, but are much less accurate. Use at close range!
es.translation: Al oprimir <BINDING_CAST2>, causarás daño muy rápidamente pero no podrás apuntar con precisión. Usa ese modo cuando tengas a los enemigos cerca.

fr.original: In full auto alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>, Hidari & Migi deal lots of damage very quickly, but are much less accurate. Use at close range!
fr.translation: En mode de tir automatique (<BINDING_CAST2>), Hidari & Migi infligent des dégâts considérables très rapidement, mais perdent en précision. Mieux vaut utiliser ce mode de tir en combat rapproché !

ru.original: In full auto alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>, Hidari & Migi deal lots of damage very quickly, but are much less accurate. Use at close range!
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_CAST2>, чтобы стрелять непрерывно. Прикончить врага можно будет намного быстрее, но сильно страдает точность стрельбы. Используй в ближнем бою.

pt.original: In full auto alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>, Hidari & Migi deal lots of damage very quickly, but are much less accurate. Use at close range!
pt.translation: Usando o tiro secundário automático (<BINDING_CAST2>), Hidari & Migi causam muitos danos muito rapidamente, mas são bem menos precisos. Use-o a curta distância!

tip_text.text: Thrill Kill, Kira's Passive Ability, heals and shields her when she defeats an enemy hero. Always be on the lookout for weakened enemies you can pick off to reap the benefits.

ru.original: Thrill Kill, Kira's Passive Ability, heals and shields her when she defeats an enemy hero. Always be on the lookout for weakened enemies you can pick off to reap the benefits.
ru.translation: «Кровавый угар» — это пассивная способность Kira. Когда она убивает вражеского героя, вокруг нее образуется щит, а ее раны начинают затягиваться. Добивай покалеченных врагов, и с тобой сложно будет совладать.

de.original: Thrill Kill, Kira's Passive Ability, heals and shields her when she defeats an enemy hero. Always be on the lookout for weakened enemies you can pick off to reap the benefits.
de.translation: Kiras passive Fähigkeit Thrill-Kill heilt und schützt sie, wenn sie einen Gegner besiegt hat. Also halt die Augen nach geschwächten Gegnern offen!

es.original: Thrill Kill, Kira's Passive Ability, heals and shields her when she defeats an enemy hero. Always be on the lookout for weakened enemies you can pick off to reap the benefits.
es.translation: Emoción perversa, la destreza pasiva de Kira, la cura y protege cuando mata a un enemigo. Siempre mantente alerta por si hay enemigos débiles para poder sacar provecho de ella.

fr.original: Thrill Kill, Kira's Passive Ability, heals and shields her when she defeats an enemy hero. Always be on the lookout for weakened enemies you can pick off to reap the benefits.
fr.translation: Grâce à sa capacité passive Instinct de tueuse, Kira se soigne et est protégée dès qu'elle tue un ennemi. Ayez l'œil pour faucher des ennemis affaiblis et en tirer parti au maximum.

pt.original: Thrill Kill, Kira's Passive Ability, heals and shields her when she defeats an enemy hero. Always be on the lookout for weakened enemies you can pick off to reap the benefits.
pt.translation: Emoção Assassina, a habilidade passiva de Kira, cura e protege quando ela derrota um herói inimigo. Esteja sempre alerta para encontrar inimigos enfraquecidos que você possa eliminar para aproveitar essas vantagens.

tip_text.text: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

de.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
de.translation: Deine Waffe kannst du mit <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> wechseln.

es.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> para cambiar de arma.

fr.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
fr.translation: Changez d'arme en appuyant sur la touche <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

ru.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
ru.translation: Менять оружие можно при помощи «<BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>».

pt.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
pt.translation: Troque de armas com <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

tip_text.text: Kira's Kitty Launcher has two fire modes. Normal fire with <BINDING_Cast1> to launch accurate kitty rockets.

de.original: Kira's Kitty Launcher has two fire modes. Normal fire with <BINDING_Cast1> to launch accurate kitty rockets.
de.translation: Kiras Kitty-Werfer hat zwei Feuermodi. Nutz die <BINDING_Cast1>, um zielgenaue Kitty-Raketen abzufeuern.

es.original: Kira's Kitty Launcher has two fire modes. Normal fire with <BINDING_Cast1> to launch accurate kitty rockets.
es.translation: El lanzagatitos tiene dos modos de disparo. Oprime <BINDING_Cast1> para disparar en línea recta.

fr.original: Kira's Kitty Launcher has two fire modes. Normal fire with <BINDING_Cast1> to launch accurate kitty rockets.
fr.translation: Le lance-miaou de Kira possède deux modes de tir. Utilisez le mode de tir normal (<BINDING_Cast1>) pour lancer des peluches-roquettes précises.

ru.original: Kira's Kitty Launcher has two fire modes. Normal fire with <BINDING_Cast1> to launch accurate kitty rockets.
ru.translation: Kira может стрелять из кошкомета двумя способами. Нажми <BINDING_Cast1>, чтобы вести прицельную стрельбу ракетами. Это обычный режим.

pt.original: Kira's Kitty Launcher has two fire modes. Normal fire with <BINDING_Cast1> to launch accurate kitty rockets.
pt.translation: O Lançador de Gatinho de Kira possui dois modos de disparo. Use o tiro primário com <BINDING_Cast1> para lançar foguetes de gatinho precisos.

tip_text.text: Use the Kitty Launcher's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to lob kitty grenades over walls and other obstacles.

de.original: Use the Kitty Launcher's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to lob kitty grenades over walls and other obstacles.
de.translation: Nutz den alternativen Angriff des Kitty-Werfers (<BINDING_Cast2>), um Kitty-Granaten über Wände oder andere Hindernisse zu werfen.

es.original: Use the Kitty Launcher's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to lob kitty grenades over walls and other obstacles.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_Cast2> para disparar en forma de parábola y así sortear muros u otros obstáculos.

fr.original: Use the Kitty Launcher's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to lob kitty grenades over walls and other obstacles.
fr.translation: Utilisez l'action secondaire du lance-miaou (<BINDING_Cast2>) pour lancer des chatons explosifs par-dessus les murs et les obstacles.

ru.original: Use the Kitty Launcher's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to lob kitty grenades over walls and other obstacles.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь), чтобы метнуть гранату через стену или другую преграду.

pt.original: Use the Kitty Launcher's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to lob kitty grenades over walls and other obstacles.
pt.translation: Use o tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) do Lançador de Gatinho para tacar granadas por cima de paredes e outros obstáculos.

tip_text.text: Use the Kitty Launcher’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>to roll her kitty grenades into an enemy base, perfect for controlled explosions.

de.original: Use the Kitty Launcher’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>to roll her kitty grenades into an enemy base, perfect for controlled explosions.
de.translation: Nutz den alternativen Angriff des Kitty-Werfers (<BINDING_CAST2>), um mit Kitty-Granaten kontrollierte Explosionen in der gegnerischen Basis auszulösen.

es.original: Use the Kitty Launcher’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>to roll her kitty grenades into an enemy base, perfect for controlled explosions.
es.translation: Usa el ataque secundario del Lanzagatitos (<BINDING_Cast2>) para disparar en forma de parábola y así provocar una explosión controlada en el núcleo enemigo.

fr.original: Use the Kitty Launcher’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>to roll her kitty grenades into an enemy base, perfect for controlled explosions.
fr.translation: Utilisez l'action secondaire du lance-miaou (<BINDING_CAST2>) pour lancer des chatons explosifs dans la base ennemie. Juste ce qu'il faut pour des explosions contrôlées.

ru.original: Use the Kitty Launcher’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>to roll her kitty grenades into an enemy base, perfect for controlled explosions.
ru.translation: <BINDING_CAST2> также позволяет забрасывать гранатами вражескую базу — идеальный вариант, если надо провести серию точечных ударов.

pt.original: Use the Kitty Launcher’s alt-fire <BINDING_CAST2>to roll her kitty grenades into an enemy base, perfect for controlled explosions.
pt.translation: Use o tiro secundário (<BINDING_CAST2>) do Lançador de Gatinho para rolar granadas de gatinho para uma base inimiga, perfeito para explosões controladas.

tip_text.text: Kira’s Active Ability J-POP Star grants her infinite ammo for a short time - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to turn any fight into a performance!

de.original: Kira’s Active Ability J-POP Star grants her infinite ammo for a short time - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to turn any fight into a performance!
de.translation: Kiras aktive Fähigkeit 'J-POP-Star' verleiht ihr für kurze Zeit unbegrenzte Munition - drück <BINDING_USEABILITY>, um jeden Kampf in eine coole Show zu verwandeln!

es.original: Kira’s Active Ability J-POP Star grants her infinite ammo for a short time - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to turn any fight into a performance!
es.translation: La destreza activa de Kira se llama Estrella pop y le brinda munición infinita durante un breve período. ¡Oprime <BINDING_USEABILITY> para que empiece el show!

fr.original: Kira’s Active Ability J-POP Star grants her infinite ammo for a short time - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to turn any fight into a performance!
fr.translation: La capacité active de Kira, Star de la J-pop, lui confère des munitions illimitées pendant un court laps de temps. Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_USEABILITY> pour transformer les combats en véritable show !

ru.original: Kira’s Active Ability J-POP Star grants her infinite ammo for a short time - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to turn any fight into a performance!
ru.translation: «Звезда японской поп-музыки» — активная способность Kira, с помощью которой она может ненадолго сделать свой запас боеприпасов неиссякаемым. Жми <BINDING_USEABILITY> и устрой врагам кровавую мясорубку.

pt.original: Kira’s Active Ability J-POP Star grants her infinite ammo for a short time - press <BINDING_USEABILITY> to turn any fight into a performance!
pt.translation: A habilidade ativa de Kira, Estrela J-POP, proporciona munição infinita por um curto período de tempo - aperte (<BINDING_USEABILITY>) para transformar qualquer luta numa performance!

tip_text.text: J-POP Star also boosts the reload speed of nearby friendly Heroes, so use it in big fights to support your team.

de.original: J-POP Star also boosts the reload speed of nearby friendly Heroes, so use it in big fights to support your team.
de.translation: J-POP-Star verbessert auch das Nachladetempo naher Teamkollegen. Setze den Effekt in großen Schlachten ein, um sie zu unterstützen.

es.original: J-POP Star also boosts the reload speed of nearby friendly Heroes, so use it in big fights to support your team.
es.translation: Estrella pop también acelera la recarga de los aliados cercanos, así que puedes usarla en grandes peleas para apoyar a tu equipo.

fr.original: J-POP Star also boosts the reload speed of nearby friendly Heroes, so use it in big fights to support your team.
fr.translation: Grâce à sa capacité active Star de la J-pop, vos alliés pourront aussi recharger leurs armes plus rapidement. Utilisez cette capacité lors de gros affrontements pour aider votre équipe.

ru.original: J-POP Star also boosts the reload speed of nearby friendly Heroes, so use it in big fights to support your team.
ru.translation: Товарищи Kira смогут быстрее перезаряжать оружие, если будут стоять рядом, так что применяйте эту способность в массовых побоищах.

pt.original: J-POP Star also boosts the reload speed of nearby friendly Heroes, so use it in big fights to support your team.
pt.translation: Estrela J-POP também aumenta a velocidade de recarregamento de heróis amigos por perto, então use-a em batalhas importantes para apoiar sua equipe.

tip_text.text: Build a pair of Popstar Portals to allow heroes to teleport from one to the other. But beware - enemies can use them too!

ru.original: Build a pair of Popstar Portals to allow heroes to teleport from one to the other. But beware - enemies can use them too!
ru.translation: Построй пару порталов поп-звезды, и твои товарищи смогут перемещаться между ними. Враги также смогут делать это, так что будь начеку.

de.original: Build a pair of Popstar Portals to allow heroes to teleport from one to the other. But beware - enemies can use them too!
de.translation: Errichte zwei Popstarportale, damit sich Helden von einem zum anderen teleportieren können. Aber Vorsicht - deine Gegner können sie auch benutzen!

es.original: Build a pair of Popstar Portals to allow heroes to teleport from one to the other. But beware - enemies can use them too!
es.translation: Construye un par de portales para que tus compañeros puedan teletransportarse de un lugar a otro. Pero ten cuidado, ya que los enemigos también pueden usarlos.

fr.original: Build a pair of Popstar Portals to allow heroes to teleport from one to the other. But beware - enemies can use them too!
fr.translation: Construisez deux portails pour permettre aux héros de se téléporter de l'un à l'autre. Mais attention, vos ennemis pourront aussi les utiliser !

pt.original: Build a pair of Popstar Portals to allow heroes to teleport from one to the other. But beware - enemies can use them too!
pt.translation: Construa um par de Portais Popstar para permitir que os heróis se teleportem de um para o outro. Mas cuidado - os inimigos também podem usá-los!

tip_text.text: Think carefully about where to build Popstar Portals and how to make the best use of them - they are a key to success with Kira.

ru.original: Think carefully about where to build Popstar Portals and how to make the best use of them - they are a key to success with Kira.
ru.translation: Тщательно продумай, где их лучше построить и как их лучше использовать. Если сделать все правильно, Kira станет очень опасной в бою.

de.original: Think carefully about where to build Popstar Portals and how to make the best use of them - they are a key to success with Kira.
de.translation: Überleg dir gut, wo du deine Popstarportale platzieren willst und wie du sie am besten nutzen kannst. Sie sind Kiras Schlüssel zum Erfolg!

es.original: Think carefully about where to build Popstar Portals and how to make the best use of them - they are a key to success with Kira.
es.translation: Piensa bien dónde colocarás los portales y cómo sacar el mejor provecho de ellos. Son la clave del éxito de Kira.

fr.original: Think carefully about where to build Popstar Portals and how to make the best use of them - they are a key to success with Kira.
fr.translation: Choisissez soigneusement les emplacements de vos portails de popstar afin de les utiliser au mieux : ils sont essentiels si vous voulez gagner avec Kira.

pt.original: Think carefully about where to build Popstar Portals and how to make the best use of them - they are a key to success with Kira.
pt.translation: Planeje bastante onde construir os Portais Popstar e como utilizá-los - eles são a chave do sucesso com Kira.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.

de.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_RECALL>, um in ungefähr 15 Sekunden wieder bei deiner Basis zu erscheinen. Sehr nützlich, wenn du in einer Zwickmühle steckst!

es.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
es.translation: Si oprimes <BINDING_RECALL> volverás al punto de partida de ese mapa luego de 15 segundos. Útil si te encuentras en una posición difícil.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_RECALL> en jeu pour retourner à votre base au bout de 15 secondes. Pratique si vous êtes en mauvaise posture.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
ru.translation: Нажми «<BINDING_RECALL>» в игре, чтобы вернуться на базу примерно через 15 секунд. Это удобно, когда оказываешься в сложной ситуации.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
pt.translation: Pressione a tecla <BINDING_RECALL> no jogo para retornar à sua Base depois de cerca de 15 segundos. Útil se você estiver numa situação difícil.

tip_text.text: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

de.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
de.translation: Links unten im Spielfenster siehst du, wie viele Bausteine du hast. Grab für mehr Bausteine!

es.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

fr.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
fr.translation: Votre nombre total de briques est affiché en bas à gauche de l'écran. Creusez pour en récupérer davantage.

ru.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
ru.translation: Общее количество кирпичей указано в левом нижнем углу экрана. Копай, чтобы получить больше кирпичей.

pt.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de Tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais Tijolos.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_HEROINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном герое.

de.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_HEROINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Helden anzusehen.

es.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_HEROINFO> para ver información detallada del personaje elegido.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_HEROINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le héros sélectionné.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_HEROINFO> in game to see detailed information about your selected hero.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_HEROINFO> no jogo para ver informações detalhadas sobre o herói selecionado.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> в игре, чтобы узнать подробнее о выбранном блоке.

de.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_DEVICEINFO>, um dir alle Infos zu deinem ausgewählten Block anzusehen.

es.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> para ver información detallada del bloque elegido.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> en jeu pour afficher plus d'infos sur le bloc sélectionné.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> in game to see information about your selected block.
pt.translation: Pressione <BINDING_DEVICEINFO> no jogo para ver informações sobre o bloco selecionado.

tip_text.text: Vander's Static Gloves can fire blasts of lightning directly at the enemy, but are also used to charge his Tesla Coil Blocks.

de.original: Vander's Static Gloves can fire blasts of lightning directly at the enemy, but are also used to charge his Tesla Coil Blocks.
de.translation: Vanders Statikhandschuhe können Blitze auf seine Gegner abfeuern, werden jedoch auch genutzt, um seine Teslaspulen aufzuladen.

es.original: Vander's Static Gloves can fire blasts of lightning directly at the enemy, but are also used to charge his Tesla Coil Blocks.
es.translation: Los guantes voltaicos de Vander pueden disparar rayos directamente a sus enemigos, pero también sirven para encender sus bobinas Tesla.

fr.original: Vander's Static Gloves can fire blasts of lightning directly at the enemy, but are also used to charge his Tesla Coil Blocks.
fr.translation: Les gants statiques de Vander Graaf peuvent projeter des éclairs en direction d'un ennemi, mais aussi alimenter ses bobines Tesla.

ru.original: Vander's Static Gloves can fire blasts of lightning directly at the enemy, but are also used to charge his Tesla Coil Blocks.
ru.translation: С помощью наэлектризованных перчаток Vander может поражать врага электрическими разрядами, а также подпитывать свои катушки Теслы.

pt.original: Vander's Static Gloves can fire blasts of lightning directly at the enemy, but are also used to charge his Tesla Coil Blocks.
pt.translation: As Luvas Estáticas de Vander podem disparar raios na direção do inimigo, mas também são usadas para carregar suas Bobinas de Tesla.

tip_text.text: Alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with Static Gloves to channel a solid beam of lightning through Vander's head! Very effective against enemies at close range.

de.original: Alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with Static Gloves to channel a solid beam of lightning through Vander's head! Very effective against enemies at close range.
de.translation: Nutze die <BINDING_Cast2> mit ausgerüsteten Statikhandschuhen, um einen Blitz durch Vanders Kopf zu leiten! Sehr effektiv gegen nahe Gegner.

es.original: Alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with Static Gloves to channel a solid beam of lightning through Vander's head! Very effective against enemies at close range.
es.translation: El ataque secundario de los guantes voltaicos (<BINDING_Cast2>) lanza un rayo concentrado desde la cabeza de Vander. Muy efectivo contra enemigos que están cerca.

fr.original: Alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with Static Gloves to channel a solid beam of lightning through Vander's head! Very effective against enemies at close range.
fr.translation: L'action secondaire des gants statiques (<BINDING_Cast2>) permet à Vander d'attirer l'électricité pour la relâcher sur ses ennemis ! Très efficace en combat rapproché.

ru.original: Alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with Static Gloves to channel a solid beam of lightning through Vander's head! Very effective against enemies at close range.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь) во время использования перчаток, чтобы пропустить через голову Vander мощный пучок энергии, который буквально испепеляет врагов в ближнем бою.

pt.original: Alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with Static Gloves to channel a solid beam of lightning through Vander's head! Very effective against enemies at close range.
pt.translation: Use o tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) com as Luvas Estáticas para canalizar um feixe sólido de raios pela cabeça de Vander! Muito eficaz contra inimigos a curta distância.

tip_text.text: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

ru.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
ru.translation: Менять оружие можно при помощи «<BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>».

de.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
de.translation: Deine Waffe kannst du mit <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> wechseln.

es.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS> para cambiar de arma.

fr.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
fr.translation: Changez d'arme en appuyant sur la touche <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

pt.original: Swap weapons with <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.
pt.translation: Troque de armas com <BINDING_TOGGLEWEAPONS>.

tip_text.text: Ball Lightning has good range and explodes on contact with enemy Heroes or blocks, shocking everything nearby.

de.original: Ball Lightning has good range and explodes on contact with enemy Heroes or blocks, shocking everything nearby.
de.translation: Blitzbälle haben eine gute Reichweite und explodieren bei Kontakt mit Gegnern oder deren Blöcken und elektrisieren alles um sie herum.

es.original: Ball Lightning has good range and explodes on contact with enemy Heroes or blocks, shocking everything nearby.
es.translation: La Esfera luminosa tiene gran alcance y explota al entrar en contacto con los personajes o bloques enemigos, devastando todo lo que tenga a su alrededor.

fr.original: Ball Lightning has good range and explodes on contact with enemy Heroes or blocks, shocking everything nearby.
fr.translation: Les boules de foudre ont une portée moyenne et explosent au contact des héros ou blocs ennemis, provoquant une onde de choc alentour.

ru.original: Ball Lightning has good range and explodes on contact with enemy Heroes or blocks, shocking everything nearby.
ru.translation: Шаровой молнией можно уничтожать врагов и объекты издалека. При попадании в цель происходит взрыв, вызывающий мощную ударную волну.

pt.original: Ball Lightning has good range and explodes on contact with enemy Heroes or blocks, shocking everything nearby.
pt.translation: O Relâmpago Esférico tem um bom alcance e explode ao entrar em contato com heróis inimigos ou blocos, dando um choque em tudo que estiver por perto.

tip_text.text: Ball Lightning's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> detonates five smaller balls right in front of Vander. Particularly effective against groups of enemies.

de.original: Ball Lightning's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> detonates five smaller balls right in front of Vander. Particularly effective against groups of enemies.
de.translation: Der alternative Angriff von Blitzball (<BINDING_Cast2>) lässt fünf kleinere Bälle vor Vander explodieren. Besonders effektiv gegen Gruppen von Gegnern.

es.original: Ball Lightning's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> detonates five smaller balls right in front of Vander. Particularly effective against groups of enemies.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_Cast2> para detonar cinco bolas pequeñas frente a Vander. Muy efectivo contra grupos de enemigos.

fr.original: Ball Lightning's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> detonates five smaller balls right in front of Vander. Particularly effective against groups of enemies.
fr.translation: Grâce à l'action secondaire de Foudre en boule (<BINDING_Cast2>), Vander peut décocher cinq boules de foudre plus petites droit devant lui. Particulièrement efficace contre les groupes d'ennemis.

ru.original: Ball Lightning's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> detonates five smaller balls right in front of Vander. Particularly effective against groups of enemies.
ru.translation: Нажми <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь) во время использования шаровой молнии, если хочешь, чтобы рядом с Vander взорвалось пять небольших шаровых молний. Делать это лучше, когда рядом будет много врагов.

pt.original: Ball Lightning's alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> detonates five smaller balls right in front of Vander. Particularly effective against groups of enemies.
pt.translation: O tiro secundário do Relâmpago Esférico (<BINDING_Cast2>) detona cinco esferas menores bem em frente a Vander. É especialmente eficaz contra grupos de inimigos.

tip_text.text: Static Boots, Vander's Passive Ability, quickly regenerates his ammo when he sprints. Stay on the move!

de.original: Static Boots, Vander's Passive Ability, quickly regenerates his ammo when he sprints. Stay on the move!
de.translation: Durch Vanders passive Fähigkeit 'Statikstiefel' lädt er seine Munition beim Rennen schnell wieder auf. Bleib in Bewegung!

es.original: Static Boots, Vander's Passive Ability, quickly regenerates his ammo when he sprints. Stay on the move!
es.translation: La destreza pasiva de Vander se llama «Botas electroestáticas» y regenera rápidamente sus municiones cuando corre. ¡No pares de moverte!

fr.original: Static Boots, Vander's Passive Ability, quickly regenerates his ammo when he sprints. Stay on the move!
fr.translation: La capacité passive de Vander, Bottes statiques, lui permet de recharger rapidement ses munitions lorsqu'il court. Allez, on se bouge !

ru.original: Static Boots, Vander's Passive Ability, quickly regenerates his ammo when he sprints. Stay on the move!
ru.translation: «Наэлектризованные ботинки» — пассивная способность Vander. Он пользуется ею во время бега, чтобы быстро пополнить запасы боеприпасов, так что не сиди на месте.

pt.original: Static Boots, Vander's Passive Ability, quickly regenerates his ammo when he sprints. Stay on the move!
pt.translation: As Botas Estáticas, a habilidade passiva de Vander, regeneram sua munição rapidamente quando ele dá uma arrancada. Não pare para descansar!

tip_text.text: Vander’s Passive Ability allows him to negate any damage he may do to himself with his Ball Lightning, use the alt-fire up close and personal!

de.original: Vander’s Passive Ability allows him to negate any damage he may do to himself with his Ball Lightning, use the alt-fire up close and personal!
de.translation: Durch Vanders passive Fähigkeit ist er vor dem Schaden seiner Blitzbälle geschützt, also kannst du seinen alternativen Angriff sorgenfrei im Nahkampf einsetzen.

es.original: Vander’s Passive Ability allows him to negate any damage he may do to himself with his Ball Lightning, use the alt-fire up close and personal!
es.translation: La destreza pasiva de Vander le permite rechazar el daño que pueda causarse a sí mismo con su Esfera luminosa. Usa el ataque secundario para atacar de cerca.

fr.original: Vander’s Passive Ability allows him to negate any damage he may do to himself with his Ball Lightning, use the alt-fire up close and personal!
fr.translation: La capacité passive de Vander lui permet d'éviter de subir les dégâts potentiels de Foudre en boule. Utilisez son action secondaire pour corser le combat !

ru.original: Vander’s Passive Ability allows him to negate any damage he may do to himself with his Ball Lightning, use the alt-fire up close and personal!
ru.translation: Для Vander его пассивная способность — это своеобразная страховка, которая защищает его от собственных шаровых молний. Альтернативный огонь лучше использовать в ближнем бою.

pt.original: Vander’s Passive Ability allows him to negate any damage he may do to himself with his Ball Lightning, use the alt-fire up close and personal!
pt.translation: A habilidade passiva de Vander permite que ele neutralize qualquer dano que ele possa causar a si mesmo com o Relâmpago Esférico. Use o tiro secundário perto dos inimigos!

tip_text.text: Vander's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but be sure to build some for your teammates to use.

de.original: Vander's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but be sure to build some for your teammates to use.
de.translation: Vanders Waffen laden Munition nur langsam an Munitionskisten wieder auf, doch du solltest sie auf jeden Fall für deine Teamkollegen aufstellen.

es.original: Vander's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but be sure to build some for your teammates to use.
es.translation: Las armas de Vander regeneran municiones lentamente a partir de las cajas de municiones. No olvides colocar algunas para tus compañeros de equipo.

fr.original: Vander's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but be sure to build some for your teammates to use.
fr.translation: Les caisses de munitions permettent à Vander de régénérer ses munitions très lentement, mais pensez à en placer pour vos coéquipiers.

ru.original: Vander's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but be sure to build some for your teammates to use.
ru.translation: Vander может пополнить свой боекомплект с помощью ящика с боеприпасами, но делать это он будет очень медленно, а вот его товарищам такие ящики будут как раз кстати.

pt.original: Vander's weapons regenerate ammo very slowly from Ammo Crates, but be sure to build some for your teammates to use.
pt.translation: As armas de Vander regeneram munição muito lentamente com os caixotes de munição, mas não se esqueça de construí-los para seus companheiros de equipe.

tip_text.text: Vander's Tesla Coils are charged by the bolts of lightning from his Static Gloves. Unlike Tony's Lil' Buddy turrets, they will not fire without first being charged up.

de.original: Vander's Tesla Coils are charged by the bolts of lightning from his Static Gloves. Unlike Tony's Lil' Buddy turrets, they will not fire without first being charged up.
de.translation: Vanders Teslaspulen müssen durch die Blitze seiner Statikhandschuhe aufgeladen werden. Anders als Tonys Gefechtstürme feuern sie nicht von alleine.

es.original: Vander's Tesla Coils are charged by the bolts of lightning from his Static Gloves. Unlike Tony's Lil' Buddy turrets, they will not fire without first being charged up.
es.translation: Las bobinas Tesla de Vander amplifican los rayos que emanan de sus guantes voltaicos. A diferencia de las torretas de Tony, las bobinas deben cargarse para que disparen.

fr.original: Vander's Tesla Coils are charged by the bolts of lightning from his Static Gloves. Unlike Tony's Lil' Buddy turrets, they will not fire without first being charged up.
fr.translation: Les bobines Tesla de Vander sont alimentées par l'énergie électrique générée par ses gants statiques. Contrairement aux tourelles de Tony, elles ne tireront pas sur les ennemis si vous ne les avez pas chargées auparavant.

ru.original: Vander's Tesla Coils are charged by the bolts of lightning from his Static Gloves. Unlike Tony's Lil' Buddy turrets, they will not fire without first being charged up.
ru.translation: Катушки Теслы, которые использует Vander, заряжаются от его наэлектризованных перчаток. В отличие от турелей Дружка Tony, они не стреляют без предварительной зарядки.

pt.original: Vander's Tesla Coils are charged by the bolts of lightning from his Static Gloves. Unlike Tony's Lil' Buddy turrets, they will not fire without first being charged up.
pt.translation: As Bobinas de Tesla de Vander são carregadas pelos raios de suas Luvas Estáticas. Ao contrário das torres de tiro de Tony, elas não atiram sem serem carregadas.

tip_text.text: Each Tesla Coil can hold one charge. However, Lightning Bolts can 'jump' from a charged to an un-charged Tesla Coil before being fired at an enemy Hero.

ru.original: Each Tesla Coil can hold one charge. However, Lightning Bolts can 'jump' from a charged to an un-charged Tesla Coil before being fired at an enemy Hero.
ru.translation: Каждую катушку Теслы можно зарядить один раз. Однако разряд молнии может перепрыгнуть с заряженной катушки Теслы на незаряженную, прежде чем ударит по вражескому герою.

de.original: Each Tesla Coil can hold one charge. However, Lightning Bolts can 'jump' from a charged to an un-charged Tesla Coil before being fired at an enemy Hero.
de.translation: Jede Teslaspule kann nur eine Ladung speichern. Blitze können jedoch von einer geladenen zu einer ungeladenen Teslaspule überspringen, bevor sie auf einen Gegner abgefeuert werden.

es.original: Each Tesla Coil can hold one charge. However, Lightning Bolts can 'jump' from a charged to an un-charged Tesla Coil before being fired at an enemy Hero.
es.translation: Cada bobina Tesla puede almacenar una carga, pero los rayos pueden transmitirse de una bobina cargada a una descargada antes de que afecten a un enemigo.

fr.original: Each Tesla Coil can hold one charge. However, Lightning Bolts can 'jump' from a charged to an un-charged Tesla Coil before being fired at an enemy Hero.
fr.translation: Chaque bobine Tesla peut contenir une charge d'énergie. En revanche, les éclairs qui s'en dégagent peuvent se propager à une bobine non chargée avant d'électrocuter un héros ennemi.

pt.original: Each Tesla Coil can hold one charge. However, Lightning Bolts can 'jump' from a charged to an un-charged Tesla Coil before being fired at an enemy Hero.
pt.translation: Cada Bobina de Tesla pode armazenar uma carga. Porém, os raios podem saltar de uma bobina carregada para uma descarregada antes de serem disparadas contra um inimigo.

tip_text.text: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.

ru.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
ru.translation: Нажми «<BINDING_RECALL>» в игре, чтобы вернуться на базу примерно через 15 секунд. Это удобно, когда оказываешься в сложной ситуации.

de.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
de.translation: Drück im Spiel <BINDING_RECALL>, um in ungefähr 15 Sekunden wieder bei deiner Basis zu erscheinen. Sehr nützlich, wenn du in einer Zwickmühle steckst!

es.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
es.translation: Si oprimes <BINDING_RECALL> volverás al punto de partida de ese mapa luego de 15 segundos. Útil si te encuentras en una posición difícil.

fr.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
fr.translation: Appuyez sur la touche <BINDING_RECALL> en jeu pour retourner à votre base au bout de 15 secondes. Pratique si vous êtes en mauvaise posture.

pt.original: Press <BINDING_RECALL> in game to recall back to your base after about 15 seconds. Handy if you’re in a tricky spot.
pt.translation: Pressione a tecla <BINDING_RECALL> no jogo para retornar à sua Base depois de cerca de 15 segundos. Útil se você estiver numa situação difícil.

tip_text.text: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.

de.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
de.translation: Links unten im Spielfenster siehst du, wie viele Bausteine du hast. Grab für mehr Bausteine!

es.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
es.translation: En la esquina inferior izquierda de la pantalla aparece tu total de cubos. Ese número aumentará con cada bloque que rompas.

fr.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
fr.translation: Votre nombre total de briques est affiché en bas à gauche de l'écran. Creusez pour en récupérer davantage.

ru.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
ru.translation: Общее количество кирпичей указано в левом нижнем углу экрана. Копай, чтобы получить больше кирпичей.

pt.original: You can see your Brick total on the bottom left of the HUD. Dig for more Bricks.
pt.translation: Você pode ver seu total de Tijolos na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Escave para obter mais Tijolos.

tip_text.text: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.

de.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
de.translation: Roly Polys TankBall-Kanonen verfügen über eine gute Reichweite und Genauigkeit. Nutze sie für beständige Angriffe auf deine Gegner.

pt.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
pt.translation: Os canhões da TanqueBola de Roly Poly oferecem bom alcance e precisão. Use-os para atirar continuamente no inimigo.

fr.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
fr.translation: Les lance-missiles de la Rolymobile ont une portée et une précision redoutables, ce qui est idéal pour faire pleuvoir un feu nourri sur vos ennemis.

es.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
es.translation: Los cañones tienen largo alcance y gran precisión. Úsalos para dispararles a tus rivales de manera continua.

ru.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons provide good range and accuracy, use them to sustain fire on the enemy.
ru.translation: У Roly Poly есть отличные танковые пушки — они очень точные, далеко стреляют и словно созданы, чтобы поливать врага огнем.

tip_text.text: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.

de.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
de.translation: Halte die <BINDING_Cast2> gedrückt, um mit dem alternativen Angriff von Roly Polys TankBall ein Paar hochexplosive Patronen abzuschießen.

pt.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
pt.translation: Use o tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) para lançar um par de projéteis altamente explosíveis dos canhões da TanqueBola de Roly Poly.

fr.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
fr.translation: Utilisez l'action secondaire (<BINDING_Cast2>) pour catapulter deux obus surpuissants grâce aux lance-missiles de la Rolymobile.

es.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_Cast2> para efectuar el ataque secundario de los cañones. Su gran potencia los hace ideales para destruir fortines y defensas.

ru.original: Hold down alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> to unleash a pair of high explosive shells from Roly Poly’s TankBall Cannons.
ru.translation: Зажми <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь), из пушек Roly Poly вылетит два очень мощных снаряда.

tip_text.text: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.

de.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
de.translation: Durch die Booster-Raketen erhält Roly Poly ein bisschen mehr Mobilität. Nutze sie für einen Sturmangriff.

pt.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
pt.translation: Os Foguetes Propulsores dão a Roly Poly um pouco mais de mobilidade. Use-os para dar um curto ataque de propulsão.

fr.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
fr.translation: Grâce à son Roquettoboost, Roly Poly peut se déplacer plus rapidement. Utilisez-le pour foncer sur vos adversaires.

es.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
es.translation: Los propulsores aumentan la velocidad de desplazamiento durante un breve instante.

ru.original: The Booster Rockets give Roly Poly that extra bit of mobility, fire to unleash a short dashing attack.
ru.translation: Когда Roly Poly стреляет реактивными ракетами, сила тяги толкает ее вперед, и она может сделать небольшой рывок в сторону врага.

tip_text.text: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.

de.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
de.translation: Drück die <BINDING_Cast2>, um mit dem alternativen Angriff von Roly Poly Fat Fats Booster-Raketen giftiges Gas zu hinterlassen. Nutze es, um deine Gegner aufzuhalten oder einen Rückzug anzutreten.

pt.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
pt.translation: Crie poças de gosma tóxica atrás de Roly Poly Fat Fat usando o tiro secundário (<BINDING_Cast2>) com os foguetes propulsores.

fr.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
fr.translation: Laissez des flaques de boue toxique derrière Roly Poly Fat Fat grâce à l'action secondaire (<BINDING_Cast2>) de son Roquettoboost. Cela vous permettra de bloquer l'accès à une zone à vos ennemis, ou de vous aider à vous échapper.

es.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
es.translation: Oprime <BINDING_Cast2> para activar el ataque secundario de los propulsores y crear charcos de líquido tóxico pegajoso, ideales para ayudarte a huir o para anegar una zona.

ru.original: Create pools of bubbling toxic goo behind Roly Poly Fat Fat by pressing alt-fire <BINDING_Cast2> with her Booster Rockets. Use it to deny an area to the enemy, or to help you escape.
ru.translation: Если хочешь создать позади Roly Poly Fat Fat лужи с пузырящейся ядовитой слизью, нажми <BINDING_Cast2> (альтернативный огонь), когда выпустишь реактивные ракеты. Используй, чтобы не отдать область врагу или осуществить побег.

tip_text.text: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.

de.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.
de.translation: Roly Polys TankBall-Rüstung schützt sie vor kritischen Treffern. Nutze sie, um so viel Schaden abzuwehren wie möglich.

pt.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.
pt.translation: A Blindagem da TanqueBola de Roly Poly evita que ela seja atingida por acertos críticos. Use-a para absorver o maior dano possível.

fr.original: Roly Poly’s TankBall Armor stops her from being hit by critical shots. Use it to absorb as much damage as possible.
fr.translation: Grâce à sa capacité Rolymobile blindée, Roly Poly est protégée des coups critiques. Utilisez-la pour absorber le plus de dégâts possible.
